raw.description:
Description

CapsLock is a company that specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses that are facing sales growth challenges. Our comprehensive services include sales consulting, data analytics, and recruitment support, all seamlessly integrated to ensure efficient and accelerated growth.

Our company was founded by industry professionals with expertise in IT, design, and data analytics. We identified a significant need for an exclusive, scalable customer acquisition solution in the market. Our vision is to provide a unique integrated solution for B2C clients that enables profitable customer acquisition, flexible scaling, and optimized internal processes.

At CapsLock, our core values center around our people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and fostering strong relationships. Our diverse and skilled team speaks 10+ languages and is located worldwide. We are dedicated to pioneering new and efficient marketing strategies to ensure our clients’ success.

﻿Role Description

As a Finance Director at CapsLock, you will be responsible for overseeing all financial aspects of the fast-growing marketing business, ensuring accuracy in financial reporting, and providing strategic guidance to support our business goals. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills and extensive financial expertise.

This role will report to the Chief Finance Officer of the Company.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Team leadership: Lead and mentor bookkeeping, FP&A, and taxation/compliance teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
  • Accounting: Oversee accounting. Lead implementation and improvement of financial and accounting policies/practices.
  • Budgeting: Oversees budgeting process. Supervise plan/fact analysis and provide explanations and recommendations.
  • Reporting: Ensure timely and accurate financial, and investment reporting for the Group of Companies
  • Internal Controls and Audits. Assist with developing and maintaining robust internal controls. Lead internal audits to ensure compliance with established financial procedures.
  • Tax and Compliance: Oversee tax filings, regulatory reports, and compliance with statutory obligations. Tax planning and optimization for the group
  • M&A transactions: Navigate the complexities of mergers and acquisitions including initial financial assessments, Due Diligence, and post-merger integration.
  • Process Improvement: Continuously improve financial processes, systems, and financial reporting to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and strategic relevance
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide insights and recommendations on financial performance and key financial metrics to the executive team
  • Third-party Communication: Manage relationships with banks, tax advisories, and external consultants

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA, CPA, ACCA preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in finance, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
  • Experience with financial reporting, month-end / year-end processes, and IFRS/GAAP compliance.
  • Proven track record in financial planning, analysis, and management within a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with executive management and external stakeholders.
  • Proactive nature, growth mindset, self-regulation.
  • Fluent English.
  • Ability and desire to work collaboratively with a diverse, remote global team.

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer above-market compensation, but we also offer perks and benefits that promote people’s well–being. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.

Ongoing Learning

People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.

Home Office

We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.

Physical Well–Being

Fitness is more than a gym membership. We all have different tastes and preferences. That’s why we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program that fits all.

Unlimited Sick Days

We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.

Fun Stuff

There is never a shortage of fun stuff when you work with amazing people. But we like to spice things up and take them to the next level, you will soon learn how.

raw.excerpt: Our Mission:6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.
raw.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

Senior Manager, GTM Engineering

Marketing Operations | Reports to: Sr. Director, Marketing Operations | Direct reports: 1 (BDR Operations Specialist)

About the Role

6sense's Marketing Operations team builds the technical backbone behind our go-to-market motion: systems integration, campaign orchestration, and AI-assisted workflows across the marketing and BDR stack.

This role will create the AI architecture, agents, and workflows that power our agentic GTM motion.

Why this role, why now

6sense is building the intelligence engine for agentic go-to-market, and this role is central to how our own Marketing team puts that strategy into practice. What you build will run our pipeline motion and get regular visibility from leaders across the company. It's a rare chance to build agentic GTM inside the company defining it.

The Sr. Manager, GTM Engineering builds the automations, integrations, and AI agents that let Marketing scale output efficiently while increasing productivity and impact. That spans core GTM engineering (lead capture, routing, and BDR handoff), BDR prospecting automation, agentic support for content and campaign creation, and ABM personalization across Marketing.

This is a hands-on technical role with management responsibilities. You'll independently weigh tradeoffs across speed, scale, data quality, privacy, AI governance, adoption, and pipeline impact, and serve as the go-to technical voice on what's scalable and sound, turning strategy into working systems that marketers and BDRs actually use. You'll own GTM engineering priorities and delivery across Marketing and BDR teams, partnering with Marketing Operations, Revenue/Growth Marketing, Customer and Event Marketing, BDR Leadership, RevOps, and IT.

Key Responsibilities

AI Agent & Workflow Architecture

  • Build agentic workflows for end-to-end campaign creation, from brief intake to first-draft assets, using Claude and comparable enterprise LLM platforms. Orchestrate agents across MCP connectors to optimize AI usage across the stack. Partner with Growth, Customer, and Event Marketing to cut manual production time on recurring campaign types, with human review in the loop.
  • Automate Marketing work management. For example, create workflows that allow marketers to build campaign assets leveraging centralized context governing product positioning, use cases, personas, and marketing channel best practices.
  • Build reusable patterns, templates, and playbooks so Marketing teams can adopt automations without GTM Engineering support.

GTM Systems Architecture & Integration

  • Be our own best customer: Build the best-in-class use of the 6sense platform within a headless GTM architecture, using 6sense data and intelligence through external tools, APIs, and MCP.
  • Build BDR prospecting automation, including signal-based account prioritization, research assembly, outreach drafting, and task automation, to increase high-quality pipeline per BDR.
  • Own the BDR technology stack, including the sales engagement platform and dialer, with BDR leadership and your BDR Operations Specialist.
  • Partner with BDR leaders to find productivity bottlenecks, then prioritize, ship, and measure fixes.

Governance, Experimentation & Iteration

  • Embed security, privacy, and compliance into workflows and agents by design, including data handling, agent permissions, and access controls, in partnership with Business Technology and Security.
  • Flag design or scale risk in workflows and agents before they ship.
  • Run technical experiments on automation and agent logic, and iterate on performance data and pipeline impact with BDR and Marketing leadership.

Team Leadership & Influence

  • Manage, coach, and prioritize work for one direct report (BDR Operations Specialist), developing their ownership of BDR tooling and process.
  • Run intake and prioritization of automation requests across competing stakeholders, and influence senior Marketing and Revenue leaders without relying on authority.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in marketing operations, GTM/revenue systems engineering, or marketing automation, with ownership of complex GTM systems, cross-functional roadmap delivery, and executive stakeholder management.
  • Hands-on experience building automations and integrations across a marketing/RevOps stack, such as Salesforce, Marketo, and 6sense or comparable ABM/intent platforms (APIs, webhooks, iPaaS).
  • Strong understanding of top-of-funnel GTM and BDR/SDR operations: lead routing, scoring, handoff SLAs, sales engagement and dialer tooling, and attribution.
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or agents in a business context using Claude or comparable LLM platforms, with working fluency orchestrating agents through MCP connectors or similar.
  • Experience building content and campaign automation workflows, from brief intake to first-draft assets.
  • B2B SaaS or subscription GTM experience, ideally across multiple regions, segments, or sales motions.
  • Experience managing, mentoring, or technically leading others.
  • Ability to translate business needs into practical technical delivery plans and build effective relationships across Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and IT.

Who You Are

  • Curious and a natural problem solver: you dig into root causes, not just the request in front of you.
  • Proactive with a strong bias to act: you form theories and test them on your own, without waiting to be asked, move fast within guardrails, measure the results, and retire what doesn't work.
  • A strategic translator: you turn business strategy into tangible actions, workflows, and systems.
  • Comfortable with visibility: you communicate credibly with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, and the executive team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building ABM personalization and GTM workflows at scale.
  • Experience automating work-management tools such as Asana.
  • Familiarity with attribution platforms such as Dreamdata.
  • Exposure to AI governance and responsible-AI practices.

Success Measures

  • Increase in high-quality pipeline generated per BDR to contribute to bookings.
  • Measurable improvement in speed-to-lead and routing accuracy from lead capture to BDR handoff.
  • Measurable reduction in BDR manual and administrative time.
  • AI-assisted workflows and agents that run reliably in production with real adoption across Marketing, not just GTM and outbound.
  • Measurable reduction in manual production time for campaign creation and ABM personalization.
  • Zero production incidents from agents or automations reaching customers or prospects without review.

Base Salary Range: $150,081.25 - $180,852.50. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

raw.description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    Our dynamic team is committed to delivering top-notch customer experiences and innovative solutions. We are seeking a dedicated Product Solution Engineer I to join our team and bridge the gap between our development and support teams, ensuring seamless resolution of customer issues.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and resolve complex L4 support escalations within assigned product areas.
  • Investigate, reproduce, and troubleshoot customer-reported technical issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with Engineering and Product teams on defect resolution.
  • Document technical findings, reproduction steps, and resolution details accurately.
  • Create, maintain, and improve support articles, SOPs, and troubleshooting documentation.
  • Analyze ticket trends to identify recurring issues, product gaps, and customer pain points.
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve product quality and customer experience.
  • Conduct technical training sessions for Support and Customer Success teams.
  • Develop onboarding materials, knowledge-sharing content, and walkthrough videos.
  • Engage directly with customers to troubleshoot complex issues and provide technical guidance.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvements in support workflows, documentation, and self-service resources.
  • Ensure adherence to SLAs, quality standards, and escalation processes.
  • Continuously build expertise in assigned products and emerging technologies.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2–4 years of experience in Technical Support, Product Support, Solutions Engineering, or a similar technical role.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
  • Experience working with APIs, REST services, Web technologies, and HTTP protocols.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and databases for investigation purposes.
  • Experience using browser developer tools, logs, API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and debugging utilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong documentation and technical writing abilities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams.
  • Experience analyzing support data and identifying trends.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting SLAs.
  • Customer-first mindset with strong ownership and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with additional programming languages or frameworks.
  • Familiarity with customer support tools and ticketing systems.
  • Previous experience in a customer-facing role.

About SuperchargeMe

SuperchargeMe is one brain for the whole commerce business. Ten products, Ads-IQ, Retention-IQ, Restock-IQ, Stores-IQ, Marketplaces-IQ, Crossborder-IQ, NPD-IQ, Concierge-IQ, Feeds-IQ and Partnership-IQ, share one set of numbers. They don't stop at recommendations: they make the changes too, at the level of control each brand chooses. It works inside Slack, plugs into 100+ tools from Shopify and NetSuite to Meta, Google and Amazon, and is running 23 brands today across paid media, retention, inventory and wholesale, stores, marketplaces, catalog and partnerships.

Every function has a tool. Nothing runs the whole. We built SuperchargeMe to run the whole.

The product is live and brands are paying for it. Selling it full-time is the next step. That's you.

The role in a sentence

You'll be the first person selling SuperchargeMe full-time: finding mid-market omnichannel brands that haven't heard of us, getting meetings with their leadership, and closing deals on numbers the CFO can sign off.

Where we are

SuperchargeMe is already revenue-generating, with brands paying for it every month. Case studies from our first clients are being written now. Until now the founders have sold it themselves. You'll take over the deals and conversations they've started, then build a much bigger pipeline with your own outbound, contacts and partner introductions.

Who you sell to: mid-market omnichannel brands, roughly $20M to $300M in revenue, primarily in the US with UK and EU brands too, selling across their own store, marketplaces, wholesale and retail. Brands starting with a single product sign up on their own. Brands that want several platforms working together, with onboarding, come to you.

There's no sales team or SDRs yet, and what works in a sale is still in the founders' heads. Writing it down is part of the job. A founding Growth Marketer joins at the same time to bring in demos. A Chief Revenue Officer will join as we grow, and you'll be the first seller on the team they build.

Most brand leaders recognize the problem as soon as you describe it: ten or twenty tools, several with their own AI, all reporting different numbers. We call it the Silo Tax. Putting a number on it for every brand you meet is the job.

The work

  • Take over the deals and conversations the founders have started, then build on them with your own target accounts, outbound, contacts and introductions from agencies, Shopify partners and systems integrators.
  • Run each deal from first call to signature: discovery, an ROI case built on the brand's own numbers, a live demo, a trial, negotiation and close.
  • Keep the risk low for buyers with short trials, a phased setup and a clear plan for what they'll see in the first 30 days.
  • Show finance and operations leaders what connecting Shopify, their ERP, ad platforms and marketplaces is worth in margin, inventory and cash.
  • Start each customer on whichever product proves value fastest, then add more. Brands that signed up on their own for one product are good candidates.
  • Write down what wins and loses deals, so the next sellers have a playbook and the product team hears what buyers want.

What good looks like

We'll judge you on new revenue you found and closed yourself.

  • In your first month you can demo the product without help, you've agreed a target list with the founders, and your first meetings with senior people are booked.
  • By the end of your first quarter your pipeline has grown well beyond what you took over, with trials running and your first deals closed.
  • Buyers who had never heard of us take your second meeting.
  • The founders stop joining your first calls, because they don't need to.

What you bring

  • Five or more years selling B2B software, with at least three as a mid-market or commercial Account Executive on 60 to 90 day sales cycles and contracts in the five to six figures.
  • Proof that you've beaten your number, such as commission statements or how you ranked against other sellers.
  • Deals won with buyers who had never heard of your company, with most of your closed revenue coming from leads you found yourself.
  • You're comfortable talking to finance and operations leaders about margin, inventory, cash and payback.
  • Your own relationships with senior people at mid-market omnichannel brands.
  • A working knowledge of the commerce stack: Shopify, NetSuite or another ERP, Meta, Google and Amazon ads, and email and SMS tools.
  • You use AI tools and agents in your own selling and can show us how. We sell AI agents, so we'd expect that.

Bonus points

  • You've been one of a startup's first three salespeople.
  • You've sold at companies like NetSuite, Celigo, Wunderkind, Feedonomics, Bloomreach, Daasity, Extensiv, Brightpearl, Skio or Okendo.

Skip this one if

  • You need inbound leads and a famous logo to open doors.
  • You want a finished playbook, an enablement team and SDRs from day one.
  • You'd rather demo features than build an ROI case a CFO signs off.
  • You'd rather manage a book than build one.

Why join

  • You'll set how we sell: the pitch, the playbook and the feedback that shapes pricing. Every seller after you will build on it.
  • Most brand leaders haven't yet seen AI that takes actions on their business. You'll be the one showing them.
  • You'll work directly with both founders, who ran commerce brands before building software. Deals get decided quickly, and what buyers tell you reaches the product fast.
  • Commission has no cap, contracts grow as customers add products, and you get stock options in the company you're helping build.

How we hire

  • A 30-minute intro call with the co-founders.
  • A deal deep-dive: talk us through two deals you found and closed yourself, with proof of what you hit.
  • A mock first call where you pitch a CFO who has never heard of SuperchargeMe.
  • References, including a former manager.

What you get

$110,000–$140,000 base · $220,000–$280,000 OTE

50/50 base and variable, uncapped commission, stock options so you own a real piece of what you build, and a strong benefits package.

Remote within the United States, with travel to client meetings and industry events, and some calls on UK and EU hours.

raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability.

As Grafana’s offering shifts from dashboards to industry-leading agentic observability, our Product Marketing team is responsible for closing the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. That means building clear, consistent positioning, enabling sellers with trustworthy technical narratives, and creating content that helps Platform Engineering teams quickly grasp why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

As a Technical Product Marketer you will play a critical part in that transformation. You’ll be the hands-on engineer who brings our technical story to life for buyers, not just practitioners. You’ll build core demos, run technical workshops and webinars, and act as the technical bridge between our Product and Sales orgs. Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey.

This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars

  • Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos that highlight Grafana’s value for SRE and platform engineering leaders.
  • Record high-quality technical demo videos and walkthroughs in partnership with our video and content teams.
  • Lead webinars, workshops, and technical sessions designed for evaluators.
  • Teach customers not just how Grafana works, but why our approach is differentiated and valuable.
  • Use AI tools to generate variations, summaries, and reusable assets that scale technical content across channels.

Enable Solutions (Sales) Engineers with clear, consistent technical storytelling

  • Serve as PMM’s technical liaison to the SE org, ensuring consistent messaging and demo guidance.
  • Produce technical enablement assets, value-driven talk tracks, competitive narratives, and demo best practices.
  • Help SEs and sellers communicate Grafana’s story with clarity, confidence, and differentiation.

Collaborate with PMMs to drive technical buyer engagement across high-impact channels

  • Partner with PMMs to identify the most important buyer personas, problems, and technical messages, and help shape the content strategy needed to reach them.
  • Extend technical narratives into impactful buyer-facing channels including analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester), industry forums, podcasts, conferences, and online technical communities.
  • Bring a technical perspective to PMM planning—helping ensure our content, campaigns, and enablement reflect the real challenges and priorities of SREs and engineering leaders.

Use automation & AI to scale technical content

  • Partner with software engineers to streamline demo setup, content workflows, and asset updates through workflows, agents, scripts, and AI-driven tools.
  • Use automation to make technical content more repeatable, discoverable, and scalable across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years in a technical role (solutions engineering, SRE, DevOps, backend engineering, technical PMM, or similar).
  • Interest and ability to travel to training and customer events 10-12 weeks per year.
  • Strong understanding of observability concepts and the needs of SRE/platform teams.
  • Ability to translate deep technical concepts into clear, value-focused stories.
  • Experience presenting technical content through demos, workshops, or webinars.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a crisp, structured, persuasive style.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration; comfort working with PMM, Product, SEs, DevRel, and Field Engineering.
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from concept to completion.
  • Comfort with light scripting or workflow automation.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, or similar observability tools, or a background in Observability or Platform Engineering.
  • Prior experience in Sales Engineering, DevRel, or technical product marketing.
  • Familiarity with demo environment automation or infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Exceptional live presentation or workshop facilitation skills.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the US, the base compensation range for this role is $183,858 - $220,630. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

About Lowry Research

Founded in 1938 and acquired by CFRA in 2021, Lowry Research provides independent technical market analysis to investment professionals. Our proprietary methodology uses daily price and volume data from NYSE and Nasdaq-listed stocks to evaluate market supply and demand, identify trends, and assess market conditions.
This temporary, part-time Technical Research Analyst position offers an opportunity to contribute to Lowry Research's proprietary technical research for Lowry and CFRA clients globally.

This is a fully remote, temporary position based in the United States, expected to last approximately two months at 25 hours per week.

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform technical market analysis using Lowry Research's proprietary data, indicators, and methodology.
  • Prepare daily market commentary and regular technical research reports covering market trends, sectors, industry groups, ETFs, and individual equities.
  • Monitor and interpret market breadth, volume, momentum, relative strength, and other technical indicators.
  • Support Senior Analysts in identifying market trends and developing technical research themes.
  • Assist with recurring research publications, market updates, and data analysis.
  • Maintain research databases and indicators, supporting improvements and automation where applicable.
  • Collaborate with technical and fundamental research teams and participate in internal meetings as needed.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Chartered Market Technician (CMT) designation or progress toward certification preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in technical market analysis or investment research incorporating technical indicators.
  • Experience analyzing market breadth, volume, momentum, trend, and relative strength indicators across equities, ETFs, sectors, and industry groups.
  • Experience writing investment research reports, market commentary, or other financial publications.
  • Strong analytical, writing, and Microsoft Excel skills, with proficiency in Word and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to interpret market data, identify trends, and communicate findings clearly and concisely.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment.

raw.description:
CancerNavigator is an early-stage healthcare company (remote, headquartered in Washington, D.C.) dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.

Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief

Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.

CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. All of our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who work with members to catch cancer early, get them to fantastic experts for their care, and help them through the thousands of other problems patients and their families face.

Join us to help serve cancer patients in their hour of need.

The “Nurse Navigator” Role

Our oncology nurse navigators are the front-line of CancerNavigator’s patient service. Nurse Navigators support patients at all parts of their journey – newly diagnosed, in active treatment, and entering remission. With more specificity, oncology nurse navigators:

  • Educate cancer patients (and their families) about their diagnosis, treatment options, and provide helpful information on any related questions and concerns the patient may have
  • Work closely with the researchers on our team to deliver tailored information to patients, guiding them to the centers and doctors that would be a great option for the patient’s care
  • Do everything possible to address any barriers to care (e.g. registering and scheduling appointments, coordinating with their health plan or their care team, transferring records, etc.)
  • Provide longitudinal support to the patient throughout their journey – helping them solve any issues related to their cancer diagnosis and care – whether connecting patients to mental health support, finding resources to ease the financial burden, arranging transportation to appointments, or answering any questions that may arise

The Requirements

The main requirement of this role is oncology nursing experience and a passion for serving cancer patients. More specifically, we are looking for someone with the following experience and qualifications:

  • Ability to work Pacific hours (8am-5pm PST)
  • Native Spanish Speaker
  • 3+ years of oncology nursing experience
  • Mastery of common navigation and care coordination issues (registration, scheduling, clinical department navigation, insurance coordination, solving coverage issues, etc.)
  • Mastery of basic computer tools (Gmail, Zoom, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Preferred: Oncology Certified Nurse (OCN)

Compensation and Benefits

  • Starting Salary Range: $100-115k (based on skills and experience)
  • Dental and Healthcare (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy up coverage)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Remote-first work; live where you want within the continental US
  • All-company on-sites 2x per year (in Washington DC and Denver)

Our Culture & Values, In Brief

We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer – serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.

We have three company values, which guide our work:

  1. Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.
  2. Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.
  3. Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.

At CancerNavigator, we believe a well-rounded and diverse team is a key to our success. We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As the Sr. Director, RevOps AMER, you are the most senior Revenue Operations leader for the Americas business, and a critical executive stakeholder. Reporting directly to the Vice President, Revenue Operations & Data Intelligence, you will serve as the primary strategic architect and operational co-pilot to the SVP of Sales AMER. You will own the operating engine and the predictability behind the AMER number. You are responsible for the end-to-end design of the AMER go-to-market (GTM) engine, translating global strategy into regional execution while scaling a high-performance operations team. You will bring a proven track record of designing regional operating models that scale and predictable quarterly outcomes. Ideal candidates will have:

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager, EMEA to be the go-to operator for our EMEA GTM team. This is a high-impact, highly visible role for someone who wants to shape how a growing region runs, from the first marketing touch to the closed deal and beyond.

As we build in-region Field Operations coverage, you'll set the playbook for how LaunchDarkly runs in EMEA, and you'll see your impact within your first 90 days, not your first year. If you're a business partner at heart who loves turning ambiguity into rhythm and results, this role is for you.

  • Regional Playbooks: Adapt global plays for land, expand, and renewals. Track how playbooks drive conversion and optimize over time.

About You:

  • You are a business partner first who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and operations.
  • You're fluent in the language of pipeline and forecasting, but just as comfortable sitting with a rep as with a VP.
  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks, and you hold yourself to a high bar.
  • You move fast with an 80/20 mindset, and you can look at a process you built and say "this isn't working" without defensiveness.
  • You know how to influence without authority, and you build relationships before you push for change.
  • You stay curious, embrace feedback, and keep looking for ways to level up yourself and those around you.
  • You’re energized by working across multiple EMEA markets, and you keep a global team aligned from a different time zone.

Qualifications:

  • Typically requires 8 years of experience, or equivalent depth of expertise, in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or a related GTM operations role
  • Experience supporting EMEA GTM teams, ideally in a regional-focused capacity
  • Proven experience running forecast, pipeline, and business review cadences with senior GTM leaders
  • Strong working knowledge of the full GTM lifecycle, including lead management, pipeline generation, sales stages, and customer handoffs
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience, with the ability to write clear business requirements for systems product owners and developers
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Experience at a B2B SaaS or high-growth tech company
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

## Senior Product ManagerAustin, TX or Remote (US) | Full-time | Salary + Equity## About the RoleThis is one of the most important hires at Suppli. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who wants the autonomy and impact of a founding product role, with direct ownership of one or two of our core products.You won't just manage a roadmap — you'll define the vision and strategy for your product area, establish what success looks like, and own execution from customer discovery through launch and iteration. You'll work closely with our Head of Product, founders, engineers, and commercial teams to solve meaningful problems for our customers.We're a fast-moving company with an ambitious engineering team. We need someone who can turn customer insights and business opportunities into clear product direction, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and give engineers the context they need to build exceptional software.We're looking for someone who thinks in outcomes, moves fast, and uses AI not as a buzzword but as a daily multiplier — to prototype, design, analyze, and build.---## Who Thrives Here* You think like an owner, not a feature manager. You're comfortable taking responsibility for an entire product area — from understanding customer problems and setting priorities to defining the roadmap and delivering measurable results. You don't need someone telling you what to build next.* You can move from idea to prototype quickly. When you have a product hypothesis, you find ways to validate it before committing significant engineering resources. Whether that's a clickable flow, an AI-assisted prototype, or a functional proof of concept, you make ideas tangible.* You're analytical and decisive. You break down ambiguous problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and make decisions grounded in customer insights, data, and business impact. You know when to investigate further and when to move.* You define success before you build anything. You don't write a PRD without first asking: What does good look like? How will we know if this worked? What's the leading indicator we'll track in week one versus month three? You use metrics to drive decisions, not simply report results.* You're AI-native, not AI-curious. You use AI tools regularly to accelerate your work — whether that's prototyping, exploring designs, analyzing feedback, drafting specifications, or building internal tools. You're resourceful and don't wait for perfect conditions to make progress.* You have a bias for action. You prioritize execution over perfection, move quickly from discovery to delivery, and take full ownership of both outcomes and setbacks.* You communicate with clarity at every level. Whether you're speaking with customers, engineers, Sales, or the founding team, you can articulate the problem, explain your reasoning, and align people around a clear direction.* You thrive in a high-ownership environment. We're building an ambitious company together. You take initiative, embrace responsibility, and step up when it matters.## What You'll Own* Own the vision and strategy for your product area. Take end-to-end responsibility for one or two of Suppli's core products. Understand the customer, define the product vision, build and prioritize the roadmap, and drive meaningful business outcomes. You'll have significant autonomy while partnering closely with our Head of Product on broader company priorities.* Define what success looks like. Establish clear success metrics, leading indicators, and measurable outcomes for your initiatives. Make sure Engineering and stakeholders understand why we're building something and how we'll know whether it worked.* Turn customer problems into product direction. Conduct user interviews, analyze customer feedback, and identify opportunities to solve high-impact problems. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into clear priorities and actionable product decisions.* Drive execution from concept to launch. Own the entire product development lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through scoping, development, release, and iteration. Work closely with Engineering and Design to ship high-quality customer-facing software.* Prototype before you spec. Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Lovable to explore concepts, validate hypotheses, and communicate product ideas. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable using modern tools to move faster.* Build a culture of measurement and experimentation. Partner with Engineering to instrument product analytics, define meaningful dashboards, and establish feedback loops. Use A/B testing, phased rollouts, and other experimentation methods where appropriate to validate assumptions and improve outcomes.* Shape exceptional product experiences. Work closely with Design to create intuitive, polished experiences for complex B2B workflows. Bring strong product design judgment and be comfortable developing flows, wireframes, or prototypes when needed.* Identify opportunities for AI-native product development. Collaborate with Engineering to explore how AI, automation, and intelligent workflows can create real value for customers. Balance innovation with reliability, explainability, and trust.* Be the connective tissue across the business. Partner directly with our Head of Product, founders, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success. Bring customer and commercial context into product decisions, communicate tradeoffs, and keep teams aligned around the highest-impact work.## Must-Have* 5+ years of product management experience, including experience in a startup or high-growth technology environment.* Demonstrated end-to-end product ownership — you've independently owned meaningful product initiatives from problem discovery and strategy through execution, launch, and measurable impact.* Strong analytical thinking and product judgment — you can break down complex problems, define success metrics, evaluate tradeoffs, and make evidence-based decisions.* Proven ability to ship customer-facing software — you have a track record of working closely with engineers and designers to deliver high-quality products.* Demonstrable AI-native workflow — you can show how you've used AI tools to prototype, analyze, design, or accelerate your work.* Technical fluency — you understand APIs, integrations, data flows, and system architecture well enough to write precise requirements and collaborate credibly with Engineering.* Product design fluency — you have strong UX instincts and can contribute meaningfully to product flows, wireframes, and prototypes.* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — You can clearly articulate complex ideas, product decisions, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences. You're equally comfortable collaborating with engineers, engaging directly with customers, and aligning senior leadership around a shared product vision.* Comfort operating with autonomy and ambiguity — you're resourceful, proactive, and capable of driving outcomes without extensive oversight.## Bonus Points* Engineering, Computer Science, or Product Design background — you've previously worked as an engineer, designer, or in another technical product-building capacity.* Founder or early-stage startup experience — you've built products or companies from the ground up and understand what it takes to operate with limited resources.* Accounts Receivable / Finance exposure — experience with invoicing, payments, cash application, credit workflows, or adjacent financial software.* Experience with AI-powered products — you've shipped LLM-powered features, automation, or intelligent workflows and understand the practical challenges of building reliable AI experiences.* Fintech or B2B marketplace background — experience navigating complex integrations, multi-stakeholder environments, or financial workflows.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As the Sr. Director, RevOps AMER, you are the most senior Revenue Operations leader for the Americas business, and a critical executive stakeholder. Reporting directly to the Vice President, Revenue Operations & Data Intelligence, you will serve as the primary strategic architect and operational co-pilot to the SVP of Sales AMER. You will own the operating engine and the predictability behind the AMER number. You are responsible for the end-to-end design of the AMER go-to-market (GTM) engine, translating global strategy into regional execution while scaling a high-performance operations team. You will bring a proven track record of designing regional operating models that scale and predictable quarterly outcomes. You are an expert at building deep, influential relationships at the executive level and possess the analytical rigor to turn complex data into competitive advantage.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Strategic Partnership: Partner with the AMER SVP to shape and execute the regional sales strategy. Own the predictability of the business and the operating plan behind the financial targets; the SVP retains accountability for attainment.
  • Annual Operating Leadership: Own the AMER Annual Operating Plan (AOP). Lead the design and operationalization of GTM structures, including complex territory design, headcount optimization, booking targets, and regional pricing/discounting strategy.
  • Forecast Leadership: Lead the AMER forecasting cadence with clear accountability. Beyond data collection, you will provide executive-level synthesis on pipeline viability, risk mitigation, and "the story behind the numbers" to Global Leadership.
  • Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing AMER Operations team. You are responsible for the hiring, development, and performance of the regional RevOps team.
  • Operational Governance: Establish and run the regional operational cadence (QBRs, Weekly Forecasts, Pipeline Inspections). Define the KPIs that matter and ensure the leadership team is aligned on corrective actions.
  • Business Transformation: Proactively identify systemic friction in the AMER business. Design and execute performance-improvement strategies in partnership with Sales leadership, ensuring the region scales ahead of the curve.
  • Regional Advocacy: Serve as the primary voice for AMER within the Global Revenue Operations organization, ensuring regional requirements influence the global systems and process roadmap.
  • AI Adoption: Drive adoption of AI tools within the Sales Organization. Identify, prioritize and support practical AI use cases in forecast preparation, pipeline analysis and management, rep productivity, and territory design.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Experience: 12+ years in Revenue/Sales Operations; prior direct management experience a plus.
  • Proven Scale: Significant experience as the Head of AMER Operations (or equivalent, such as a regional or segment RevOps leader) in a high-growth, SaaS organization.
  • Financial Acumen: Deep expertise in enterprise sales models, multi-channel distribution, and complex financial modeling.
  • Executive Influence: A proven ability to influence at the SVP and EVP level, serving as a trusted partner to Sales leadership during periods of rapid scale or transition.
  • Technical Mastery: Expert-level command of the RevOps tech stack (SFDC, Clari/Gong, etc.) and its application in driving sales behavioral change.
  • Strategic Versatility: A unique ability to pivot from 30,000-foot strategy to "in-the-trenches" deal execution and system troubleshooting.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a business or technology discipline; MBA or equivalent executive experience preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

About the Job:

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager, EMEA to be the go-to operator for our EMEA GTM team. This is a high-impact, highly visible role for someone who wants to shape how a growing region runs, from the first marketing touch to the closed deal and beyond.
You'll join our GTM Operations team as the face of operations in EMEA, partnering day-to day with Marketing, SDR, Sales, Solution Engineering, and Customer Success leaders across the lifecycle. You'll turn strategy into the processes, cadences, and insights that move the number. And you won't build alone: a global RevOps team stands behind you with builders and enablement teams to give you the foundation to develop what you design, and enablement to help teach your stakeholders how to be successful.
As we build in-region Field Operations coverage, you'll set the playbook for how LaunchDarkly runs in EMEA, and you'll see your impact within your first 90 days, not your first year. If you're a business partner at heart who loves turning ambiguity into rhythm and results, this role is for you.

Why This Role Matters:

  • High Impact: You'll own the rituals that make EMEA pipeline and forecasting trustworthy, with a direct line to revenue in one of our key regions. Support EMEA in bringing forecast accuracy within +/- 5% accurate.
  • Strategic Influence: Be the voice of EMEA inside GTM Operations and a trusted partner to regional GTM leadership
  • Break New Ground: Help build in-region operations coverage and set the operating playbook for the region
  • Career Growth: Gain exposure across the full GTM lifecycle, from Marketing and Sales to Customer Success, at a high-growth B2B company
  • Regional Playbooks: Adapt global plays for land, expand, and renewals. Track how playbooks drive conversion and optimize over time.

Responsibilities:

  • Business Partnership: Serve as the named operations partner for EMEA's Marketing, Sales & Customer Success leaders. Join their operating meetings, know their number, pipeline, and top risks, and bring insight before you're asked.
  • First Line of Defense: Own intake for EMEA field requests. Answer, route to the right operations team, or escalate, so the field never needs to navigate our org chart.
  • Operating Cadence: Run the EMEA forecast, pipeline, and business review cadence. Inspect pipe hygiene with leaders so each forecast is based on clean data, and each meeting ends in strong data-driven decisions, not updates.
  • Strategy -> Process: Apply our global processes, handoffs, and rules of engagement in EMEA. Own the regional variants and keep them documented.
  • Actionable Insights: Use standard data to find what drives the pipeline, understand what becomes a win, help leaders understand their teams. Recommend the change and see it through.
  • Planning Inputs: Bring what the field knows (territory health, ramp, pipe coverage, and in-market demand generation) to Planning and FP&A so EMEA plans reflect realistic expectations.
  • Adoption & Accountability: Partner with Enablement on new motions and launches, then inspect adoption through the cadence and close the gaps.
  • Voice of the Field: Bring EMEA priorities into operational planning and partner with Systems teams to define clear business requirements.

About You:

  • You are a business partner first who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and operations.
  • You're fluent in the language of pipeline and forecasting, but just as comfortable sitting with a rep as with a VP.
  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks, and you hold yourself to a high bar.
  • You move fast with an 80/20 mindset, and you can look at a process you built and say "this isn't working" without defensiveness.
  • You know how to influence without authority, and you build relationships before you push for change.
  • You stay curious, embrace feedback, and keep looking for ways to level up yourself and those around you.
  • You’re energized by working across multiple EMEA markets, and you keep a global team aligned from a different time zone.

Qualifications:

  • Typically requires 8 years of experience, or equivalent depth of expertise, in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or a related GTM operations role
  • Experience supporting EMEA GTM teams, ideally in a regional-focused capacity
  • Proven experience running forecast, pipeline, and business review cadences with senior GTM leaders
  • Strong working knowledge of the full GTM lifecycle, including lead management, pipeline generation, sales stages, and customer handoffs
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience, with the ability to write clear business requirements for systems product owners and developers
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Experience at a B2B SaaS or high-growth tech company
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority
  • Experience with GTM tools like Salesforce, Gong, Looker, Outreach, Cognism

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

## Senior Product ManagerAustin, TX or Remote (US) | Full-time | Salary + Equity## About the RoleThis is one of the most important hires at Suppli. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who wants the autonomy and impact of a founding product role, with direct ownership of one or two of our core products.You won't just manage a roadmap — you'll define the vision and strategy for your product area, establish what success looks like, and own execution from customer discovery through launch and iteration. You'll work closely with our Head of Product, founders, engineers, and commercial teams to solve meaningful problems for our customers.We're a fast-moving company with an ambitious engineering team. We need someone who can turn customer insights and business opportunities into clear product direction, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and give engineers the context they need to build exceptional software.We're looking for someone who thinks in outcomes, moves fast, and uses AI not as a buzzword but as a daily multiplier — to prototype, design, analyze, and build.---## Who Thrives Here* You think like an owner, not a feature manager. You're comfortable taking responsibility for an entire product area — from understanding customer problems and setting priorities to defining the roadmap and delivering measurable results. You don't need someone telling you what to build next.* You can move from idea to prototype quickly. When you have a product hypothesis, you find ways to validate it before committing significant engineering resources. Whether that's a clickable flow, an AI-assisted prototype, or a functional proof of concept, you make ideas tangible.* You're analytical and decisive. You break down ambiguous problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and make decisions grounded in customer insights, data, and business impact. You know when to investigate further and when to move.* You define success before you build anything. You don't write a PRD without first asking: What does good look like? How will we know if this worked? What's the leading indicator we'll track in week one versus month three? You use metrics to drive decisions, not simply report results.* You're AI-native, not AI-curious. You use AI tools regularly to accelerate your work — whether that's prototyping, exploring designs, analyzing feedback, drafting specifications, or building internal tools. You're resourceful and don't wait for perfect conditions to make progress.* You have a bias for action. You prioritize execution over perfection, move quickly from discovery to delivery, and take full ownership of both outcomes and setbacks.* You communicate with clarity at every level. Whether you're speaking with customers, engineers, Sales, or the founding team, you can articulate the problem, explain your reasoning, and align people around a clear direction.* You thrive in a high-ownership environment. We're building an ambitious company together. You take initiative, embrace responsibility, and step up when it matters.## What You'll Own* Own the vision and strategy for your product area. Take end-to-end responsibility for one or two of Suppli's core products. Understand the customer, define the product vision, build and prioritize the roadmap, and drive meaningful business outcomes. You'll have significant autonomy while partnering closely with our Head of Product on broader company priorities.* Define what success looks like. Establish clear success metrics, leading indicators, and measurable outcomes for your initiatives. Make sure Engineering and stakeholders understand why we're building something and how we'll know whether it worked.* Turn customer problems into product direction. Conduct user interviews, analyze customer feedback, and identify opportunities to solve high-impact problems. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into clear priorities and actionable product decisions.* Drive execution from concept to launch. Own the entire product development lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through scoping, development, release, and iteration. Work closely with Engineering and Design to ship high-quality customer-facing software.* Prototype before you spec. Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Lovable to explore concepts, validate hypotheses, and communicate product ideas. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable using modern tools to move faster.* Build a culture of measurement and experimentation. Partner with Engineering to instrument product analytics, define meaningful dashboards, and establish feedback loops. Use A/B testing, phased rollouts, and other experimentation methods where appropriate to validate assumptions and improve outcomes.* Shape exceptional product experiences. Work closely with Design to create intuitive, polished experiences for complex B2B workflows. Bring strong product design judgment and be comfortable developing flows, wireframes, or prototypes when needed.* Identify opportunities for AI-native product development. Collaborate with Engineering to explore how AI, automation, and intelligent workflows can create real value for customers. Balance innovation with reliability, explainability, and trust.* Be the connective tissue across the business. Partner directly with our Head of Product, founders, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success. Bring customer and commercial context into product decisions, communicate tradeoffs, and keep teams aligned around the highest-impact work.## Must-Have* 5+ years of product management experience, including experience in a startup or high-growth technology environment.* Demonstrated end-to-end product ownership — you've independently owned meaningful product initiatives from problem discovery and strategy through execution, launch, and measurable impact.* Strong analytical thinking and product judgment — you can break down complex problems, define success metrics, evaluate tradeoffs, and make evidence-based decisions.* Proven ability to ship customer-facing software — you have a track record of working closely with engineers and designers to deliver high-quality products.* Demonstrable AI-native workflow — you can show how you've used AI tools to prototype, analyze, design, or accelerate your work.* Technical fluency — you understand APIs, integrations, data flows, and system architecture well enough to write precise requirements and collaborate credibly with Engineering.* Product design fluency — you have strong UX instincts and can contribute meaningfully to product flows, wireframes, and prototypes.* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — You can clearly articulate complex ideas, product decisions, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences. You're equally comfortable collaborating with engineers, engaging directly with customers, and aligning senior leadership around a shared product vision.* Comfort operating with autonomy and ambiguity — you're resourceful, proactive, and capable of driving outcomes without extensive oversight.## Bonus Points* Engineering, Computer Science, or Product Design background — you've previously worked as an engineer, designer, or in another technical product-building capacity.* Founder or early-stage startup experience — you've built products or companies from the ground up and understand what it takes to operate with limited resources.* Accounts Receivable / Finance exposure — experience with invoicing, payments, cash application, credit workflows, or adjacent financial software.* Experience with AI-powered products — you've shipped LLM-powered features, automation, or intelligent workflows and understand the practical challenges of building reliable AI experiences.* Fintech or B2B marketplace background — experience navigating complex integrations, multi-stakeholder environments, or financial workflows.

Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.

The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

This role is heavily centred around Snowflake architecture, data modelling, customer identity, segmentation, and enabling downstream tools such as Braze, Hightouch, and CDPs.

You’ll play a key role in helping clients turn fragmented customer data into actionable insights and scalable engagement strategies.

Desirable

  • Experience working with loyalty, retail, QSR, financial services, or subscription customer datasets

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work

ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. Description

About the Role

The Salesforce Administrator owns and optimizes our Salesforce platform — a mature, heavily automated environment spanning Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. You will manage significant custom configuration, a body of existing legacy automation, and numerous critical integrations (NetSuite, marketing automation, e-signature, telephony, and more).

This is a hands-on role for a skilled administrator who can configure declaratively, keep our integration ecosystem healthy, and translate cross-functional business needs into reliable, scalable solutions. We actively manage and extend this org using AI-assisted tooling (including Claude Code), so we are especially interested in someone who already leverages AI to streamline administration or is genuinely driven to work in an AI-forward setup.

Key Responsibilities

System Administration & Security

  • Serve as the primary system administrator for Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
  • Manage user lifecycle, roles, profiles, permission sets, field-level security, and sharing rules.
  • Support end users with troubleshooting, training, and documentation to drive adoption across departments.

Automation & Process Modernization

  • Design, build, and maintain complex declarative automation using Salesforce Flow (record-triggered, screen, scheduled, and HTTP callout flows).
  • Audit, rationalize, and retire legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builders into clean, maintainable Flows.
  • Administer Service Cloud processes, including Case assignment rules, queue management, and automated offboarding cases tied to client cancellations.

Integrations & Ecosystem Management

  • Own and maintain integrations across connected platforms, including NetSuite (via Celigo / ), GoHighLevel, PDF Butler (e-signature/doc-gen), Dialpad, Apollo, HubSpot (sunset phase), and Outlook/Teams sync.
  • Configure and support custom API- and webhook-based integrations to ensure uninterrupted data flow across systems.

Deployments, Data Hygiene & Analytics

  • Manage deployments across sandboxes and production using the Metadata API, Salesforce CLI, or Change Sets, troubleshooting test-coverage and deployment failures.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards supporting pipeline, subscription-revenue metrics (MRR, ARR, churn), and operational decision-making.
  • Ensure data hygiene through validation rules, deduplication, and regular audits (e.g., lead-source completeness, duplicate resolution).

AI & Innovation

  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT) to accelerate Flow design, formula building, metadata analysis, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Stay current on Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to propose continuous system improvements.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience: 8 years of dedicated experience as a Salesforce Administrator in a complex, heavily automated environment. Experience in healthcare, marketing, or agency/managed services environments is a strong plus.
  • Certifications:Salesforce Administrator certification required. Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Platform Developer I (PDI) strongly preferred.
  • Core Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Salesforce data model, security architecture, and Flow Builder (including HTTP callouts and complex sub-flows).
  • Cloud Knowledge: Hands-on administration experience across both Sales Cloud and Service Cloud (Case management).
  • Integrations: Experience owning third-party and custom integrations, including middleware/iPaaS (e.g., Celigo / ) and REST/Webhook syncs. Experience with NetSuite or marketing tech stacks is a major advantage.
  • Analytics: Strong proficiency with custom report types, bucket fields, and dashboards; comfort with SaaS metrics (MRR/ARR/churn) preferred.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

2. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate for this specific setup fits the "Technical Modernizer" persona:

  1. The Flow Architect: They don't just "know" Flow; they understand architectural patterns (one Flow per object per event, sub-flows, fault paths) and are comfortable deprecating legacy Process Builders without breaking downstream logic.
  2. The Integration Specialist: They aren't intimidated by API error logs, webhook payload mismatches, or Celigo flow errors between Salesforce and NetSuite. They can trace data failures across system boundaries independently.
  3. The AI-Augmented Admin: They actively use AI tools (Claude Code, LLMs) to draft formulas, analyze SOQL/XML metadata, or generate test cases 2–3x faster than traditional manual admins.

# Shift Time will be 6.30 PM to 3.30 AM IST (+/ - 1HRS )
