Overview

Amyx is seeking a senior Program Manager / Program Director to lead execution of the DHS Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction (CWMD) Advisory & Assistance Services (A&AS) contract. This role is accountable for full lifecycle program management across a complex, multi‑stakeholder federal enterprise environment, delivering programmatic, analytical, technical, and advisory support to CWMD leadership and its successor organizations. The ideal candidate brings deep DHS and/or CWMD mission experience, proven success managing large, integrated A&AS portfolios, and the ability to operate effectively during organizational transition and restructuring. This role functions as the senior interface between Amyx, Government program leadership, CORs, and mission partners while ensuring delivery excellence, compliance, and cost control in a highly scrutinized federal environment.

Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Contract Execution

*Serve as the single point of accountability for overall contract performance, including scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk.*Lead day‑to‑day execution of A&AS task areas, including program management, systems engineering support, information analysis, reporting, outreach, and scientific/technical advisory services.*Direct and integrate multidisciplinary teams supporting CWMD mission areas, including CBRN threat analysis, risk assessments, partner engagement, and capability gap analysis.

Government Engagement & Stakeholder Management*Act as primary liaison with DHS CWMD leadership, CORs, Government PMs, and senior stakeholders across DHS components and interagency partners.*Facilitate recurring Monthly Status Reports, Quarterly IPRs, executive briefings, and ad hoc decision support sessions.*Support Government leadership during organizational restructuring and mission realignment, maintaining continuity of advisory support and delivery.

Financial & Performance Management*Manage program budgets, burn rates, and forecasting in alignment with Firm‑Fixed‑Price (FFP) or hybrid contract models.*Track and report contract metrics, SLAs, risks, and issues; implement mitigation strategies to safeguard performance and compliance.*Ensure program execution aligns with LPTA or cost‑sensitive acquisition environments, emphasizing productivity, automation, and efficiency.

Workforce & Team Management*Lead, mentor, and retain a high‑performing team of Program Managers, Task Leads, SMEs, analysts, and support staff.*Ensure proper staffing coverage, onboarding, training, and knowledge transfer across all task areas.*Foster a culture of accountability, mission focus, and proactive problem solving.

Process Improvement & Automation*Identify opportunities to automate reporting, analytics, workflow tracking, and performance monitoring to reduce cost and improve decision timeliness.*Apply continuous improvement practices (e.g., Lean, Agile, Six Sigma‑inspired approaches) to improve delivery efficiency without sacrificing quality.*Drive standardization of artifacts, dashboards, and reporting across the CWMD portfolio.

Compliance & Risk Management*Ensure compliance with DHS contractual, security, privacy, records management, and quality standards.*Oversee internal quality assurance processes aligned with ISO/CMMI‑based practices where applicable.*Proactively manage program risks and issues, escalating when necessary with clear recommendations.

Qualifications

*15+ years of progressively responsible experience in federal programs, including 10+ years in program or portfolio‑level management.*Demonstrated experience managing large A&AS‑style contracts ($50M+ total value preferred) for DHS, DoD, or IC customers.*Direct experience supporting CWMD, CBRN, homeland security, intelligence analysis, threat analysis, or risk assessment missions.*Proven ability to operate effectively in complex, evolving organizational environments, including Government reorganizations.*Strong working knowledge of federal acquisition environments, COR interactions, and performance‑based contract delivery.*Excellent executive communication skills (written and verbal), with experience briefing SES‑level leadership

*Prior experience supporting DHS CWMD, CISA, CBP, TSA, DTRA, or related national security mission sets.*Experience managing contracts during agency transitions or mission realignment.*Familiarity with analytics, dashboards, and performance metrics* used to support executive decision‑making.*Experience leading multi‑prime or subcontractor teams.*PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program management certification.*Lean Six Sigma, Agile, or change‑management certifications.*DHS Suitability Clearance

raw.description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at .

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is looking for a Fertility Medical Expert (RN, NP, or PA) to join our Medical Experts team on a contract basis for approximately a 3-month engagement, working a minimum 15 hours per week in a fully remote role. In this role, you will serve as a clinical resource for members navigating fertility and family-building, providing evidence-informed information and guidance that helps people understand their options and make confident, informed choices.

Day to day, you will meet with members by video to talk through their fertility questions and goals, offering clear, practical information without diagnosing, prescribing, or directing care..

This is a chance to put your fertility experience to work in a fast-growing digital health environment, with the flexibility of a contract schedule. You will work alongside a diverse team of medical experts across fertility, pregnancy, urology, mental health, and nutrition who share a passion for continuous learning and an evidence-based approach.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Provide members with evidence-informed information and guidance on fertility topics, such as fertility evaluation and testing, treatment options, and family-building pathways
  • Conduct one-on-one virtual sessions (video) that educate and present options without diagnosing, prescribing, or directing care
  • Stay current on reproductive and fertility regulatory trends and clinical practice guidelines in the US
  • Participate in quality assurance initiatives and audits to help ensure a safe, compliant member experience that meets the highest standards
  • Collaborate with the broader Medical Experts team and cross-functional partners to deliver a consistent, high-quality member experience
  • Maintain a reliable, flexible schedule within ~15 hours per week range to meet member demand throughout the engagement

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 30 Days, you will have:

  • Delivered consistently high-quality, well-rated fertility sessions that help members feel informed and supported
  • Stayed within Carrot’s non-diagnostic, non-directive scope of practice and met documentation and quality standards across member interactions
  • Met your agreed weekly hours and availability, communicating proactively about scheduling and capacity
  • Ramped up quickly and worked independently with minimal oversight in a confidential, remote environment
  • Built trusted working relationships with the Medical Experts team and cross-functional partners

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • An active US license as a Registered Nurse (RN), Nurse Practitioner (NP), or Physician Assistant (PA)
  • 3+ years of experience providing patient care in a fertility clinic or a hospital clinic that addresses reproductive health
  • Superb listening skills and the ability to empathetically discuss fertility and family-building topics
  • The ability to work independently and to distinguish good clinical judgment from non-directive guidance
  • The ability to work from a confidential and private remote environment with reliable internet and digital resources
  • Flexibility to adapt to evolving business needs and availability for 15 per week for a 3-month engagement

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in third-party reproduction (e.g., gestational surrogacy, donor gametes), urology, pregnancy, or menopause
  • Experience in digital health or telehealth settings, including virtual member or patient education
  • Prior contract or consulting experience with a quick ramp-up
  • Fluency in an additional language

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Fertility journeys are deeply personal, and members often arrive with more questions than answers. As a Fertility Medical Expert, you will be the knowledgeable, compassionate clinical voice who helps them understand their options and feel prepared for the conversations they have with their own care teams.

Your expertise helps make Carrot’s clinical program one that members trust and rely on, and it strengthens the confidence of the employers and health plans who count on Carrot to deliver high-quality, whole-person care. Even in a focused 3-month engagement, your work will make a direct, visible difference for the people we serve.

Interview Process 🤝

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  • Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  • Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
  • Mock Chat- 45 Minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation 💰

The starting base hourly for this position will range from $70-$90/hr. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to:

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

raw.description:
Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

Analytics Engineer

We’re hiring Analytics Engineers to join Convene Hospitality Group’s (CHG) Technology organization. We’re building out the foundational platform to democratize data at CHG so that a venue GM, a finance lead, and an AI agent are all able to ask a question and get the same trusted answer.

Analytics engineers own the full path from ingestion to visualization, including governance and observability. You’ll bring data in from source systems, model it through bronze, silver, and gold, define the semantic layer, and breathe life into the visualizations, conversational analytics, and business agents that teams rely on to make decisions.

You’ll join the Data Platform team, reporting to its Engineering Manager, and work closely with other analytics engineers and business partners across the company. You’ll build on Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran, using Snowflake-native capabilities like semantic views and Cortex to power ThoughtSpot and beyond.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with the business. Work with Finance, Sales, Operations, and venue teams to understand their needs and turn them into models and metrics they trust.
  • Own ingestion for your domains. Set up and maintain Fivetran connectors, land data in bronze, and handle schema drift and load failures.
  • Model the business. Build dbt models that move data through bronze, silver, and gold, and shape gold around how CHG runs so people outside the data team can understand and use it.
  • Own the semantic layer. Set metrics, dimensions, and relationships so a number means the same thing in a dashboard, a search, or an agent’s answer. Tune synonyms and descriptions so a model picks the right measure, trace wrong answers to the root cause, and help us decide where each definition lives.
  • Power self-service in ThoughtSpot. Build the models and Liveboards that let teams explore data on their own, and turn the questions people actually ask into new test cases.
  • Own the quality of conversational analytics. Test answers the way you’d test code. Build and maintain a golden question set of real business questions paired with certified answers as your test cases, run them as a regression suite on every model or semantic change, and block releases that fail. Back your models with dbt tests and clear documentation.
  • Apply governance day to day. Tag sensitive data at ingestion, apply access controls such as tag-based masking and row access policies, and follow the standards the team sets, so an agent only returns what the person asking is allowed to see.
  • Keep it fast and fresh. Monitor freshness, data quality, and pipeline health so problems surface to you before they reach a dashboard or an agent’s answer. Tune query and model performance, from incremental dbt models to warehouse sizing, so answers come back fast and Snowflake costs stay in check.
  • Work AI-native. Lead with specs, then hand agents end-to-end tasks, from exploring source data to building models, tests, and documentation. Let agents run loose in the wild (with some guardrails in place). You hold agent and human work to the same review bar, so code from Claude and code from a teammate get the same scrutiny. Share what you learn, and help set the playbook for agentic data work.

What We Look For:

  • You have 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development, building data products people rely on.
  • You write strong SQL and have built and maintained dbt models in production.
  • You’ve worked in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake.
  • You’ve worked with ELT ingestion tools like Fivetran and can troubleshoot source-data issues such as schema changes, late-arriving data, and API limits.
  • You understand data modeling: dimensional models, medallion layering, and clear reasoning about grain, slowly changing dimensions, and event lifecycles.
  • You’ve built dashboards or self-service data products that people use to make decisions.
  • You test and document your work as a habit.
  • You’re curious about the business. You ask what decision a request supports before you start building.
  • You use AI agents for real multi-step work, like writing SQL and dbt models, generating tests, and drafting documentation, and you verify what they produce.
  • You explain your work clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
  • You take ownership. You see work through, ask for help when you’re stuck, and look for ways to make things better.

Bonus Points

  • You’ve evaluated LLM or natural-language analytics output, for example with golden sets or regression testing.
  • You’ve worked in hospitality, events, real estate, or another customer-centric, multi-location business.

Marketing Intern

At a glance: Fully remote · Must live in AL, CO, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, LA, MA, MI, MN, NC, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WA, or WI · Pay: $18.00 per hour · Maximum hours per week: 24 · January 19th, 2027 - April 9th, 2027

The impact of this role

The AMA Marketing Team is looking for an intern who is excited to learn more about lifecycle marketing, content marketing, and membership marketing! Work with the senior leaders on the marketing team to learn how to use core marketing ops tools like HubSpot, WordPress, and more. This role will support Membership, Certification, and content initiatives that are integral to AMA's overall marketing strategy. This intern will leave with an understanding of how all the sections of our in-house marketing team work together to support multiple products and business lines.

What you'll do

  • Building content/article pages on the new website
  • Certification messaging audit and revamp
  • Completing the manual activation for free memberships from events (like Content Marketing World)
  • Create, execute, and analyze survey information
  • Plan, design, and execute promotional campaigns

What you bring

  • A current Junior or Senior studying Marketing
  • Being comfortable with a variety of tools or the ability to not be phased by learning new tools (we use WordPress, HubSpot, Qualtrics, Salesforce, Payload)
  • Fundamental knowledge of Marketing
  • Understanding of marketing funnels and personas
  • Copywriting experience for a public-facing audience

What you may also have

  • Any prior experience working on customer journeys would be helpful, but not necessarily required

Why the AMA

The AMA is the essential community for marketers, from students to executives to academics. Through our five scholarly journals, conferences, PCM® certification, 70 regional chapters, and presence on 350 college campuses, we help the profession learn, grow, and make a lasting impact. The AMA Foundation (AMAF) strengthens and elevates the marketing profession by advancing knowledge, building a global community of marketing leaders, and supporting marketing initiatives that drive innovation and societal impact. Want to learn more about AMA? Check out our website.

What it's like here

  • Fridays are ours. No internal meetings after 12 pm. Use that time to catch up, explore learning and development, or whatever you need to avoid the Sunday Scaries!
  • Remote, but not alone. Teammates in 20+ states, annual team member summit in Chicago, monthly town halls, and lots of cross-team collaboration.
  • Recognition is built in.Our Bucketlist rewards program enables gratitude in tangible form!
  • Growth: Free AMA membership, professional development content, and the PCM® Marketing Manager certification exam
  • Flexibility: We know you may have a balance of classes and this internship. We offer flexibility with your schedule.

How we hire

  1. Resume review by our recruiter and the hiring manager. A person reads your resume; AMA never uses AI to screen candidates.
  2. One-way video interview (Spark Hire): Five (5) questions, about 15-20 minutes, unlimited think time. We promise it isn't scary. We wrote the questions carefully because we want your answers to be just as thoughtful. Our recruiter is the face you’ll see asking the questions. No robots here.
  3. 30-minute phone interview with a member of the People and Culture team.
  4. Virtual interview with the hiring manager and the stakeholders you'll work with most.

We won’t leave you hanging. You will always hear from us within a week about the status of your application and status.

Please note that only applicants who apply officially will be considered in this process. We appreciate the candidates who apply and express interest, but we cannot circumvent the recruitment process for any candidates, regardless of their relationship to the AMA or our team members.

Eligibility

You must live in one of the states listed above. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without employer sponsorship. For internships, F1 visas are okay.

Equal opportunity

The American Marketing Association is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, reproductive health decisions, family responsibilities, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. AMA is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

It's a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!

About the role:

8am is looking for a Staff level Engineer to join our team of seasoned AI engineers who are delivering on the roadmap of AI features to enhance and expand our 8am suite of products. In this role, you will design and build AI-powered features that delight our customers, create new capabilities, and strengthen our platform. You will collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to bring cutting-edge AI into production, ensuring it drives meaningful business and customer outcomes.

About us:

At 8am, our vision is to power a world where professionals thrive. We start every day on a mission to empower professionals with the most trusted, innovative technology to deliver world-class outcomes for their clients and exceptional financial results for their business. They count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

Founded in 2005, 8am™ (formerly AffiniPay) is the professional business platform built to help legal, accounting, and other client-focused professionals run stronger, more profitable businesses. Today, more than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. trust 8am to help them work smarter, serve clients better, and unlock their full potential. We have been recognized as one of Inc 5000’s fastest growing companies in the U.S. for 13 years in a row, and as a result, our teams continue to grow as well!

What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate business problems into AI-driven solutions.
  • Design, implement, and integrate AI features into existing 8am products.
  • Partner with the Data team to ensure the right data is collected, enriched, prepared, and staged for AI consumption and use.
  • Build and evaluate AI-powered services, from customer-facing prototypes to general availability to all our customers.
  • Write high-quality Python code to manipulate data, interact with large language models, and assess performance.
  • Develop tools and infrastructure to support reliable, scalable, and secure AI deployment.
  • Work with our cloud operations team to deploy AI features, monitor their impact, and continuously improve them.

About you:

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally in full stack SaaS application development or backend.
  • Proven track record of building and deploying production-ready AI/ML services at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks, platforms, evals and related tooling.
  • Strong Python or equivalent modern tech stack development skills and familiarity with data manipulation and evaluation workflows.
  • Experience building scalable data infrastructure and integrating models into broader SaaS systems.
  • Experience working in AWS cloud environments, or equivalent and with modern DevOps practices.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, or drive innovation.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, or drive innovation.

Additional InformationThe annual salary range for this position is $150,000 to $190,000. The salary range for performing this role outside of the US / Austin / California may differ. 8am is committed to offering competitive, fair and commensurate compensation and has provided an estimated pay range for this role. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and education.Why 8am:

At 8am, our culture is shaped by the people who bring it to life every day. Together, we build a company rooted in continuous learning, genuine community, holistic wellness, and meaningful engagement—values that empower us as individuals and unite us as a team. Our culture is grounded in our core values: Work Smart, Win Fast; Outshine Ordinary, and We Find a Way. These values drive how we serve our customers and work with each other in a collaborative, inspiring, and empowering environment, every day.

Here’s how we support our 8Team:

  • Health Insurance Coverage: We offer our 8Team a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit your needs, including a 100% company-paid HDHP plan for employees.
  • Financial perks: We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package including annual bonuses, equity options and 401(k) or RRSP if in Canada, with a company match for all team members.
  • Time for what matters: Flexible Time Off, paid holidays, and a parental leave program for our new parents.
  • Wellness: Wellness stipends, mental health support, and one-on-one nutrition coaching.
  • Learning and Development: Continuous learning through , leadership programs, professional development funds, and individually focused talent development.
  • Giving back to the communities around us: Participate in our charitable matching gift program, paid time off for volunteer service, and company-sponsored volunteer events (both local and virtually).
  • Engagement: Virtual and in-person team-building events, quarterly award recognition through our Rise & Shine Award of Excellence Program, and our peer-to-peer appreciation platform.

At 8am, we don’t just offer benefits - we create an environment where people can thrive, grow, and make a real impact every day.

Diversity, equity & inclusion at 8am:

At 8am, we recognize that innovation occurs with a strong team of people who are diverse in background, personality, talent and ideas. Experience comes in many forms and ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we continue to learn from each other is an integral part of our culture. We are committed to creating a welcoming and transparent environment for all that embraces those differences through education, equal access to opportunities and information, inclusionary programs, and community outreach.

Security advisory:

Our hiring teams at 8am are dedicated to recruiting top talent that share our passion for serving the professional services industry through innovative financial technology. As such, our Talent Acquisition Team only follows legitimate hiring practices. We will always communicate with our candidates using emails with the 8am domain and will never ask for sensitive/personal data during the application process. All interviews take place over phone call, Zoom/Google Meet or in person. All offers are communicated verbally by our Talent Acquisition Specialists with a written offer letter as a follow up.

The AI Engineer is responsible for supporting engineering initiatives across the organization’s AI and Microsoft cloud environment, with a primary focus on Microsoft Copilot, AI agent creation, and the Cowork platform, including developing and maintaining Cowork skills, ensuring alignment between technical execution and business objectives. This role helps develop, test and support solutions while managing risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes across multiple initiatives. The AI Engineer contributes technical expertise to assigned initiatives while continuously improving skills and delivery effectiveness.

  • Supports engineering delivery across complex AI initiatives, ensuring alignment to business objectives and technical standards.
  • Supports delivery of AI solutions, including Microsoft Copilot experiences, AI agents, and Cowork skills, spanning design, development, testing, evaluation, and deployment.

  • Drives continuous improvement in AI engineering practices, tooling, prompt and evaluation workflows, and delivery processes.

  • Resolves technical and delivery issues while managing trade-offs and competing priorities, promoting a culture of collaboration, accountability, and high performance.

  • Proactively manages risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
  • Ensures quality, responsible-AI alignment, and alignment to business objectives.
  • Demonstrates sound judgment and problem-solving, and influences outcomes without authority.
  • Recognized as a go-to resource in the AI, Copilot, and agent-development domain.
  • Earns stakeholder trust and confidence.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, AI agent creation, and building and maintaining Cowork skills.

  • Understanding of the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages) and cloud platform (Azure) architecture, security, and scalability.

  • Ability to translate business needs into clear functional and technical AI solutions.
  • Skilled in managing risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and competing priorities across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust across technical and business teams.

The Role

We’re seeking a Financial Services Sales Manager in the UK to own and grow revenue across a defined set of verticalised accounts. This role is focused on selling into complex, multi-stakeholder environments with long sales cycles and high strategic value.

You will act as the orchestrator for your accounts driving executive alignment, building long-term account strategies, and positioning Vega as a foundational platform within the enterprise SOC.

﻿

What You’ll Do

  • Lead complex sales cycles involving CISOs, security operations leaders, platform teams, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
  • Position Vega as a strategic alternative to legacy SIEM and security analytics platforms, articulating ROI, cost reduction, and operational transformation at scale.
  • Build and execute account-specific strategies that combine direct sales motions with tightly aligned channel engagement.

  • Collaborate deeply with Sales Engineering to deliver enterprise-grade evaluations, pilots, and proof-of-value engagements.
  • Forecast accurately and manage complex pipelines in Salesforce, including multi-stakeholder deal tracking and executive close plans.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer, providing feedback to product and leadership teams to influence roadmap and go-to-market strategy.
  • Represent Vega in executive briefings, customer QBRs, and high-profile industry and partner events.

Requirements

﻿What You Will Bring

  • 7+ years of financial services, quota-carrying sales experience in cybersecurity or enterprise software.

raw.excerpt: As a Vision, Mission, and Driven company, VMD has been delivering information technology solutions to the Federal government in Agile Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Critical Infrastructure Protection since 2002.
raw.description:
As a Vision, Mission, and Driven company, VMD has been delivering information technology solutions to the Federal government in Agile Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Critical Infrastructure Protection since 2002. Our mission has now expanded, and we have merged with Xcelerate Solutions to revolutionize end-to-end enterprise security. Together we are committed to protecting our nation’s citizens, critical infrastructure, and resources.

Why Join VMD Corp?

At VMD, now a part of Xcelerate Solutions, you have the opportunity to thrive in your career and become a Game Changer. The quality and talent of our people is what drives our success. We embrace an employee-first culture and make it a priority to provide professional development opportunities that foster career growth.

We help protect American Citizens and the nation’s most critical infrastructure by working alongside our customers and delivering game changing solutions to strengthen their missions. We believe our passion and commitment to achieving our customers' goals and solve their most critical challenges defines who we are. We don’t just dream big, we act on it – through teamwork, dedication, and resilience.

About the Mission You Will Join:

You will be helping to transform and modernize the nation’s lawful systems and adjudication process. The portfolio of systems supports millions of applicants as go through Citizenship and VISA processing. This work is critical to securing the homeland and protecting the American people. The team you will be joining uses Agile and innovative practices to bring technical solutions to the USCIS mission.

Your Impact to the Mission:

The CI/CD Pipeline Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines that support enterprise application development and deployment. This role automates software build, testing, security scanning, artifact management, and deployment processes to improve release efficiency, software quality, system reliability, and security compliance.

The engineer works closely with application developers, cloud engineers, system administrators, cybersecurity personnel, and program leadership to implement automated DevSecOps practices across development, test, staging, and production environments. The position supports cloud-native applications, Java microservices, containerized workloads, and enterprise integration platforms while ensuring compliance with applicable security and configuration management requirements.

Key Responsibilities

CI/CD Pipeline Development and Automation

  • Design, develop, configure, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications and microservices, automated testing jobs, infrastructure builds, etc.
  • Implement and optimize build, unit testing, integration testing, code quality analysis, artifact publishing, and deployment workflows.
  • Develop reusable pipeline templates, shared libraries, deployment scripts, and automation components to standardize delivery processes.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures, build errors, deployment issues, and configuration inconsistencies.

DevSecOps and Security Integration

  • Integrate automated security testing, static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), container image scanning, and vulnerability assessments into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Enforce security gates, code quality thresholds, and approval requirements before software is promoted between environments.
  • Support remediation of security vulnerabilities, software dependencies, and container image findings.
  • Maintain pipeline configurations and deployment processes consistent with organizational security policies and applicable NIST SP 800-53, RMF, and federal cybersecurity requirements.
  • Support audit readiness through pipeline logs, deployment records, traceability, and documented release approvals.

Cloud, Containers, and Infrastructure Automation

  • Support containerized application deployments using Docker and Kubernetes, including Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS).
  • Integrate pipelines with cloud services, infrastructure automation, container registries, and environment configuration management.
  • Implement automated deployment strategies, including rolling deployments, blue-green deployments, and rollback procedures, as appropriate.
  • Collaborate with cloud and infrastructure teams to resolve environment, networking, access, and deployment issues.

Configuration Management and Release Support

  • Manage source control workflows, branching strategies, versioning, artifact repositories, and release tagging.
  • Implement environment promotion controls across development, test, staging, and production.
  • Maintain pipeline documentation, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical standards.
  • Monitor pipeline performance and identify opportunities to reduce deployment time, improve reliability, and increase automation.

Collaboration and Continuous Improvement

  • Work with cybersecurity, quality assurance, architecture, and operations teams to resolve delivery and compliance issues.
  • Provide technical guidance to developers on pipeline usage, deployment standards, and DevSecOps best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve software delivery performance, pipeline reuse, operational consistency, and release quality.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience as well as 10+ years total experience in the field.
  • Three or more years of experience developing, maintaining, or supporting CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation.
  • Demonstrated experience with one or more CI/CD platforms, such as Jenkins, Harness, GitLab CI/CD, or GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with source control systems, particularly Git.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Groovy.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, container registries, and automated application deployments.
  • Understanding of software build processes, automated testing, version control, release management, and configuration management.
  • Experience integrating code quality tools and automated security scanning into software delivery workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS cloud services and Amazon EKS.
  • Experience with Harness pipeline development, reusable templates, service and environment configuration, and deployment orchestration.
  • Familiarity with SonarQube, Twistlock/Prisma Cloud, or comparable code quality and security tools.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable technologies.
  • Familiarity with observability platforms such as New Relic, CloudWatch, or comparable monitoring solutions.
  • Experience supporting Java, REST APIs, and microservice architectures.
  • Experience supporting federal government IT programs and security compliance requirements, including NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and the Risk Management Framework (RMF).
  • Experience supporting production systems with stringent availability, auditability, and change-control requirements.

Performance Expectations

  • Deliver reliable, repeatable, and maintainable CI/CD pipelines that support timely and controlled software releases.
  • Increase automation and reduce manual intervention in software build, testing, security validation, and deployment activities.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline documentation and traceable deployment records.
  • Identify and resolve pipeline issues promptly to minimize development delays and production deployment risks.
  • Ensure security and quality controls are consistently applied throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Collaborate effectively with development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to meet program milestones and operational objectives.

Basic Qualifiers:

  • Education Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience as well as 10+ years total experience in the field.
  • Can Additional Years of Experience Substitute for Degree? No
  • Required Certification(s): None
  • Minimum Years of Specific Experience in Field: 10
  • Minimum Clearance to Start: Public Trust
  • Work Status Allowable: US Citizenship

Travel and Telecommuting:

  • Travel: None
  • Telecommute Options: Remote

Job Title: Digital Marketing Specialist (Social Media, Email Marketing & Lead Generation)

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to manage and execute our social media strategy, email marketing campaigns, and lead generation efforts. You will be responsible for growing our online presence, nurturing leads, and driving sign-ups for our online workshops focused on helping people overcome their fear of water.

The ideal candidate is highly creative, data-driven, and skilled in social media management, email marketing automation, and lead generation strategies.

1. Social Media Management & Content Creation

  • Develop and execute a content calendar focused on overcoming water fear, success stories, FAQs, and engaging posts.
  • Create and schedule 4 social media posts per week (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn).
  • Design and produce 3 short-form videos per week (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts).

  • Engage with followers by responding to comments, messages, and community interactions.

  • Create and manage promotional email campaigns for upcoming workshops and special offers.
  • Segment and clean email lists to ensure targeted messaging and high deliverability.
  • Perform A/B testing to optimize subject lines, email copy, and CTAs.

3. Lead Generation & CRM Management

  • Optimize landing pages to increase lead capture and conversion rates.
  • Track leads in a CRM system and implement an effective follow-up strategy.
  • Plan and run Facebook & Instagram ad campaigns (ad budget separate).
  • Generate leads organically through engagement in Facebook Groups, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Quora.

  • Proven experience in social media management, content creation, and engagement strategies.
  • Strong expertise in email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, ConvertKit, ActiveCampaign, etc.).
  • Knowledge of lead generation techniques (organic outreach & paid ads).
  • Basic video editing skills for creating short-form content.

  • Strong writing skills for crafting engaging social media captions, emails, and ad copy.
  • Experience using Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, or similar tools for tracking performance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in coaching, wellness, or swimming, education industries is a plus.
  • Familiarity with automation tools like Zapier, ClickFunnels, or HubSpot.
  • Prior experience working with online courses or coaching businesses.

Why this role

You’ll design our Evolver Experience Ecosystem, unifying our learning programs and culture initiatives into one connected experience. You’ll own talent and leadership development programs and New Evolver Onboarding, alongside our community and culture programming including Employee Resource Groups, CSR, and connection events.

This is a builder role, designed for a person who can own a project from ideation and design through delivery and measurement. You'll shape the strategy, put the systems in place, and facilitate in the room yourself.

If you’ve been waiting for a role that puts learning and culture in the same hands (and trusts you to build it!), this role is for you.

  • Engage Evolvers in the company’s Corporate Social Responsibility work through our signature Building Hospitality program.

What makes you a great fit

  • A confident facilitator who can engage any room, from tenured executives on a virtual call to new hires in our Denver office.

Annual base salary range: $125,000 - $135,000 depending on relevant experience.

Location

All Evolve team members must live in one of our approved locations by their first day. We can hire from anywhere in the U.S. except D.C. and Hawaii. Some positions may also have restrictions based on compensation in the following states: California, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Washington. If you live in Colorado, you can work remotely anywhere in the state, at our downtown Denver office, or a hybrid of both! If you're planning to move soon, please let us know, and we'll be happy to review your application again.

California Applicant Privacy Policy | Evolve

How we reward Evolvers

We’re intentional about offering benefits that empower every Evolver to thrive both professionally and personally because they’re more than perks—they’re investments in our customer-obsessed, high-performing team.

We believe in treating others as they want to be treated, providing benefits that deliver real value, and challenging the status quo to meet the diverse needs of our team. Whether it’s helping you take care of your health, plan for the future, or celebrate life’s milestones, our offerings are designed to support you every step of the way.

  • Financial Wellness: Industry-competitive pay, equity in the company, and a 401(k) with a 4% immediate vesting match.

Senior Elixir Engineerat Vic.ai Remote

Location: Remote

This is a fully remote position, full-time, with flexible working hours and work arrangements.

About Vic.ai

Vic.ai is creating the “Intelligent Accounting” era, using artificial intelligence to automate accounting and provide advisory, business insight, and eventually business foresight.

We’re a Series A stage start-up, founded by three Norwegian entrepreneurs and backed by renowned Silicon Valley investors (including Costanoa Ventures, Cowboy Ventures, and GGV Capital).

We’re US-based, but our team is global, from New Zealand to California. We’re bringing AI to Finance and Accounting because the industry is ripe for automation and big-data insight and the market is huge: $200B just in the US.

Our main office locations is in New York. We have a well established remote-work culture, and over 50% of our team are working fully remote.

We have a solid team of very experienced, yet humble, Elixir engineers, will you be our next team member?

About you

You’ve been a software engineer for 5+ years, but you’ve been a tinkerer and a builder your whole life. We’re a team of builders—when we aren’t building Vic.ai, we’re tinkering with a personal project, contributing to open source, modding a drone, building a computer from components, etc.

We’re looking for an experienced developer who enjoys working with server-side technologies. You possess a good mixture of DevOps and application development skills and would like to build innovative solutions with experienced teammates in a flexible environment.

You should have plenty of experience in building performant, easy to use, well-monitored, and well tested APIs, designing efficient data flows, communicating clearly, sharing knowledge, and questioning existing solutions.

You’re ready for the next step in your career, ready to take on fast-moving challenges. You’re enthusiastic about AI and the possibilities it opens for software development and transforming traditional work. You aim at reaching greatness and delivering exceptional outcomes in your work.

As a team player, you are not afraid of reaching out to your colleagues to discuss development challenges, especially when you are stuck trying to solve a specific issue.

You are fluent in English.

Job Requirements

  • Advanced Elixir programming experience is a must
  • Solid understanding of working in Linux shells
  • Ability to spin up servers, setting them up and make them available for application deploys
  • Having great understanding of the value of automated tests, and ability to implement them across the whole stack
  • Designing efficient deploy flows and continuous integration
  • Solid knowledge of key-value stores, SQL, and relational databases; preferably PostgreSQL
  • Ability to implement and maintain robust concurrent background job systems, having a grasp of concurrency patterns and message queues
  • Fluent English, spoken and written, clear and effective daily communication with the team

What you’ll do

  • Build and deploy high-uptime products and infrastructure as part of the Vic.ai platform
  • Integrate Elixir systems with non-uptime-critical systems in Python
  • Design and establish validation, testing, correctness, and resilience best practices across teams
  • Ship products and services as part of a small, collaborative team
  • Help establish engineering process, tools, and systems that will allow us to scale the code base, productivity, and the team

Who we're looking for:

  • BS (or higher) in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent technical experience
  • 5+ years of relevant work experience
  • Professional experience with Elixir programming language
  • Track record of shipping high-quality products and features
  • Ability to turn business needs into engineering solutions

As an early employee, you'll be working with a small team of committed and talented engineers and having a large, long-term impact on technical design and engineering culture.

We Offer

We're not just fully remote, we also offer

Competitive salary

Generous vacation time, family and travel-friendly environment
Work alongside an enthusiastic, collegial, and driven team in a highly meritocratic environment

Above all, you should enjoy the journey. Our engineers are creative, technical, smart, and genuinely like each other. They enjoy the work they do, and so should you!

Software Engineer III (Ruby on Rails)

Atlanta, GA preferred, Remote

At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 450 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

Overview

At PrizePicks, we are changing the game in daily fantasy sports. We are a passionate team of innovators dedicated to creating a best-in-class experience for our members. Our engineering team builds and scales the platform that powers our explosive growth — from real-time contest engines to the services that handle millions of daily transactions. We are looking for a Software Engineer III to join our Gamification team and help us continue to build the future of fantasy sports.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Software Engineer III with strong Ruby on Rails expertise to join our Gamification team. In this role, you will own feature development within Rails-based backend services that power PrizePicks’ core platform — including customer rewards, incentives and our loyalty program. You will own the delivery of complex work end-to-end, begin guiding junior engineers, and contribute to architectural decisions that shape your team’s systems. This is a role for someone who can break down hard problems, deliver high-quality solutions, and start having influence beyond their own code.

What You’ll Do

  • Own feature development: Take ownership of features end-to-end — from technical design through delivery — breaking complex projects into well-scoped, deliverable pieces.
  • Write high-quality code: Produce Ruby code that is idiomatic, performant, well-tested, and raises the bar for the codebase.
  • Contribute to architecture: Participate in team-level architectural decisions around data modeling, service boundaries, API design, and background processing patterns.
  • Improve quality proactively: Identify opportunities to improve code quality, performance, reliability, and developer experience — and act on them.
  • Guide junior engineers: Provide technical guidance to Software Engineers I and II through thorough code reviews, pairing sessions, and design feedback.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with Product, Design, and QA to validate technical decisions and ensure alignment between product goals and implementation.
  • Participate in on-call rotation: Take increasing ownership of incident response, contributing to root cause analysis and systemic improvements.
  • Build team knowledge: Document technical decisions, data models, and service patterns to strengthen your team’s shared understanding.

What You Have

Experience:

  • 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time building Ruby on Rails applications
  • History of delivering complex features within a software team to drive business outcomes
  • Experience breaking down ambiguous requirements into concrete technical plans
  • Exposure to large-scale, high-throughput distributed systems — you understand the challenges of building software that serves millions of users in real time

Technical Skills:

  • Advanced proficiency in Ruby on Rails — you understand the framework deeply and write clean, idiomatic, production-quality code
  • Strong PostgreSQL skills — schema design, query optimization, migrations, and understanding of performance characteristics at scale
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs within Rails
  • Solid testing practices — RSpec or Minitest, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing strategies
  • Familiarity with background job processing (Sidekiq or similar)
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows

Working Style:

  • Autonomous — you can take an ambiguous problem and drive it to a well-defined solution
  • Comfortable providing and receiving direct technical feedback
  • Strong written communicator, especially important in a fully remote environment
  • Able to balance deep technical work with collaborative design and planning

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools for coding, planning, and scoping work
  • Experience with agentic coding tools and AI-augmented development workflows
  • Prior experience working in a remote engineering organization
  • Prior experience with event-driven architecture

Where You’ll Live

While we prefer candidates based in Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates.

Working at PrizePicks

The typical salary range for this position is $145,000 to $155,000. At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you’ll be working when determining our salary ranges. The compensation info you see on our job postings gives you an idea of the starting pay range for the position. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter will be happy to chat more about the specific pay range for your location and how we arrived at it during the hiring process.

This application period will remain open for 30 days. We’re committed to finding the best candidate, so this date may be adjusted, and any changes will be reflected in this posting.

Benefits you’ll receive:

In addition to your great compensation package, full-time employees will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Company-subsidized medical, dental, & vision plans
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Annual bonus
  • Flexible PTO to encourage a healthy work/life balance (2 weeks STRONGLY encouraged!)
  • Generous paid leave programs, including 16-week paid parental leave and disability benefits
  • Workplace flexibility and modern work schedules focused on getting the job done, not hours clocked
  • Company-wide in-person events and team outings
  • Lifestyle enhancement program
  • Company equipment provided (Windows & Mac options)
  • Annual performance reviews with opportunities for growth and career development

You must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

The Case Manager is a professional external-facing role, which is responsible for oversight of cases throughout the authorization/approval journey for patients and their providers. This role relies on critical thinking skills to drive cases through complex communication, authorization, and appeal processes, with the primary focus of expediting patients’ access to care while securing payment channels to avoid unexpected out of pocket cost. This may involve interacting with private commercial or government-run insurers, healthcare providers, suppliers/distributors, and patients to ensure access across the care continuum.

Core Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Act as a single point of contact between the internal team, client, providers, payor, facility, and patient as needed.
  • Support cases through approval/denial process with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.
  • Collaborate and provide direction to the internal and external stakeholders (i.e., Payor Specialist Team, Reimbursement Team, Clinical Team, client sales/MSL) and coordinate efforts to ensure accuracy and completeness of each case.
  • Identify and share trends impacting business processes with management.
  • Prioritize and act on key client activities and follow up with customers to ensure problems are solved.
  • Manage through ambiguity while designing innovative client and payor solutions.
  • Make sound independent decisions in urgent and non- routine situations pertaining to client and patient scenarios.
  • Interpret complex clinical documentation to prepare authorization documentation for payor submission in relation to medical policy criteria for coverage.
  • Partner with the interdisciplinary team to champion their clients, patients, and customers, and is responsible for the life cycle of their case to ensure successful completion.
  • Provide resources to patients, caregivers, health care providers and clients with resources available for financial assistance and transportation.
  • Provide compassionate and empathetic support to patients and caregivers.

Skills / Requirements:

  • Maintains open, effective dialogue with effective communication and is both clear and thorough in reports, documentation, and other written communications.
  • High level of ability to coordinate multiple priorities and activities to accomplish goals.
  • Ability to independently manage case load, prioritize work, and use time management skills to manage deliverables.
  • Critical thinking and strong problem solving
  • Suggests creative ideas and innovative solutions while exploring multiple alternatives and approaches to overcome obstacles and find solutions.
  • Excellent follow-through with solid levels of determination and tenacity.
  • Remains calm and productive during transitions or changing circumstances.
  • Demonstrates composure and professionalism under difficult circumstances.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing with a focus on customer satisfaction, with empathy, drive, and commitment to exceptional service.
  • Possess a strong understanding of the US Healthcare System, public and private payer nuances, and patient access challenges for new to market, high dollar or highly complex medical interventions, products, therapies.
  • Ability to leverage professional expertise and apply company policies and procedures to resolve challenges.
  • Ability to develop, maintain and navigate relationships.
  • Ability to interpret and understand medical documentation as it relates to each specific case and how it applies to a specific medical policy.
  • Ability to be agile and adaptable in responses to rapidly changing processes and consumer needs.

Education, Certifications and Experience:

  • College Degree is preferred (Bachelor's or Associate Degree).
  • 4 – 6 years of experience in a healthcare setting and/or medical insurance background with a customer service focus.
  • Experience with maintaining detailed records of client interactions, services provided, and progress made.
  • Experience working in office, hospital/clinic or home health care settings welcome.
  • Experience in developing and/or implementing new technologies a plus.
  • Experience with complex medical products and associated insurance processes a plus.
  • Experience writing Appeals is preferred.

Physical Requirements:

  • As a remote-forward organization, this position operates in a professional office environment and teleworking from the employee’s home address listed in their employment file.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Keyboarding
  • Speaking
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
  • Working hours to support activities in multiple time zones.

Our PRO-spectus Culture Philosophy

At PRO-spectus we have created a culture that is supportive, dedicated, and teamwork driven. We celebrate each other’s joys in personal life and professional accomplishments, promoting meaningful relationships and friendships.

Our employees bring strength of mind and spirit to make the extraordinary happen every day. With humility and compassion at our core, PRO-spectus is proud of our relentless focus towards the higher purpose of improving the lives of patients we support.

We recognize it takes a lot of people working together with a common goal to make spectacular happen, and we never forget that at the heart of our company are the people who make it work.

All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status or other protected status under federal, state or local laws.

Our benefits include robust medical, dental, and vision plans; life insurance and disability coverage; and tax-advantaged savings accounts. With paid time off, holidays, bereavement leave, and a 401(k)-retirement plan with employer matching, PRO-spectus prioritizes your financial and personal security. raw.description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA. This is a 2 Year FTC.

Role Summary

In this role you will oversee a subset of the growing PLOS journals portfolio: you will manage PLOS Biology and PLOS Medicine, with line-management of their professional Editors-in-Chief, and provide editorial oversight for a diverse set of journals led by academic volunteers across a range of disciplines in biology, human and environmental health. You will manage in line with PLOS strategy, helping to keep PLOS at the forefront of open science publishing and trusted content. You will leverage your strong relationships with the scientific community to drive engagement and develop the journals to meet the evolving needs of their global communities. You will work collaboratively with the journals’ Editorial Boards, and in-house colleagues, to create and deliver against journal strategies, using your international networks to grow PLOS’ profile and reputation.

The role is an integral part of the senior PLOS editorial leadership. As such, you will be expected to engage PLOS Leaders’ Framework—adaptive decision-making, empowering others, iterative learning, agility, resilience, systems thinking, continuous improvement, catalysing opportunity—at an advanced level. As part of that leadership, you will also own ad hoc projects across the entire PLOS journals portfolio. Priority projects currently relate to quality control, workflow optimization, cost efficiency, non-article research outputs (data and code), policy development and community engagement. You will embrace change, and lead your teams effectively through it.

Responsibilities

Journal portfolio management

  • Work closely with the Directors of Editorial, Publishing, MarComms and Global Development to develop an editorial strategy for a portfolio of PLOS journals that supports PLOS’s commitments to Open Science, DEI, community engagement, trusted content and customer service
  • Identify and develop opportunities to expand the portfolio in line with PLOS strategy
  • Develop and oversee attainment of multi-term performance metrics for individual journals
  • Partner with the Publishing Director to develop and manage annual budgets, ensuring responsible decision-making and efficient resource allocation to meet both budget and quality standards
  • Work closely with Operations colleagues and vendors to oversee optimization of editorial workflows, systems and reporting
  • Work closely with Marketing and Communications colleagues to ensure promotion of journal content and PLOS’ mission, and to drive journal submissions and uptake of Open Science practices
  • Ensure that Editorial makes effective and efficient use of cross-journal Centers of Excellence (e.g. Publication Ethics, Editorial Board Services)
  • Ensure that the portfolio shares cohesive and consistent editorial policies and quality standards, reacting dynamically to changing community needs while forefronting Open Science
  • Lead cross-journal initiatives, overseeing development of systems and workflows
  • Oversee Editorial participation in community initiatives, conferences and events, ensuring equality of opportunity and alignment with PLOS’ mission
  • Help to ensure best-practice document hygiene and information sharing by everyone in Editorial

People management

  • Lead a high-performing and cohesive team of Editorial staff (up to 4 direct reports), fostering a cross-portfolio and cross-cultural mindset
  • Ensure strategy is collaboratively translated into clear tactics for teams and individual staff, and monitor progress against goals regularly
  • Lead by example, modeling open and clear communication and ensuring all stakeholders understand their roles and responsibilities
  • Build strong relationships with Editorial Boards within a true partnership framework
  • Address underperformance swiftly, sensitively and supportively, in collaboration with Line Manager and People & Culture team
  • Act as a thought-partner to, and deputize for, the Editorial Director

Diversity, equity and inclusion

  • Oversee improvement of the diversity of PLOS staff, Editorial Boards, peer-reviewers and authors
  • Work collaboratively with stakeholders to eliminate bias in manuscript processing and editorial decision-making
  • Oversee editorial participation in internal and external DEI initiatives

Cross-sector

  • Maintain in-depth industry knowledge, awareness of market trends, innovations and evolving customer needs
  • Represent PLOS at industry events occasionally (approx 1-2 events per year)

Qualifications and Experience

  • PhD and post-doctoral experience (or equivalent) in a relevant subject area
  • Substantial editorial experience (5+ years) with progressively increased managerial responsibility in STM publishing required
  • Track record in managing a group of successful journals and teams distributed internationally
  • Passionate interest in science and scientists
  • Proven commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion in science and scholarly publication.
  • Strong business acumen
  • Wide network of contacts within global scientific communities
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically, to innovate and to implement creative solutions
  • Experienced people manager with a track record of managing high-performing teams through change
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

The base salary range we've established for these positions is $145,000 - $163,000. PLOS also offers a comprehenseive benefits package sumarized below.

US:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out.

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all.

Visit to learn more.

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
Als IT Security Consultant Defence (m/w/d) unterstützt du unsere Kunden aus dem militärischen Umfeld bei der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller IT-Security-Projekte. Dabei analysierst du bestehende IT-Landschaften, entwickelst Sicherheitskonzepte auf Basis des BSI IT-Grundschutzes und begleitest Kunden bei sicherheitsrelevanten Fragestellungen.

Als IT Security Consultant Defence (m/w/d)

  • berätst du Kunden aus dem militärischen Umfeld zu IT- und Informationssicherheit sowie sicherheitsrelevanten Fragestellungen.
  • analysierst du IT-Infrastrukturen und bestehende Sicherheitsorganisationen und leitest geeignete Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Informationssicherheit ab.
  • konzipierst du Sicherheitskonzepte nach den Vorgaben des BSI IT-Grundschutzes.
  • konzipierst und pflegst du Sicherheitsdokumentationen mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch.
  • unterstützt du bei der Akquisition sowie der Generierung von Folgegeschäft.
  • arbeitest du eng mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen und begleitest Sicherheitsprojekte von der Analyse bis zur Umsetzung.

Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Cyber Security oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation; alternativ eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Consulting von Informationssicherheit / IT-Security / Cyber Security
  • Gute Kenntnisse im BSI IT-Grundschutz sowie in regulatorischen Vorgaben wie ZDv A-960/1 und VSA
  • Kenntnisse von IT-Architekturen und IT-Infrastrukturen; Erfahrungen mit dem ISMS-Tool SAVE sind von Vorteil
  • Branchenübliche Zertifizierungen sind wünschenswert (z. B. BSI IT-Grundschutz-Praktiker, BSI IT-Grundschutz-Berater), bei Bedarf unterstützen wir dich im Zertifizierungsprozess
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) in Wort und Schrift
  • projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft (20-30 %)

Das zeichnet dich persönlich aus

  • Du vertiefst dich detailliert in deinen Aufgaben und schaffst es deine Ergebnisse verständlich zu visualisieren und darzustellen.
  • In herausfordernden Situationen bewahrst du einen kühlen Kopf und bleibst professionell in deiner Rolle.
  • Du meisterst zielstrebig die Zusammenarbeit im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und bringst Engagement sowie den Ehrgeiz mit, einen spürbaren Beitrag zum Projekterfolg zu leisten.

Benefits

  • Come as you are: Bei uns gibt es keinen Dresscode. Wir legen Wert auf deine Ideen, nicht auf deinen Kleidungsstil. Wir schätzen dich in deinem Business-Outfit genauso wie in Hoodie und Jeans.
  • Sport@Materna: Nutze das vielfältige und flexible Sport- und Wellnessangebot unseres Partners Urban Sports Club in ganz Deutschland, Österreich und mehreren europäischen Ländern.
  • Flache Hierarchien: Deine Ideen brauchen keine langen Entscheidungswege: Bei uns kannst du anpacken und mitgestalten!
  • Wissensaustausch: Du möchtest über den Tellerrand hinausschauen? In unseren Brown-Bag-Sessions, Developer-Summits und Communities hast du die Gelegenheit dazu!
  • Job Rad:Neues Bike gefällig? Mit Job-Rad unterstützen wir dich dabei dein Wunsch-Fahrrad zu leasen.
  • Learning@Materna:Mit über 100 Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsangeboten unterstützen wir dich bei deiner persönlichen Weiterentwicklung!

Interessiert? Werde Teil der Materna-Story!

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unser Auswahlprozess besteht aus zwei Gesprächsrunden. Bei erfolgreicher Bewerbung wirst du zunächst zu einem virtuellen Interview eingeladen.

Wende dich bei Fragen gerne an mich.
