raw.title: Principal Product Manager
raw.excerpt: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease.
raw.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

Kpler is expanding into high-value verticals where its extensive coverage of commodities and related supply chains gives customers a competitive edge. North American inland transportation is a key focus, supporting US and Canadian crude oil exports via pipelines, as well as the transportation of marginal barrels and last-mile movements via barges and rail.

As Product Manager for North America Inland Transportation Monitoring, you will own the product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Commodities Product and Business Unit Leads, you will identify market opportunities, translate customer needs into product requirements and build a product that delivers actionable insights across North American inland transportation.

You will work closely with Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing and Market Analysts to develop a reliable, data-driven product, establish trusted methodologies and ensure seamless data delivery through web applications, APIs and other distribution channels.

This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in commodities, transportation or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. It offers the opportunity to build a new product category on a strong data foundation, taking a pragmatic, iterative approach rather than managing an already mature offering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead product discovery to identify unmet customer needs and develop innovative propositions for internal and external customers.
  • Define the product strategy and roadmap for North America Inland Transportation Monitoring, prioritising development in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Drive the first product release and go-to-market strategy, contributing to positioning, packaging and pricing input, and working with Sales and Marketing to support launch and early adoption.
  • Ensure seamless data delivery through web applications, APIs and other data distribution pipelines, working closely with Engineering and Data teams.
  • Establish trusted data standards and methodologies, using recognised external frameworks where relevant to ensure the product becomes a reliable reference source for customers.
  • Develop product positioning and competitive strategy, monitoring the North American inland transportation landscape and differentiating Kpler through its independent approach and real-time data infrastructure.
  • Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Data, Sales and Marketing to align teams around product development, customer value and go-to-market execution.
  • Implement product governance best practices and agile methodologies, maintaining effective prioritisation and delivery processes.
  • Analyse market feedback, delivery progress and product risks, keeping relevant stakeholders informed of roadmap trade-offs and potential challenges.

Skills & Experience

  • At least 7 years of product management or commercial experience in the commodities and transportation industries, or a closely related B2B data/SaaS business, with a track record of delivering products that customers adopt.
  • Strong understanding of the commodities and transportation data landscape, including the wider competitive environment.
  • Proven ability to translate customer needs into product direction and deliver solutions in close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Experience with product discovery, roadmap prioritisation and data-product delivery.
  • Understanding of go-to-market planning, including product positioning, packaging and pricing input.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work with databases and use complex data to develop impactful products.
  • Experience working across cross-functional teams to deliver data-driven products.
  • Fluency in English.
  • A rigorous, problem-solving approach, with the ability to operate independently and take ownership of outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage technical and commercial teams, including senior external stakeholders.
  • A pragmatic, action-oriented mindset, with the ability to operate in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and iterate towards product-market fit.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience in pipelines, rail or barges, rather than only adjacent transportation segments.
  • Experience launching a new product line rather than solely managing an established offering.
  • An established network across commodities trading houses, producers, operators or funds.
  • Understanding of the regulatory environment shaping North American pipeline, rail and barge transportation.
We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

We make things happen

We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.

We build together

We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.

We are here to help

We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.
Our People Pledge
Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.

raw.excerpt: Company Overview Imagine Everything.  Build the Future with Hexion.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Imagine Everything. Build the Future with Hexion.

At Hexion, we push boundaries, rethink possibilities, and create real impact. We activate science to deliver progress—developing breakthrough solutions that strengthen industries, protect communities, and drive a more sustainable future.

This is where bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators come together to shape what’s next. Whether you're engineering advanced materials, transforming manufacturing technologies, or leading strategic innovation, your ideas and actions leave a lasting mark. We cultivate an inclusive culture of growth, collaboration, and accountability, ensuring every contribution propels us forward.

We don’t follow the status quo—we challenge it, disrupt it, and improve it. Every role at Hexion is part of something bigger.

We invest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous development—equipping you with the tools, training, and opportunities to excel. With an unwavering commitment to safety, partnership, belonging, and impact, we empower you to lead change and strengthen industries worldwide.

Your Future Starts Here.

If you’re ready to push limits, reimagine what’s possible, and create the extraordinary, Hexion is where you belong.

Anything is possible when you imagine everything.

Position Overview

Lead Hexion’s enterprise Agentic AI and automation strategy—architecting and scaling agentic AI capabilities, identifying automation opportunities across all business functions, championing AI fluency and a learning culture, and overseeing the execution and KPI governance of automation initiatives to deliver measurable business value across the organization.

Job Responsibilities

  • Build AI-powered applications that deliver agentic and generative AI capabilities to business users across commercial, supply chain, manufacturing, and R&D functions.
  • Develop and tune Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines over unstructured content such as product specs, Safety Data Sheets, standard operating procedures, emails, and meeting transcripts — using parsing (Azure Document Intelligence, Unstructured), chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, and reranking.
  • Create domain-specific tools and connectors (including Model Context Protocol servers) that expose enterprise systems — ERP, planning, analytics, content management, and custom APIs — as safe, well-documented actions for AI agents to call.
  • Build user-facing surfaces with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Teams apps, Streamlit, or React — including chat interfaces, approval workflows, and result-review screens.
  • Implement data validation and guardrails at every tool boundary: schema checks, business-rule validation, content safety, PII handling, and explicit user confirmation for write operations.
  • Partner with product owners and subject-matter experts to gather requirements, translate workflows into agent execution plans, prototype rapidly, demo, gather feedback, and iterate.
  • Support deployment and operations of the applications you build: package for production on Azure AI Foundry or Container Apps, add tracing and logging, monitor usage and quality, and respond to production issues.
  • Apply prompt engineering and evaluation to measure application quality — build test cases, run LLM-as-judge evals, and track regressions over time.
  • Document use cases, tools, and playbooks so applications remain maintainable and extensible by the team.
  • Collaborate across globally distributed teams through code reviews, pair programming, and shared technical standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field — or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development or data/analytics engineering experience, including recent hands-on work with LLMs or AI-powered applications (professional projects, internships, or substantive personal projects).
  • Strong proficiency in Python and comfort with TypeScript or JavaScript for front-end work.
  • Working knowledge of at least one AI/agent framework: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
  • Practical experience with LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Hugging Face) and structured outputs.
  • Hands-on RAG experience — document parsing, chunking, embeddings, and hybrid retrieval — with at least one vector database.
  • Comfort integrating with enterprise APIs such as ERP, BI platforms, SharePoint or Microsoft Graph, Teams, and REST/GraphQL services.
  • Solid SQL skills and working familiarity with a modern data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent).
  • Self-directed learner who stays current with a fast-moving field, can teach themselves new frameworks with minimal guidance, and ships working software without hand-holding.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills; comfortable demoing to business stakeholders and gathering requirements directly from subject-matter experts.
  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and basic DevOps workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, or Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate).
  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry agents or Palantir AIP Logic / Workshop applications.
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool/function calling, and prompt registries.
  • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling — LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or Weights & Biases.
  • UX sensibility — ability to design clean, low-friction chat and approval interfaces that business users actually adopt.
  • Exposure to Docker, containerized deployments, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Bicep).
  • Public portfolio — GitHub projects, technical blog posts, or community contributions — demonstrating curiosity and hands-on experimentation in generative or agentic AI.
  • Prior experience delivering business applications in process industries, manufacturing, supply chain, or commercial analytics.

Other

We are an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, pregnancy, race, national origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or military status, status as a qualified individual with a disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

To be considered for this position candidates are required to submit an application for employment through our career site and, be at least 18 years of age. Any offer of employment will be conditioned upon successful completion of a drug test and background investigation, as well as authorization for the Company to conduct additional periodic background checks as required by the Chemical Facility Anti-Terrorism Standards (CFATS) or regulations adopted by the department of Homeland Security or other regulatory agencies. A prior criminal record is not an automatic bar to employment, and the Company will conduct an individualized assessment and reassessment, consistent with applicable law, prior to making any final employment decision.

raw.description:
Precision for Medicine is a global Clinical Research Organization with uniquely integrated offering which enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas.

Due to our continued growth we are seeking a Regulatory and Start Up Specialist based in the UK to join our growing team. Apart from the experience with regulatory submissions, candidates will ideally also have contracts and budgets negotiation experience for the UK.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Responsible for delivery, in terms of timeliness and quality, of site activation readiness within the assigned country/sites and foreseeing and mitigating any risks.

  • Preparation of Clinical Trial Application Forms as well as preparation of submission dossier (initial and amendments/notifications) for submission to Competent Authorities, Ethics Committees, and other applicable local bodies according to local requirements and within required timelines to obtain all necessary authorizations/approvals for the conduct of the Clinical Trial according to international and local/national applicable regulations, company SOPs and principles of ICH-GCP.
  • Interaction with CA/EC for study purposes and handling responses to the CA/EC.
  • Providing regular updates about CA and EC submissions to the Start Up Lead and/or Regulatory Lead assigned to the study and to Project Manager/Project Team
  • Maintenance of project plans, project trackers and regulatory intelligence tools as it pertains to assigned responsibilities and to keep Regulatory Leadership
  • Preparation/Support the development of study specific start-up plans, IMP release requirements and essential document review criteria.
  • Partner with the assigned site CRA to ensure alignment in communication and secure site
  • Review and manage collection of essential documents required for site activation/IMP release.
  • Customize country/site specific Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form.
  • Responsible for/facilitates the translation and co-ordination of translations for documents.
  • Maintain communication with other key functions participating to country start up e., Feasibility, Clinical Operations, Project Management, Regulatory, and Site Contracts management group on project specific status and deliverables.
  • Act as SME for collection and maintenance of site level critical path to Site Activation data points, including but not limited to Competent Authority, local IRB/Ethics Committee (EC) timelines, site contracts and budget negotiation requirements for and other required reviews to secure on time site activation for the assigned sites in the country.
  • When required, participate/support the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee department.
  • May participate/support feasibility group in site outreach to assess potential interest of investigators to a potential study.
  • Keep an updated knowledge of the local clinical trial laws, regulations and help distributing their knowledge within PFM to ensure the conduct of Clinical Trials according to international and local/national applicable regulations.
  • Maintain audit/inspection readiness at all times and file documents as per TMF plan and/ or study specific plans in the relevant TMF
  • May support the clinical team performing Pre-Study Site Visits.

The ideal candidate will have:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related field (ideally in a scientific or healthcare discipline), or Registered Nurse (RN) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • A qualification in Pharmacy/ work experience as a Pharmacist would be highly beneficial.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience.

Other Required:

  • Previous experience working as a Regulatory and Start Up Specialist or Site Contracts Specialists in either a CRO or pharmaceutical/ biotech industry or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.
  • Experience using computerized information systems, electronic spreadsheets, word processing and electronic mail required.
  • Fluency in English

Preferred:

  • Relevant regulatory and site start-up (feasibility, contract negotiations, CA/ EC/ IRB submissions) experience.
  • Experience in site contract and budget negotiation would be a strong plus.
  • Experience using milestone tracking tools/systems.
  • Ability to prioritize workload to meet deadlines
  • Advanced degree in medical or life sciences (MD, PhD, PharmD)/RAC certification/Masters in Regulatory Science.

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

Role TItle: Mechanical Engineering Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible-you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

Required Skills:

  • Python

  • Mechanical Engineering

We are looking for a highly skilled Mechanical Engineering Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving engineering design, physical modeling, simulation, technical problem-solving, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks across structural, thermal, mechanical, and multiphysics domains. A representative task may require translating physical requirements into a computational model, generating the required geometry or mesh, applying materials and boundary conditions, running an engineering simulation, and determining whether the resulting artifact and analysis satisfy the applicable physical and design constraints.

This is a very coding heavy role. Candidates must have experience using coding agents in their workflow.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Solve and validate mechanical-engineering problems involving design, analysis, simulation, testing, or R&D.

  • Translate physical systems and engineering requirements into analytical or computational models.

  • Create or modify geometry, meshes, materials, loads, contacts, constraints, and solver inputs.

Required Qualifications:

  • An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline; or

  • Strong understanding of applied mechanics and mechanical-engineering fundamentals.

  • Experience developing analytical, computational, or simulation-based engineering solutions.

  • Practical proficiency with coding agents.

Process:

  • Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

  • Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

  • Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure:

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability:

Typically, roles are filled within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

What is Findem:

Findem is the AI platform for talent outcomes. Its Labeling Engine transforms billions of unstructured people data points into verified Success Signals — context about what drives success — and Relationship Signals — insight into how people are connected and where influence flows. Together, these give customers a competitive edge in hiring, executive search, mobility, learning, development and workforce planning. That’s why leaders rely on Findem to improve pipeline quality, reduce costs, and deliver faster, more consistent talent impact. Named one of America’s Most Innovative Companies, Findem is redefining how organizations turn people data into business advantage.

Why We Need You:

Findem is looking for a Senior UX Designer for a 6-month contract to help shape the experience of our AI-powered recruiting products. You’ll focus on the craft that makes software feel intuitive and complete: refining workflows, sharpening interactions, and bringing a cohesive, polished feel to products that customers use every day and that we put in front of prospects in demos.

As we scale our agent platform, you’ll design and ship new agentic patterns, defining how users direct, review, and collaborate with AI agents inside their daily workflows. You’ll also help define how our team uses AI tools in its own work, building an AI-native process that brings design and engineering closer together and shortens the path from idea to shipped experience.

As part of the Executive Search team, you’ll work daily with Product and Engineering and get in front of customers early. You’ll prototype with them, help win deals, and see your work through to production, so you can point to the deals and shipped features your designs made possible.

What You'll Do:

  • Leading-edge design for agentic and UX experiences across RRA, RaaS, and Exec Search.
  • Agent artifact design and experience — how multi-agent interactions and agent outputs are shaped, presented, and interacted with.
  • Early customer prototype UX and implementation (Exec Search exploratory work).
  • UX design and user workflows for RRA SaaS.
  • Committing UX code polish PRs (front-end polish only — no back-end code or API contracts).

Your Working Experience:

  • 5+ years designing and shipping digital products, with a portfolio of live, shipped experiences (not just concepts or handoff mocks).
  • Track record of moving quickly from idea to prototype in ambiguous, early-stage contexts.
  • Preferred: 0-to-1 or exploratory product work, ideally in SaaS or B2B.
  • Preferred: comfort collaborating directly in an engineering codebase and workflow (Git, PRs, design QA).
  • Portfolio and demonstrated ability weighted above formal credentials.
  • Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong UX and interaction design fundamentals: user journey mapping, information architecture, and turning complex workflows into simple, intuitive flows.
  • Proven design-systems experience — building and applying reusable components consistently across multiple surfaces.
  • Hands-on front-end proficiency: comfortable committing polish-level PRs in a modern stack (React/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, component libraries), including responsive behavior, empty/loading/error states, motion, and accessibility.
  • Ability to take work from idea to design to working prototype, reusing existing services and APIs rather than building them.
  • Preferred: experience designing for AI-native or agentic products — agent artifacts, streaming outputs, chat/canvas interfaces, human-in-the-loop review, and non-deterministic states.
We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer
We believe that a diverse team builds better solutions. We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
Ready to build something impactful and lead a team to success? Apply now and let’s grow together.

Role Title: Applied Scientist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Required Skills:

  • Python

  • Machine Learning

  • Statistics

  • Data Analysis

  • Experimentation

  • Pandas

  • Data Modeling

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required; your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is part of an open Data Scientist project, with a strong emphasis on clear written and verbal communication.

Scope of Work:

  • Design and execute statistical analyses to uncover actionable insights from complex datasets.

  • Develop and validate machine learning models for various business or research objectives.

  • Apply data modeling techniques and manage large-scale data transformations using Python and Pandas.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define experimentation frameworks and analyze outcomes.

  • Document methodology, findings, and recommendations with a focus on clarity and precision.

  • Review peer contributions and provide high-quality feedback to support knowledge sharing.

  • Deliver reproducible code and well-organized analytical reports as part of the project deliverables.

  • Evaluate AI model outputs on statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and quantitative problems.

  • Create expert-level prompts, datasets, and reference solutions.

  • Identify flawed methodology, statistical errors, and weak quantitative reasoning.

  • Provide clear, structured feedback that improves model capability.

Preferred Qualifications:

MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.

What is your new project?

Our client builds and grows mobile apps used by millions of people worldwide. Their apps are primarily monetized through in-app advertising, so every UA decision is judged on real ad revenue per user, not vanity installs. We move fast, run on data, and give UA managers real budgets and real ownership.

What makes this project exciting?

We’re looking for a Mid/Senior UA Manager to own and scale paid acquisition across our mobile portfolio. You’ll manage significant daily budgets across Meta, TikTok, Mintegral, AppLovin, Unity and other networks, with one clear goal: profitable growth measured by ROAS. This is a hands-on role with direct impact on company revenue and a short path from idea to live test.

What makes you a great fit

  • 3+ years of hands-on mobile UA experience (5+ years for Senior)
  • Proven track record managing significant budgets on at least two of: Meta, TikTok, Mintegral, AppLovin, Unity
  • Deep understanding of ROAS-based bidding (tROAS, AEO/VO, CPI/CPE) and cohort-based KPIs
  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable with Excel/Sheets, BI tools, and MMP data (AppsFlyer, Adjust or similar)
  • Ownership mindset: you treat the budget like your own money
  • Excellent English, written and spoken

Big advantages:

  • Experience in mobile gaming or adtech companies
  • Experience growing apps monetized mainly through in-app ads (IAA) or hybrid models, not only IAP
  • ⁠Understanding of ad monetization: mediation, eCPM, ARPDAU and how they drive LTV and ROAS
  • Hands-on experience with AppLovin and Mintegral at scale
  • SQL skills (Snowflake, BigQuery or similar)
  • ⁠Experience launching new networks and geos from zero
  • Experience with creative testing frameworks and working with creative teams

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Plan, launch and optimize mobile UA campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Mintegral, AppLovin, Unity and additional networks (Google App Campaigns, ironSource, Moloco, Liftoff, DSPs)
  • Own budgets and hit ROAS targets (D0/D3/D7) by managing tROAS bids, daily caps and budgets at campaign and country level
  • Scale winners and cut losers fast, based on trends and total profit, not single-day noise
  • Build and run a structured testing roadmap: new networks, geos, bidding strategies, audiences and creatives
  • ⁠Work closely with the Creative team on briefs, concepts and creative performance analysis
  • Partner with Data and Monetization teams to connect UA cost with ad revenue (eCPM, ARPDAU, LTV curves)
  • Analyze performance in SQL and BI dashboards, and spot issues before they cost money
  • Manage relationships with network account managers and push for betas, better terms and support
  • Report weekly to management on spend, ROAS, learnings and next steps

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

About Edelman Financial Engines

Since 1986, Edelman Financial Engines has been committed to always acting in the best interests of our clients. Pricing & Commercial Analyst (Remote/Hybrid)

Full Time, Spain or Italy

Working closely with Sales, Commercial Development, Finance, and Pricing colleagues around the world, you'll develop pricing proposals that help win and retain business while ensuring profitability. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, solving complex business challenges, and turning analysis into commercial recommendations.

As a Pricing & Commercial Analyst, you will

  • Build and maintain pricing and financial models for prospective and existing clients
  • Perform profitability and pricing analyses to support business decisions
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders across Pricing, Finance, Sales, and Commercial teams to create winning pricing strategies and proposals that meet both client needs and business objectives

  • Strong communication, organization, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities
  • Proficient at managing multiple projects and deadlines and working in a fast-paced, time sensitive environment
  • Takes responsibility for their work, checks for accuracy before delivering results, and shows initiative in finding solutions and driving tasks forward

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

At BCD Travel, we value you—our culture and success are defined by our people. We carefully consider a wide range of objective, gender‑neutral compensation factors, including professional background, skills, experience, and role scope.

This position is advertised across multiple European locations. The expected annual gross salary ranges by country are as follows:

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Ecosystem Operations Specialist, you'll help turn GitLab's Ecosystem go-to-market strategy into reliable day-to-day execution. You'll be a trusted operational resource and first point of contact for sellers, Ecosystem Sales Managers, partners, and cross-functional teams, supporting partner business from account setup and deal registration through quoting, ordering, and post-sales operational support. You'll resolve standard issues, improve processes and data quality, and route commercial, policy, finance, legal, and systems decisions to the right owners so Ecosystem Sales Managers can focus on partner strategy, pipeline creation, and deal progression.

What you'll do

  • Execute partner-sourced and partner-influenced workflows, including intake, account and opportunity setup or linking, deal registrations, cloud co-sell referrals, validation, routing, approval follow-up, and standard issue resolution.
  • Process partner quote requests against documented pricing and program requirements, receive purchase orders, and prepare opportunities for closure with Sales, Deal Desk, Billing, and Finance. Support marketplace and two-tier transactions involving distributors, resellers, and cloud providers.
  • Guide partners, distributors, sellers, and Ecosystem Sales Managers through operational questions, including attribution, program compliance, and post-sales support. Identify and route exceptions requiring commercial, policy, contractual, pricing, payment, or systems decisions to the appropriate owner.
  • Execute and improve partner program workflows, including onboarding, not-for-resale licensing, certifications, rebates, Professional Services Partner eligibility, Letters of Authorization, and channel price files. Collaborate with Programs and policy owners on required notifications, documentation, and compliance reporting.
  • Monitor Salesforce and partner-management data for missing links, incorrect ownership, incomplete attribution, failed synchronization, and recurring defects. Support month-end close, recurring data controls, and ad hoc reporting tied to projects and company objectives and key results.
  • Build and present dashboards and business updates on backlog, aging, turnaround time, approvals, pipeline, attribution, data quality, compliance, and process health. Share trends, risks, blockers, and recommended actions in regional and global partner team meetings.
  • Investigate recurring friction and manual work, document root causes and operational requirements, test process or system changes, and support automation and scalable self-service improvements.
  • Maintain process documentation, how-to guides, and best practices, and deliver office hours, operational training, and communications when processes or systems change.

What you'll bring

  • Relevant experience in partner operations, sales operations, deal desk, order management, finance operations, or a similar revenue operations environment, including direct support for sales or partner sales teams, distributors, and partners, along with an interest in GitLab and open source software.
  • Experience with enterprise quote-to-cash processes and configure, price, quote tools or other commercial systems in a channel or partner context.
  • Experience with Salesforce and partner-management systems or portals.
  • Strong analytical skills, including advanced spreadsheets, dashboard building in Salesforce or business intelligence tools such as Tableau, and turning data into clear recommendations.
  • Hands-on experience using generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools to improve operational productivity, quality, or scale, including writing effective prompts, judging when outputs need human review, and sharing useful approaches with others.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize requests, investigate issues, identify exceptions, and escalate decisions to the appropriate owner, along with experience contributing to process improvement and automation.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining operational requirements to technical and non-technical audiences, documenting processes, creating enablement materials, and collaborating across Sales, Ecosystem, Programs, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Billing, and Systems.
  • Preferred experience includes Impartner or similar tools, SQL, or Snowflake.

About the team

The Ecosystem team supports GitLab's partner go-to-market strategy. In this role, you'll work with Ecosystem Sales Managers, global distributors, partners, sellers, and cross-functional teams to keep partner operations moving and make process health visible. We focus on accurate transactions, reliable partner data, consistent program execution, and reducing operational friction so our Ecosystem Sales Managers can focus on partner strategy and field engagement.

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. raw.description:
This is a fully remote position. Preferred candidates possess telehealth/remote patient support experience.

The Clinical Navigator provides individualized clinical education, treatment-support services, and care coordination within the scope of assigned patient-support programs. The role helps patients and caregivers understand prescribed treatment plans, identify potential barriers to treatment initiation and continuation, and develop practical strategies that support informed participation and adherence.

The Clinical Navigator conducts structured outreach throughout the patient journey, provides program-approved education, documents patient interactions and outcomes, and coordinates with authorized members of the patient's healthcare and support teams. The Clinical Navigator recognizes and escalates clinical, safety, access, psychosocial, and operational concerns in accordance with established program protocols and collaborates closely with case management and other cross-functional teams.

The Clinical Navigator does not diagnose, prescribe, modify treatment plans, provide emergency care, or replace the patient's treating healthcare team.

Core Duties & Responsibilities

  • Conduct structured outreach to patients and caregivers at designated points throughout the treatment journey.
  • Provide accurate, program-approved education regarding prescribed treatment, preparation, administration logistics, adherence expectations, and available support resources.
  • Identify patient- and caregiver-reported barriers to treatment initiation, continuation, or adherence and develop practical strategies within program scope.
  • Identify clinical, educational, logistical, psychosocial, or access-related barriers that may contribute to missed treatment or nonadherence.
  • Provide support within scope and route issues requiring clinical decision-making, access assistance, or additional services to the appropriate provider or internal team.
  • Recognize and escalate urgent or potentially serious clinical concerns according to program protocols.
  • Identify and report adverse events, product complaints, medication errors, missed or delayed treatment, treatment discontinuation, and other reportable information within required timelines.
  • Escalate questions involving diagnosis, treatment selection, dosing, treatment modification, contraindications, or other clinical decisions to the treating healthcare provider.
  • Coordinate communication and follow-up across authorized stakeholders in accordance with privacy standards and program workflows.
  • Accurately document outreach attempts, education provided, patient concerns, milestones, outcomes, escalations, and follow-up activities.
  • Manage an assigned caseload while meeting established quality and productivity standards.
  • Maintain current knowledge of assigned products, disease states, treatment journeys, program resources, and approved educational materials.
  • Communicate recurring patient, access, treatment, and operational trends to leadership and participate in quality improvement activities.

Skills & Requirements

  • Strong communication, active listening, motivational interviewing, and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent documentation, organization, prioritization, time management, and follow-up skills.
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, analytical, and independent judgment.
  • Ability to manage multiple active cases, follow standardized protocols, and work independently in a remote environment.
  • Ability to support patients and caregivers across multiple stages of the treatment journey.
  • Ability to establish trust through respectful, collaborative, and nonjudgmental communication.
  • Proficiency with case management or CRM platforms, electronic health records, Microsoft Office, secure messaging, video communication, and related healthcare technology.
  • Working knowledge of patient privacy, adverse event reporting, product complaint reporting, professional boundaries, and scope-of-practice requirements.

Education, Certifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a healthcare-related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and clinical experience.
  • Current, unrestricted professional license or certification applicable to the assigned program (e.g., LPN/LVN, RN, NP, PA, SLP, OT/COTA, PT/PTA, PharmD).
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in direct patient care, patient education, clinical navigation, care coordination, case management, specialty pharmacy, rehabilitation, infusion services, or patient-support programs preferred.
  • Experience providing patient education and support through telephone, video, secure messaging, or other remote channels preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Remote work environment from the employee's approved home office.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use.
  • Ability to lift up to 15 pounds occasionally.
  • Flexibility to support activities across U.S. time zones (EST–PST).
  • Occasional travel for training, company meetings, or client activities.

Our PRO-spectus Culture Philosophy

At PRO-spectus we have created a culture that is supportive, dedicated, and teamwork driven. We celebrate each other’s joys in personal life and professional accomplishments, promoting meaningful relationships and friendships.

Our employees bring strength of mind and spirit to make the extraordinary happen every day. With humility and compassion at our core, PRO-spectus is proud of our relentless focus towards the higher purpose of improving the lives of patients we support.

We recognize it takes a lot of people working together with a common goal to make spectacular happen, and we never forget that at the heart of our company are the people who make it work.

PRO-spectus is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status or other protected status under federal, state or local laws.

At PRO-spectus, we are deeply committed to pay transparency and equity. The salary range for this position is $50.00 - $57.00 per hour based on experience and qualifications, with the final offer reflecting skills and other job-related factors. Beyond competitive pay, we offer a comprehensive and generous benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance.

Our benefits include robust medical, dental, and vision plans; life insurance and disability coverage; and tax-advantaged savings accounts. We also provide an Employee Assistance Program, home office benefits, and unique perks like an Employee Ownership Program. With paid time off, holidays, bereavement leave, and a 401(k)-retirement plan with employer matching, PRO-spectus prioritizes your financial and personal security. Plus, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus opportunity.

Join PRO-spectus, where your career growth, well-being, and contributions truly matter!

raw.description:
Description

MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments - no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

Our client builds and grows mobile apps used by millions of people worldwide. Their apps are primarily monetized through in-app advertising, so every UA decision is judged on real ad revenue per user, not vanity installs. We move fast, run on data, and give UA managers real budgets and real ownership.

What makes this project exciting?

We’re looking for a Mid/Senior UA Manager to own and scale paid acquisition across our mobile portfolio. You’ll manage significant daily budgets across Meta, TikTok, Mintegral, AppLovin, Unity and other networks, with one clear goal: profitable growth measured by ROAS. This is a hands-on role with direct impact on company revenue and a short path from idea to live test.

What makes you a great fit

  • 3+ years of hands-on mobile UA experience (5+ years for Senior)
  • Proven track record managing significant budgets on at least two of: Meta, TikTok, Mintegral, AppLovin, Unity
  • Deep understanding of ROAS-based bidding (tROAS, AEO/VO, CPI/CPE) and cohort-based KPIs
  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable with Excel/Sheets, BI tools, and MMP data (AppsFlyer, Adjust or similar)
  • Ownership mindset: you treat the budget like your own money
  • Excellent English, written and spoken

Big advantages:

  • Experience in mobile gaming or adtech companies
  • Experience growing apps monetized mainly through in-app ads (IAA) or hybrid models, not only IAP
  • ⁠Understanding of ad monetization: mediation, eCPM, ARPDAU and how they drive LTV and ROAS
  • Hands-on experience with AppLovin and Mintegral at scale
  • SQL skills (Snowflake, BigQuery or similar)
  • ⁠Experience launching new networks and geos from zero
  • Experience with creative testing frameworks and working with creative teams

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Plan, launch and optimize mobile UA campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Mintegral, AppLovin, Unity and additional networks (Google App Campaigns, ironSource, Moloco, Liftoff, DSPs)
  • Own budgets and hit ROAS targets (D0/D3/D7) by managing tROAS bids, daily caps and budgets at campaign and country level
  • Scale winners and cut losers fast, based on trends and total profit, not single-day noise
  • Build and run a structured testing roadmap: new networks, geos, bidding strategies, audiences and creatives
  • ⁠Work closely with the Creative team on briefs, concepts and creative performance analysis
  • Partner with Data and Monetization teams to connect UA cost with ad revenue (eCPM, ARPDAU, LTV curves)
  • Analyze performance in SQL and BI dashboards, and spot issues before they cost money
  • Manage relationships with network account managers and push for betas, better terms and support
  • Report weekly to management on spend, ROAS, learnings and next steps

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

raw.description:
Evio Overview

Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.

In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reform—rapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. In 2025, Wellmark joined as Evio's first non-founding investor and sixth owner health plan. Each company made, and continues to make, significant investments to establish Evio as an independent entity to lead this transformation.  

Evio has advanced analytics and contracting capabilities at scale, and a suite of digital tools, to power our high-cost medication solutions. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing “flywheel” where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an “Only Evio can do that,” mindset and prioritization.

Evio is also a company that has invested heavily in and been highly intentional about people, team and culture. We believe we have created a very special place to work and encourage candidates to observe and ask us about our culture and decide for themselves.

Evio's Values

  • Empathy– The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit.
  • Diversity – We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights – one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all.
  • Adventure – We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity.
  • Relentless – Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other.
  • Transparency – Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate.
  • Excellence – We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard.

Healthcare Data Analyst

About the role

We are looking for a data analyst with deep knowledge of medical and pharmacy claims data to join Evio’s analytics team. You’ll develop and maintain data analytics tools and products that help Evio better understand the drivers of health outcomes and identify opportunities to improve medication use and care. You’ll work closely with Evio’s clinical research, product, and technology teams, combining healthcare data expertise with opportunities to learn from teammates across disciplines.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain healthcare analytics tools that help improve how health plan members use medical services and prescription medications
  • Develop and enhance Evio’s digital health tools that deliver clinical insights to physicians in real time at the point of care
  • Collaborate with Evio clinicians to develop real-world evidence (RWE) studies using claims data representing more than 25 million lives
  • Partner with Evio’s technology team to ingest and standardize medical and pharmacy claims data, including developing and improving ETL processes
  • Collaborate across analytics, clinical, and technology teams to identify and implement opportunities for automation and AI

The skills and experience you bring to this role include

  • 5+ years of experience as a healthcare data analyst at a health plan
  • Deep understanding of medical and pharmacy claims data, including claim-line-level analysis
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SQL, Python, and/or comparable analytics and modeling tools
  • Familiarity with Medi-Span or First Databank, HCPCS and CPT coding systems, and their application in healthcare analytics
  • Experience working with large, complex databases and process automation
  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail, with the ability to work collaboratively and translate data into insights that inform decisions
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to evolving priorities, and take ownership of work in a collaborative environment
  • Bachelor’s degree

Salary Considerations

Anticipated annual base pay range: $90,000- $110,000 with additional variable compensation.

At Evio, we’re committed to building a competitive compensation package to honor the value our teammates bring as well as attract and retain top talent that is aligned with our culture, mission and values. Please note that the base pay information shown is a general guideline for the job responsibilities and qualifications listed. Salary decisions are based on candidate experience, market, and business considerations.

Evio Benefits

Evio also offers a number of attractive benefits to eligible teammates including health insurance, retirement savings, life and disability insurance, paid and unpaid time off, and other benefits to make sure Evio teammates and families are well supported.

  • Great Health InsuranceThe company pays 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for teammates, and 50% for dependents.
  • 401K Match
    Evio matches 100% of teammate contribution up to 5% of salary, subject to IRS limits.
  • Time Off
    We have a flexible vacation policy for teammates to unplug and recharge when you need it. There is no minimum or maximum amount of vacation allowed per year, and there is no payment in consideration for unused vacation. Vacation is to be used at your discretion, with approval of leadership.
  • Parental Leave
    Generous paid leave for new parents (includes birth and non-birth parents).

Fraud Notice

We’ve recently learned of fraudulent job postings and individuals falsely claiming to represent Evio. Protecting our candidates is incredibly important to us, and we want to share a few reminders:
  • All official communication will come from an email ending in @evio.com.
  • We will never conduct text-only interviews (Teams, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.).
  • We will never ask for payment, gift cards, fees, or purchases of any kind.
  • We will never request sensitive financial information during the recruiting process.
  • Our open roles are posted only on our official website, LinkedIn, and Greenhouse job board.
If you believe you’ve encountered a scam, you can also report it to the Federal Trade Commission or the Internet Crime Complaint Center. Thank you for your care and vigilance — we’re grateful to everyone who helps keep our community safe.

Information Disclosure

We value transparency in our hiring process and want applicants to understand how your information is used.

We collect and use personal information you provide during the application process such as your resume, employment history, education, interview responses, and other job-related information, to evaluate your qualifications for employment. This may also include limited technical and interaction data, such as IP address and device or browser information.

We may use automated or AI-assisted tools to help review applications, identify qualified candidates, and detect or investigate potentially fraudulent or deceptive activity. Human reviewers remain involved, and these tools support, not replace, human judgment.

These measures support a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please inform us when invited to interview.

California privacy notice Consistent with California law, we use this information for recruiting, hiring, and related business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy and improving our hiring processes.

Overview

Amyx is seeking an experienced CWMD Policy Analyst to support the DHS Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction (CWMD) Advisory & Assistance Services (A&AS) contract. This role provides policy analysis, strategic advisory support, and coordination assistance to CWMD leadership and successor organizations during a period of significant mission and organizational transition.

The Policy Analyst will support development, analysis, and execution of CWMD‑related policies, frameworks, and guidance, with emphasis on CBRN risk, interagency coordination, and alignment with DHS and CISA governance structures. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in fluid policy environments, translating complex missions into actionable policy products for senior decision‑makers.

Responsibilities

CWMD Policy Development & Analysis

*Conduct research and analysis to support CWMD, CBRN, and nuclear‑related policy development, updates, and implementation.*Analyze existing DHS, CWMD, and interagency policies to identify gaps, overlaps, and alignment opportunities.*Support development of policy memoranda, white papers, briefing materials, and decision papers for CWMD and DHS leadership.

Strategic Advisory & Governance Support*Provide advisory support to CWMD leadership on policy implications of mission changes, budget constraints, and organizational realignment.*Support policy oversight activities as CWMD functions transition to or coordinate with CISA, CBP, TSA, and other DHS components. *Assist in maintaining policy continuity during restructuring, ensuring mission requirements remain supported.

Interagency & Stakeholder Coordination*Support coordination with DHS components, interagency partners, and external stakeholders on CWMD policy matters.*Prepare materials and talking points for interagency working groups, governance boards, and executive forums.*Track actions, policy decisions, and follow‑ups to resolution.

Programmatic & A&AS Support*Support A&AS reporting requirements, including inputs to monthly status reports, quarterly reviews, and executive briefings.*Assist in documenting policy‑related risks, issues, and mitigation strategies.*Apply structured approaches to policy analysis to ensure consistency, traceability, and defensibility.

Process Improvement & Change Management*Support development of policy frameworks and playbooks that improve execution efficiency under cost‑sensitive, LPTA‑oriented environments.

Qualifications

*7+ years of experience in policy analysis, strategic planning, or advisory support within a federal, homeland security, or national security environment.*Experience supporting CWMD, CBRN, nuclear security, intelligence, homeland security, or related mission areas.*Demonstrated ability to produce clear, well‑structured policy products for senior Government audiences.*Familiarity with DHS governance, policy development processes, and interagency coordination.*Strong research, writing, and briefing skills.Bachelor’s degree required (Master’s degree preferred) in public policy, national security, international relations, political science, or a related field.

*Prior experience supporting DHS CWMD, CISA, CBP, TSA, or another DHS Headquarters organization.*Experience supporting policy work during organizational restructuring or mission realignment.*Understanding of CWMD policy issues across CBRN, nuclear, intelligence, and risk management domains.*Experience supporting A&AS contracts and performance‑based advisory services.* DHS Suitability, Active Secret or higher clearance.

WHO WE ARE ☝🏼

We are Kintiga (formerly MAP Patient Access, Axtalis, and SKC), a pan-European specialist consultancy that partners with ambitious health technology developers through the complex journey to achieve successful market access across Europe, with our tailored approach, global perspective and local expertise.

Our clients in healthcare and life sciences are leading innovators in pharma, biotech, medtech, digital health, and diagnostics. As part of Kintiga, we support the successful launch and reimbursement of breakthrough therapies and technologies.

Join our team and help shape the future of the cutting-edge healthcare solutions. At Kintiga, we cultivate a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture where every voice matters. We value diversity, openness, and integrity - encouraging our team members to bring their ideas and passion to work every day. Become part of a supportive, dynamic team that thrives on innovation, lifelong learning, and making a meaningful impact in healthcare and life sciences.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🔍

We’re looking for a Senior Consultant who can lead end-to-end projects and major strategic work streams across value and access. You’ll bring strong technical expertise and rigour, alongside excellent project delivery and governance skills. You’ll be confident developing clear, actionable recommendations, building trusted client relationships, and ensuring high-quality delivery. You’ll also play an important role in coaching and developing junior consultants, helping to build capability across the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead value and access projects or major workstreams from set-up through delivery, including planning, methodology, resourcing, quality control, financial awareness and client communication.
  • Provide strategic and technical leadership across payer strategy, global value communications, HTA readiness, policy intelligence, evidence gap assessment, reimbursement planning and stakeholder engagement.
  • Senior-review value dossiers, payer value propositions, HTA strategy outputs, advisory board materials, objection handlers, payer decks, reports and medical writing deliverables.
  • Lead client discussions, workshops and strategic meetings, translating complex evidence and access issues into practical recommendations and next steps.
  • Own project-level delivery economics, anticipating scope, timeline, review and resourcing risks and protecting quality and profitability.
  • Mentor Consultants, Associate Consultants and Analysts, strengthening capability in structured thinking, evidence interpretation, writing quality and client-ready delivery.
  • Support proposal development, project scoping, pitch materials and account growth opportunities.

Essential Requirements

  • Strong experience in market access, value communications, HTA strategy, payer research, HEOR, medical writing or healthcare consulting.
  • Proven ability to lead projects or major workstreams, manage client expectations and deliver high-quality outputs on time and within scope.
  • Strong understanding of global, regional or affiliate payer requirements, HTA systems, pricing and reimbursement pathways and evidence needs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strategic storytelling and senior-review capability.
  • Commercial awareness and ability to manage scope, effort, resourcing, quality and profitability at project level.
  • Experience contributing to business development activities such as proposals, pitch meetings, thought leadership or service offering development.

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience leading international market access, JCA readiness, managed access, rare disease, oncology, ATMP or complex launch projects.
  • Line management or formal coaching experience.

WHAT CAN WE OFFER YOU? 🤩

💰 Competitive Salary (dependent on experience).

🎁 Extensive benefit programme.

👥 Company-wide meet-ups.

🌍 International work environment with cross-border responsibilities.

🌴 Generous annual leave entitlement – 3 of those will be used for our Christmas shutdown.

⭐️ Flexible working – to help maintain a better work/life balance.

We bring together diverse backgrounds and expertise, and our team is dynamic, solutions-focused, and committed to delivering excellence. If you are a results-driven professional looking for an opportunity to gain experience in a growing life sciences organisation, then please apply!

Please note that this role is open to full-time applicants only. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies and, unfortunately, are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Salary: Dependent on Experience

Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive is seeking a Senior Security Technical Program Manager to drive execution of the Security & Privacy Roadmap and other high-priority security risk-reduction programs. You will turn complex security and privacy goals into sequenced, measurable plans; align Security, Product, Engineering, Privacy, Legal, and business partners; and make risks, dependencies, resourcing needs, and decisions visible to executives. You will play a central role in quarterly security planning and in preparing clear, evidence-based, board-ready updates.This role is well suited to a hands-on program leader who can move between technical detail and executive narrative—and who measures success by durable risk reduction and shipped outcomes, not activity alone.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own roadmap execution: Maintain the integrated Security & Privacy Roadmap from intake and prioritization through delivery and operational handoff. Clarify scope, accountable owners, milestones, dependencies, decision points, and success measures across concurrent initiatives.
  • Drive risk-reduction programs: Lead cross-functional execution of major security programs, which may include identity and access management, authorization, vulnerability remediation, auditability, data protection and retention, privacy controls, and security assurance. Keep work tied to explicit risks and customer or business outcomes.
  • Lead quarterly planning: Coordinate planning inputs, capacity and sequencing discussions, prioritization trade-offs, and commitments. Surface gaps early, distinguish committed work from aspirational work, and bring options and recommendations to decision-makers.
  • Establish operating rigor: Run effective program reviews and maintain concise plans, RAID logs, decision records, and dashboards. Track leading indicators and delivery milestones; escalate blockers with clear impact, owner, and recommended next step.
  • Prepare executive and board materials: Develop accurate, board-ready narratives and presentations that explain the risk, why it matters, progress against commitments, measurable outcomes, material changes, and decisions or investments required. Validate claims and metrics with accountable teams.
  • Build strong partnerships: Align technical and nontechnical stakeholders, facilitate decisions when priorities conflict, and communicate with clarity at levels ranging from engineers to senior executives.
  • Improve the system: Identify recurring delivery, governance, or measurement gaps and improve the security program operating model so teams can execute predictably and demonstrate control effectiveness.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs, with meaningful experience in cybersecurity, product security, privacy, or a closely related risk-management domain.
  • A track record of delivering multi-team programs across engineering and business functions, including work with senior leaders and teams that do not report to you.
  • Strong program-management fundamentals: integrated plans, dependency and critical-path management, risk and issue resolution, capacity planning, change control, and outcome-based reporting.
  • Ability to understand security architecture and control objectives well enough to ask precise questions, identify delivery and risk gaps, and translate technical details into business impact—without needing to be the hands-on implementer.
  • Excellent executive writing and presentation skills; experience producing concise leadership updates or board-level materials grounded in verified evidence.
  • Demonstrated an AI first mindset in executing programs vs manually chasing teams to get things done.
  • Sound judgment in prioritizing risk, surfacing uncomfortable trade-offs, and balancing urgency, customer impact, compliance needs, and delivery capacity.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach and the ability to create accountability through influence, structure, and clear communication.

Preferred

  • Experience in a SaaS or technology company with complex products, customer data, and cross-functional security ownership.
  • Familiarity with security and privacy programs such as IAM and authorization, vulnerability management, data lifecycle controls, incident remediation, audit readiness, or privacy engineering.
  • Experience defining program metrics, risk indicators, control evidence, and executive dashboards.

How success will be measured

  • Roadmap initiatives have clear scope, accountable owners, realistic milestones, dependencies, and measurable risk or customer outcomes.
  • Quarterly commitments are prioritized against capacity; material delivery risks and decision needs are raised early, not at the deadline.
  • High-priority security programs deliver agreed milestones and demonstrable risk reduction, with exceptions and residual risk explicitly documented.
  • Leadership and board updates are timely, concise, consistent with source evidence, and decision-ready.
  • Cross-functional partners have a reliable operating cadence and clear visibility into status, trade-offs, and next actions.

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.
The Impact of a Revenue Strategic Programs Director - Change Agent at Coupa:

The Revenue Strategic Programs Director – Change Agent makes sure the field always knows what matters most, what has changed, and what to do next. You will build clear, reliable messaging channels between revenue leadership and the field, so Coupa can move quickly with clarity on revenue-generating priorities and changes.

You will own the change management and field communication layer of Coupa’s revenue programs. That means turning strategy and program decisions into simple, timely, actionable messages, and confirming they land, are understood, and lead to action.

This role suits a communicator and change leader who is just as comfortable shaping the story with executives (CRO & COO) as listening to sellers, managers, and customer-facing teams. You are structured, fast-moving, and relentless about clarity, so that priorities and changes stick.

What You'll Do:

    Field Messaging Channels and Communication Strategy

  • Design, launch, and run clear, consistent channels that carry revenue priorities and changes to the field, so teams know where to look and what to trust.
  • Establish a communication cadence, such as a regular priorities update, a “what changed” digest, and rapid-response notices for urgent shifts.
  • Maintain a single source of truth for current revenue priorities, programs, and process changes, so nothing is lost in channel noise.
  • Translate complex strategy, policy, and program decisions into plain, concise messages written for sellers, managers, and customer-facing teams.
  • Define who needs to know what and when, and tailor messages by region, segment, and role.

    • Change Management and Adoption

  • Lead change management for revenue initiatives, including stakeholder mapping, impact assessment, readiness planning, communications, and reinforcement.
  • Partner with Enablement, Sales Leadership, Customer Success, and Marketing to align messages, training, and tools around each change.
  • Equip frontline managers with talking points, FAQs, and guidance so they can carry changes to their teams with confidence.
  • Track adoption and understanding, then adjust the approach, the message, or the channel when the data says it isn’t landing.

    • Speed and Clarity on Revenue Priorities

  • Work with revenue leaders to sharpen and sequence the top revenue-generating priorities into a short, clear list the field can act on.
  • Cut through competing asks from across the business so the field is not flooded, and the highest-impact messages get through.
  • Shorten the time between a leadership decision and field awareness, and reduce the time from awareness to action.

    • Listening and Feedback Loops

  • Create two-way channels, such as input surveys, manager forums, and field advisory groups, so field feedback shapes how programs are designed and communicated.
  • Act as the voice of the field with leadership, surfacing friction, confusion, and unintended consequences early.
  • Close the loop by showing the field how its input led to changes.

    • Program Partnership and Measurement

  • Support strategic revenue programs with program management discipline, including milestones, owners, dependencies, and status reporting.
  • Define metrics for communication effectiveness and change adoption, such as reach, comprehension, time to action, and behavior change, and connect them to revenue outcomes.
  • Celebrate and motivate participation with clear leaderboards and incentives.
  • Report progress, risks, and lessons learned to the CRO, COO and revenue leadership.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

  • 10+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales strategy or enablement, change management, strategic communications, program management, consulting, or a related field, ideally at a B2B SaaS or technology company.
  • Demonstrated success driving change management and adoption among large, distributed field or sales teams.
  • Exceptional writing and communication skills, with the ability to make complex topics simple, accurate, and actionable.
  • Experience building and running communication channels, cadences, and content for a sales or customer-facing audience.
  • Strong program and project management discipline, including planning, stakeholder management, and status tracking.
  • Working knowledge of revenue metrics and go-to-market motions, such as pipeline, bookings, retention, and sales productivity.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders and frontline teams, and to work across a matrixed global organization.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace, and the judgment to know what the field needs to hear first.
