raw.excerpt: BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies.
raw.description:
BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies. We've harnessed the power of prescriptive AI to revolutionize the way we tackle cyber threats, stopping attacks before they launch.

Named by Gartner® in 48 reports over the last 4 years and recognized as a Tech Innovator for Preemptive Cybersecurity in the 2025 Emerging Tech report, BforeAI is the industry’s fastest, most accurate solution for automated protection against online fraud.

Join us in the fight for a safer cyberspace!

🚀 Why it’s great to work here

We are a location-independent company with a fully distributed team. We believe diversity of experience, background, and thinking leads to stronger teams and a better product. We value autonomy, intellectual honesty, practical decision-making, and engineers who take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for perfectly defined tasks.

We offer an intellectually stimulating company environment and you’ll be working with a bright, dedicated team from across the globe. Additionally, we offer flexible time off, sick days, all public holidays, and stock options.

✨ What’s cool about this job

You will work with a dedicated global team on technically difficult problems involving cybersecurity, distributed systems, data engineering, machine learning, and SaaS product development. You will help turn raw and rapidly changing threat information into dependable product behavior. That means writing production services, defining clear boundaries between components, handling failure deliberately, and making results understandable to operators and customers.

📣 What you’ll be doing

You will build Python and Go services, APIs, and customer features using shared data capabilities delivered by Platform Engineering. You'll work with security researchers to implement production detections and expose the supporting evidence through customer workflows. You'll own defined capabilities from technical design through testing, release, and production support, including resolving implementation details and integration requirements.

  • Build and maintain Python and Go services and APIs for product features and detections.
  • Design features around shared identities, evidence, relationships, and history. Reuse existing data capabilities and resolve interface requirements with Platform Engineering.
  • Turn researcher-developed detection methods into tested production services with defined inputs, outputs, and evaluation criteria.
  • Build APIs that expose threat evidence and support customer investigation workflows, working with Product and frontend engineers.
  • Implement reliable reevaluation and customer updates when underlying evidence or intelligence changes.
  • Test failure handling, detection regressions, and authorization boundaries.
  • Design for safe retries, idempotency, and predictable behavior in asynchronous and event-driven workflows.
  • Enforce tenant isolation and access controls; preserve evidence and source context for results.
  • Add observability, investigate production issues, and improve reliability and performance as usage grows.
  • Contribute designs, code reviews, estimates, and documentation; identify unclear requirements and dependencies.
  • Verify AI-generated code before incorporating it into production software.

💥 You’ll be a great fit if

  • Experience building SaaS products and/or product features on shared data platforms.
  • Experience building, shipping, and supporting backend software in production.
  • Strong proficiency in Python or Go, with willingness to develop proficiency in the other language.
  • Experience designing or implementing APIs and integrating services with databases and external or internal systems.
  • Understanding of asynchronous processing, distributed system failure modes, and practical reliability patterns.
  • Ability to write maintainable code and automated tests, review others’ work, and debug production behavior.
  • An understanding of secure software development, authorization, and protecting customer data.
  • Ability to translate product requirements into service designs and implementations, working with domain specialists to resolve unclear requirements.
  • Understanding of how data quality, freshness, relationships, and access permissions affect feature behavior and customer results.
  • Ability to document decisions and coordinate assigned work in a remote team.
  • Willingness to learn AI-assisted development practices and critically evaluate generated code.

You do not need every item below, but relevant experience may help you have an immediate impact:

  • Production experience with both Python and Go.
  • Experience with cybersecurity products, threat intelligence, or detection engineering.
  • Experience with Azure, event-driven architectures, or multitenant applications.
  • Experience building customer features on a data platform, including consuming shared APIs, data models, graph services, or analytical services.
  • Experience working with researchers or integrating ML outputs into production workflows.
  • Practical experience using AI development tools alongside automated testing and code review.

💻 Our environment

Our Azure-based environment includes Go and Python services, Event Hubs and Kafka-compatible messaging, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Explorer, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis, Databricks for appropriate analytics and machine-learning workloads, Kubernetes, and Azure-managed compute services.

Experience with every component is not required. We care more about whether you understand the engineering principles underneath these technologies, can become productive in an unfamiliar environment, and can choose the appropriate combination of managed services and custom software.

At BforeAI, we're dedicated to building a diverse workplace based on merit, work ethics, and character, and we believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success! If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we hope you’ll still consider applying!

We use an Employee of Record service to facilitate seamless global hiring processes and offer benefits tailored to the country where you will be working! For countries not supported by our EOR partner, talk to us about being a contractor. In all cases, this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship so you will need to be authorized to work in the country you’re based in. We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed.

💡 Want to know more about BforeAI?

  • About BforeAI
  • BforeAI on YouTube
  • Our Values & Benefits at BforeAI
  • Celebrating 41 Gartner® mentions
  • BforeAI has been recognized by Gartner® as a Tech Innovator in the 2025 Emerging Tech

raw.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest is looking for a Brand Partnerships Lead to shape and lead high-impact client partnerships and pop-up programs that connect brands with our platform in creative, meaningful ways. You’ll work across creative, production, experiential, sales and operations partners to bring integrated programs from concept through launch. This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, creative development, and execution, with clear visibility into business impact and room to grow your influence over time.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead end-to-end marketing strategy and execution for mid-to-large client partnership and pop-up programs from concept through launch.
  • Establish program frameworks, planning rhythms and decision points that align business priorities, partner needs and Pinterest brand standards across multiple high-visibility initiatives.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration across creative, production, experiential, sales, and operations teams to keep high-visibility programs moving forward.
  • Manage communication and expectations across assigned programs, building strong relationships and ensuring alignment on timelines, deliverables, feedback, and overall program execution.
  • Establish goals, track milestones, and measure performance against KPIs tied to program success, package volume, and incremental revenue.
  • Turn program learnings into strategic recommendations that influence future partnership offerings, operating models and market-facing opportunities.
  • Use AI to speed early planning, briefing and concept development, while applying judgment and verification to maintain quality.
  • Use AI to summarize learnings, streamline repeatable reporting and help identify opportunities to improve future programs.

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in integrated marketing, brand partnerships, experiential marketing or program leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in leading complex partnership or pop-up programs from planning through launch, with clear ties to business and revenue goals.
  • Experience in partnering across creative, production, experiential, sales, and operations to move cross-functional work forward.
  • Experience in translating business priorities into clear plans, timelines, and integrated go-to-market approaches.
  • Experience ideating on and reviewing creative work, upholding brand standards, and giving clear feedback that strengthens ideas and execution.
  • Experience in using performance insights and business context to recommend changes that improve future partnership strategy, planning and execution.
  • High integrity and ownership in handling sensitive information, avoiding over-reliance on AI and staying accountable for final decisions and deliverables.

Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

  • We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6 months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

#REMOTE

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

US based applicants only
$120,321—$247,718 USD

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support.
By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.

raw.title: SMB Account Manager - US-Based
raw.excerpt: About ToptalToptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand.
raw.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Our Account Managers grow and retain Toptal’s small- and medium-sized business clients. You will own a book of high-value SMB accounts, become a trusted advisor to each client, and proactively expand each relationship across Toptal’s full portfolio, including specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

This is a high-energy, consultative growth role. You will look beyond the transactional request to understand the business problem behind it, identify needs the client has not yet voiced, and build account plans that turn one successful engagement into a broader partnership. Excellence in this role means asking better questions than the clients expect, keeping every engagement healthy, and consistently turning insight into expansion revenue.

You will own the full client lifecycle. You will be the primary point of contact for your accounts, guide clients through active projects, resolve issues before they stall decisions or put the relationship at risk, and know when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise. You will work closely with Talent Operations, Delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptal’s services experts to deliver an exceptional experience while driving growth.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be recognized for the growth you create, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Own the Portfolio: You are the dedicated advisor and primary point of contact for a portfolio of SMB accounts, accountable for their retention, growth, and success. You exercise discretion and independent judgment in how you prioritize and grow each account.
  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You run insight-driven conversations with clients to understand the business objective behind each request, assess account health, and uncover challenges Toptal can solve. You earn the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Account Planning: You build and execute proactive account plans that connect each client’s business goals to the right Toptal offering, with clear next steps, timing, and expansion targets.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You expand accounts across Toptal’s full portfolio, including specialized talent, HireGlobal for global hiring and payroll, and our AI-driven, platform-powered services offerings, positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction talent vendor.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win Expansion: You own expansion from identification through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close across departments, projects, and offerings. You explain why the relevant offering fits and address concerns, bringing in teammates as subject-matter experts for specialized offerings and working with internal specialists and experts for solution expertise and scoping. You own the client relationship. You maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce (SFDC).
  • Uncover Value Early: You monitor demand signals and platform data to offer “uncovered value,” identifying needs before the client voices them, and you use outreach and engagement campaigns, including Salesloft cadences, to educate clients on Toptal’s full breadth of services.
  • Own the Client Experience: You own the client relationship and the client’s experience of every engagement, from kickoff onward. You stay close to active work, address concerns with a client-first mindset, and partner with Talent Operations and Delivery, who execute the work, to keep engagements on track so that retention is earned through results.
  • First Line of Defense: You are the first to respond when a client raises an issue, resolving smaller concerns yourself and escalating to Client Experience when an issue needs more than you can solve on your own. You partner with Talent Operations, Delivery, HireGlobal, and services experts to bring the right expertise into an account at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Meet colleagues across Customer, Talent Operations, Delivery, and HireGlobal to begin your onboarding journey.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the Account Manager did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales and vertical-specific training, demonstrating fluency in our full range of talent, HireGlobal, and services offerings, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Begin joining client calls, learning who the business partners are on both sides of each relationship and where Toptal can help them grow.
  • Review and prioritize your portfolio, and draft an initial account plan for each of your accounts.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Complete all onboarding and portfolio transitions, and establish yourself as the primary point of contact for your accounts through introduction and discovery calls.
  • Establish a working cadence with key clients and with the team members supporting those accounts, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. Run account health check-ins that surface at least one new business need beyond the client’s original request.
  • Build a qualified expansion pipeline across your portfolio based on priority account plans with consistently high-performing call-quality metrics and accurate forecasts maintained in SFDC.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Execute your account plans and consistently meet or exceed your defined revenue and expansion metrics, with a clear pattern of organic growth across your portfolio.
  • Expand the scope of engagements to include new departments, projects, and offerings, including HireGlobal and services opportunities.
  • Identify where expansion opportunities lose momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Demonstrate portfolio net revenue growth through sustained retention and expansion performance, with a consistent qualified pipeline of new opportunities across your accounts.
  • Be a trusted advisor to your clients, and a reference point for the team on maintaining forecast accuracy, account planning excellence, and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Mentor new team members, sharing best practices on Toptal’s model and on moving from transactional to consultative account management.
  • Position yourself for senior-level partnership responsibilities.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 3+ years of B2B account management or sales experience, with a demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding revenue-based quotas.
  • 1+ years of experience in a software consulting or tech sales role, with proficiency navigating the software project lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated experience growing and retaining existing client accounts, including proactively creating and closing expansion opportunities, reaching new decision makers, and connecting new business needs to additional solutions.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of accounts in parallel and maintaining momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Ability to translate a client’s business objectives into recommendations and actionable project scopes that demonstrate Toptal’s value.
  • Experience maintaining accurate pipeline, forecast, and account data in a CRM.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a diverse array of clients and competing deadlines. Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to a named sales methodology, such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

These are what we assess for in interviews and coach against after you join.

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You uncover the “why” behind a client’s request.
  • Proactive ownership. You do not wait for a client to name a new opportunity or voice dissatisfaction. You analyze their trajectory, spot gaps, needs, and roadblocks before they occur, and you own the outcome, successes and failures alike.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk, and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation, stay current on industry trends, and are willing to respectfully reframe a client’s thinking when their stated request is not the best path to their goal.
  • Portfolio thinking. You see beyond the single engagement and can position specialized talent, HireGlobal, and services offerings as parts of one growth plan.
  • Account discipline. You bring consistent, disciplined account management and process adherence, including rigorous SFDC hygiene, to execute account strategies and long-term growth.
  • Client-centricity. You are committed to the client’s success, across the talent we provide, the experience we offer, and the outcomes we deliver, and you are direct about fit when Toptal is not the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive, with yourself first, and optimistic and ambitious in the face of change. You want to exceed targets, not just meet them.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You seek feedback, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Collaborative and grounded. Nothing we do is done in isolation. You work as a team within Toptal and within client accounts, and you don’t take yourself too seriously. We are a high-performance team that values authenticity and wit.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

About the Role

We are seeking an Email Marketing Specialist to support a fast-growing US real estate team by creating, managing, and optimizing email marketing campaigns that generate leads, nurture prospects, and strengthen client relationships. This role requires someone who is highly organized, analytical, and experienced in marketing automation, CRM management, and customer journey optimization within the real estate industry.

Key ResponsibilitiesEmail Marketing & Campaign Management

  • Plan, create, schedule, and deploy email marketing campaigns for buyers, sellers, investors, and past clients.

  • Build automated email sequences for lead nurturing, follow-ups, appointment reminders, listing alerts, and re-engagement campaigns.

  • Develop compelling email copy and subject lines that drive engagement and conversions.

  • Ensure all campaigns align with the client's branding, messaging, and marketing goals.

CRM & Marketing Automation

  • Manage and maintain CRM databases, ensuring accurate contact segmentation and list hygiene.

  • Build and optimize automation workflows based on lead behavior, lifecycle stage, and engagement.

  • Integrate email campaigns with CRM and marketing platforms to improve customer experience.

  • Monitor lead flow and ensure timely follow-up communications.

Audience Segmentation

  • Buyers

  • Sellers

  • Investors

  • Past Clients

  • New Leads

  • Geographic Markets

  • Engagement Level

  • Personalize campaigns to improve open rates, click-through rates, and conversions.

Performance Reporting & Optimization

  • Open Rate

  • Click-Through Rate (CTR)

  • Conversion Rate

  • Bounce Rate

  • Unsubscribe Rate

  • Lead-to-Appointment Conversion

  • Conduct A/B testing on subject lines, content, send times, and CTAs.

  • Provide regular reports and recommendations to improve campaign performance.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with the real estate agents, transaction coordinators, ISA teams, and marketing staff.

  • Coordinate email campaigns around new listings, open houses, market updates, newsletters, and promotional events.

  • Support broader digital marketing initiatives as needed.

QualificationsRequired

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in email marketing, digital marketing, or marketing automation.

  • Experience supporting a US real estate company, brokerage, or real estate marketing agency is highly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of lead nurturing and customer lifecycle marketing.

  • Experience using CRM and email marketing platforms such as:

  • Mailchimp

  • ActiveCampaign

  • HubSpot

  • Follow Up Boss

  • GoHighLevel

  • kvCORE

  • Lofty (formerly Chime)

  • Constant Contact

  • Brevo (Sendinblue)

  • Excellent copywriting and proofreading skills.

  • Strong analytical and reporting skills.

  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred

Significance is seeking an Oracle Database Administrator to support a long-term federal program with the Department of Energy (DOE). This role is fully remote.

Security Requirements:Must be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities: As the Database Administrator Intermediate uou will perform systems database administration support services for DOE applications. This support will be for all environments including but not limited to Development, Sandbox, Test, Performance, Training, and Production.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Perform database administration for Oracle Portal and the core databases supporting DOE applications.
  • Install, configure, patch, upgrade, troubleshoot, and maintain Oracle Fusion Middleware products, including WebLogic Server, Oracle WebCenter (Portal/UCM), OID, and OAM.
  • Design, implement, and advise on Oracle Single Sign-On (SSO), Oracle Internet Directory (OID), Oracle Access Manager (OAM), and Universal Content Management (UCM).
  • Administer and tune WebLogic domains, managed servers, clusters, and data sources.
  • Use Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) to monitor, alert on, and automate proactive issue handling for databases and middleware.
  • Support data warehouse environments, including database design, ETL performance, and storage and capacity planning.
  • Support administration of on-premises and cloud-hosted databases in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Microsoft Azure.
  • Recommend and implement database and middleware security policies, including SSL/TLS certificate management.
  • Recommend and implement backup, recovery, and redundancy strategies, and support disaster recovery operations.
  • Continuously monitor databases for storage space, availability, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Working independently, perform performance analysis, capacity planning, system sizing, and ongoing maintenance.
  • With the CBS and OCIO teams, perform periodic database health checks and prepare quality assurance and performance reviews covering business requirements, testing, upgrades, architecture, and storage changes.
  • Provide break/fix support, including identifying and resolving production defects and implementing stabilization changes. Remediate cybersecurity findings.
  • Review Oracle’s quarterly Critical Patch Updates (CPUs), give feedback to system owners, and coordinate testing and implementation with system owners and OCIO across all environments.
  • Maintain system documentation, including baseline configurations, installations, upgrades, security, and event logs.
  • Work with system owners and CBS security staff to provide input for the annual Assessment & Authorization (A&A) and ATO.
  • Establish and maintain SOPs that ensure database security, integrity, and accuracy.
    Support internal and external data calls.
  • Support evaluation and adoption of Oracle AI Database 26ai features as DOE modernizes.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline from an accredited institution and 5 years of relevant experience; without a degree, 6–8 years of relevant experience is required.
  • At least two-thirds of that experience as a DBA/middleware administrator supporting Oracle OID, OAM, and SSO in enterprise environments. Oracle Portal/WebCenter experience is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience administering Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle Fusion Middleware.
  • Strong understanding of Oracle Database and its utilities and tools, including Oracle Enterprise Manager.
  • Strong knowledge of performance tuning and monitoring.
  • Strong knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • Good understanding of Oracle security management and data integrity.
  • Good knowledge of load balancers, storage, and cloud environments.
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
  • Experience with code migration, database change management, and data management across the development lifecycle.

Desired Skills:

  • Experience with Oracle Federal Financials and/or Oracle Hyperion environments.
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including Autonomous Database, Base Database Service, and Exadata Cloud.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, including Oracle Database@Azure and Azure VM-hosted Oracle workloads.
  • Data warehouse administration experience (Oracle DW, ADW, or similar).
    Exposure to Oracle AI Database 26ai, including AI Vector Search and other new features.
  • Certifications such as Oracle Autonomous Database Cloud Professional, OCI Architect, Oracle WebLogic Administrator, or Microsoft Azure Administrator/Database Administrator.
  • Ability to analyze business and functional requirements and recommend solutions across database, middleware, and cloud platforms.
  • Experience supporting a federal ATO/A&A process.
    · Oracle Autonomous Database Cloud Professional certification
    · Ability to analyze a range of business and functional requirements to recommend optimal solutions

raw.description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

  • Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake
  • Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities
  • Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond
  • Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time
  • Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region
  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8–12 territory managers
  • Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge
  • Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts
  • Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies
  • Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts
  • timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution
  • Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments
  • Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions
  • Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

  • Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards
  • Manage regional budgets and resources effectively
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline
  • Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience in a district / regional manager role
  • Proven success leading specialty sales teams and exceeding performance goals
  • Prior launch experience required; first-launch / startup biotech experience strongly preferred
  • Experience in cardiovascular, nephrology, hypertension, or related specialty markets strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success in recruiting and developing top talent
  • Strong business planning, analytical, and coaching skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment
  • Willingness to travel extensively within region

Leadership Profile

  • A strong coach who develops people and builds winning teams
  • Highly accountable, with a bias for action and urgency
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping build infrastructure
  • Collaborative and able to influence across functions
  • Resilient, adaptable, and energized by launch environments

Travel

  • This position requires up to 60% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

US Salary Range: $180,000 - $215,000

raw.description:
Job Type: Full-Time l Location: San Francisco, CA l Department: AI Infrastructure Supply Chain l Reporting to: Director, Supply Chain Analytics | Work Location Type: #hybrid

IREN is a leading AI Cloud Service Provider, delivering large-scale GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s vertically integrated platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and data centers in renewable-rich regions across the U.S. and Canada.

The Senior Supply Chain Analyst enables the modernization of IREN’s global supply chain systems and tools portfolio by turning data into decisions: forecasts, supplier risk signals, should-cost models, Clear to Build dashboards, and AI-assisted workflows that enable the Supply Chain team to scale. Reporting to the Director, Supply Chain Analytics & Engineering, this individual will shape the analysis, modeling and AI layer on top: framing the business question, building envisioning solutions, and applying LLM and agentic tools to supply chain work.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way - responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

  • Bachelor's degree in statistics, data science, engineering, economics, supply chain or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years in analytics, data science or applied AI, with at least 2 years working on supply chain, procurement, operations or finance problems.
  • Program management experience supporting multi-team and function implementations of tools, processes, or solutions.

  • Strong understanding of supply chain processes, tools, stakeholder interactions, and processes and experience working with ERP/MRP, CLM, PLM, QMS tools
  • Hands-on experience applying LLMs to business workflows: prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation over internal documents, evaluation of outputs, and building small tools or agents with current APIs and frameworks.
  • Proficiency in a BI tool (Power BI, Tableau or Looker) and in designing metrics people trust.
  • Working knowledge of supply chain processes – source-to-contract, procure-to-pay, planning, inventory, logistics – and the decisions each one turns on.
  • Experience with procurement and supplier-risk platforms (Coupa, Ariba, Ivalua, Craft, Interos, Resilinc) or supply-market intelligence sources.
  • Demonstrated experience building and validating forecasting or predictive models that were used in real decisions, and explaining their limits to non-technical audiences.
  • Prefer experience in data center, AI infrastructure, energy, construction or other capital-project-heavy industries with long-lead equipment (GPUs, networking, transformers, switchgear, generators).

Other important requirements
  • Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing may be required according to company policies.
  • Must be able to reliably commute to the assigned office location on scheduled in-office days under the hybrid work arrangement.
  • This role requires willingness to travel domestically and internationally to supplier and vendor sites, data centers, implementation partner locations, and industry events. IREN does not yet have an office in the Bay Area (a Santa Clara office is planned); until it opens, this role will work remotely, transitioning to hybrid on-site work once the office is established.

Requirements

  • Support cross-functional implementations of analytics, dashboards, and AI-based tools by program managing requirements across stakeholders.
  • Own the recurring supply chain analytics output creation and execution: spend analysis, supplier performance scorecards, lead-time and on-time-delivery tracking, inventory health and transformation KPIs, built on the governed datasets the Data Engineer maintains.
  • Frame business questions from procurement, planning, finance and capital projects as analytical problems, and deliver answers with clear recommendations, not just dashboards.
  • Build and validate forecasting models for demand, lead times and delivery dates on long-lead equipment, and should-cost and price-trend models for key categories.
  • Partner with Risk Manager to develop supplier-risk and delivery-risk AI-based tool/dashboard
  • Prototype optimization and scenario models (inventory policy, allocation across sites, sourcing mix) and hand production-ready logic to the Data Engineer for deployment.
  • Identify and deliver LLM and agentic use cases across the supply chain: extracting terms and specs from contracts, quotes and datasheets; summarizing and comparing RFx responses; supplier research and discovery; drafting supplier communications; triaging PO, invoice and shipment exceptions.
  • Build these as repeatable tools with prompts, retrieval over internal documents, evaluation sets and human-in-the-loop checks, in line with IREN's AI and data-security policies.
  • Partner with the Supply Chain Data Engineer on data requirements, definitions and quality issues surfaced by analysis; raise them early and specifically.

Benefits

The IREN Package
At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.
Compensation
  • The expected base salary for this role USD $190,000-$240,000/annum.
    • Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market data for the region.
  • Total Compensation package may be inclusive of annual incentive bonus, equity (long-term incentive).
  • Relocation or Living-out-allowance / per diem (as appliable and based on successful candidate circumstances)
Health & Wellness
  • 100% company paid health insurance premiums (medical, dental, and vision) for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents
  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary life, critical illness, and accident coverage available
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) – when combined with the High Deductible Health Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources
Retirement & Financial Wealth
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Access to financial planning and legal services
Time Off & Leave Programs
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
Growth & Development
  • Internal skills training and advancement pathways
  • Professional development to support certifications, continuing education, or role related training
Community & Culture
  • Company events and team-building activities
We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!

We are committed to evaluating qualified applicants and do not discriminate against protected characteristics under applicable legislation.

raw.description:
React Native Mobile Application Developer

Start Date: November 2026

Job Type: Full-Time

Labor Category: TECH

Location: Remote

Xentity is seeking to fill a React Native Mobile Application Developer position to lead the development and continued enhancement of mobile applications supporting the wildland fire community. The developer will be responsible for designing and implementing mobile experiences used by field personnel and fire management teams, with an emphasis on reliable operation in challenging environments where connectivity may be limited or unavailable.

The position will focus primarily on React Native mobile application development while also contributing to Xentity's React-based web applications. The successful candidate will have hands-on experience developing and supporting at least one production mobile application that has been published to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and will be able to demonstrate their specific development contributions to that application.

The developer will work extensively with React Native, offline application capabilities, local data storage, mobile mapping, and Esri ArcGIS technologies. The role requires an understanding of the complete mobile application lifecycle, including local development, testing, application configuration, signing, builds, and store submission processes. The developer will not be responsible for operating the mobile CI/CD deployment pipeline, but must have sufficient knowledge of mobile build and deployment processes to define requirements, troubleshoot issues, and effectively support the team responsible for mobile CI/CD.

Position Scope

  • Lead the design and development of React Native mobile applications supporting wildland fire operations and field personnel.
  • Develop mobile applications designed to operate reliably in remote and low-connectivity environments, including offline mapping and data capabilities.
  • Implement mobile mapping functionality using Esri ArcGIS technologies, including maps, feature layers, geographic data, and offline workflows.
  • Work closely with backend, GIS, and web application developers to integrate mobile applications with APIs, data services, and existing Xentity application platforms.
  • Provide technical guidance to the mobile CI/CD team regarding application build requirements, environment configuration, signing, provisioning, testing, and App Store/Google Play release requirements.
  • Troubleshoot mobile build, device, operating system, performance, connectivity, and application issues and work with the appropriate team members to resolve them.
  • Help establish approaches for offline data storage, synchronization, caching, and recovery for field applications.
  • Support application testing across iOS and Android devices and operating system versions.
  • Work directly with product owners, project managers, GIS specialists, UX designers, and wildland fire subject matter experts to translate operational requirements into effective mobile solutions.

Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience.

Required Requirements

  • Must be US Citizen to meet government contract requirements
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a position of Public Trust clearance
  • Demonstrated professional experience developing React Native mobile applications.
  • Must have been a developer on one or more production mobile applications published to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and be able to describe their specific development role and contributions.
  • Strong experience with React Native and TypeScript.
  • Experience developing mobile mapping applications and working with geospatial data in an offline or constrained-connectivity environment.
  • Required experience with Esri ArcGIS technologies, including the ArcGIS Maps SDK for React Native or equivalent ArcGIS mobile development technologies.
  • Ability to design mobile applications that efficiently manage maps, geographic data, feature layers, and other potentially large datasets on mobile devices.
  • Understanding of Android and iOS application development requirements, including application configuration, permissions, certificates, provisioning, signing, builds, and store requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively with a mobile CI/CD team and provide technical requirements and guidance for mobile builds, testing, signing, and deployment.
  • Experience troubleshooting mobile application issues across both Android and iOS.
  • Strong understanding of mobile application performance, memory management, storage, connectivity, and battery considerations.
  • Experience with Git and modern software development practices.
  • Ability to collaborate with UX designers, web developers, GIS developers, backend developers, project managers, and technical leads.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Demonstrated experience implementing offline-capable mobile applications, including local data storage, synchronization, caching, and handling intermittent or unavailable network connectivity.
  • Experience developing native Android applications using Kotlin.
  • Experience developing native iOS applications using Swift.
  • Experience building React Native applications that incorporate native Android or iOS modules.
  • Experience implementing offline GIS workflows, including offline maps, feature data, synchronization, and conflict handling.
  • Experience with Esri ArcGIS Maps SDK for Native Apps, ArcGIS Runtime, ArcGIS Feature Services, ArcGIS Online, or related Esri technologies.
  • Experience with local mobile databases or storage technologies such as SQLite.
  • Familiarity with OAuth and Authentication frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Geospatial formats like KMZ, KML, GeoJSON, Shapeful, FileGDB.
  • Familiarity with Agentic Pair Programming and VS Code.

Job Goal:

  • First 30 days
    • Familiarity with the Application stack and current application and codebase
    • Familiarity with the backlog of tickets and roadmap of the applications
    • Applications running on development platform and able to contribute changes
  • First 60 days
    • Completed ticket work from assigned backlog
  • First 90 days
    • Providing feedback and support with backlog refinement and ticket prioritization and clarity
  • First Year Job Goal
    • Full understanding of application. Deployment of main mobile applications and supporting portfolio of applications.
Salary: 90k- 100k

raw.description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.
Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.
We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.
But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.
At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.
The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

This is the role that owns the first impression. From the moment someone lands on our homepage to the point they hand over their payment details, you’ll shape every critical step. We’re redesigning how millions of pet lovers discover and join TrustedHousesitters - and this hire will lead that work. If you’ve spent your career moving conversion needles, experimenting relentlessly, and building beautiful product at speed, this is your next chapter.

The Role: Experimental, Visual, and Commercial

You’ll own the full acquisition and onboarding experience at TrustedHousesitters - web and mobile - sitting within the New Member Revenue squad. That means everything from the homepage and landing pages through to registration flows, onboarding nudges, and first payment. You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data, CRM, and our CRO Manager, and you’ll have real ownership of the experimentation roadmap for your area.

The challenge is genuinely interesting. Our product is loved - but our acquisition experience needs to match that. We’re running ‘Project Heartbeat’: a push to make TrustedHousesitters feel as aspirational as Airbnb, peppering real trust signals and community moments into journeys that currently skew too utilitarian. You’ll need to balance a high visual bar with a rigorous test-and-learn mindset. Neither alone is enough.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the acquisition journey end-to-end: From homepage to first payment - web-first, with mobile increasingly in scope - including landing pages, onboarding flows, and lifecycle nudges.

  • Drive conversion through experimentation: Co-own the experimentation roadmap with our CRO Manager: frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and ship rapid tests. You should be able to name the number your last test moved.

  • Raise the visual bar: Strong UI craft is a non-negotiable - every surface you touch should feel considered, current, and well-executed.

  • Translate insight into shipped product: Self-serve with Amplitude, turn quantitative and qualitative signals into testable ideas, and move quickly from insight to design.

  • Shape strategy, not just output: Partner with product, engineering, data, and commercial teams - your voice should be in the room before decisions are made, not after.

    Who you are:

    • The Growth Designer: You’ve owned acquisition or conversion work in-house, at pace - and you can tell the story of an experiment you ran, the hypothesis behind it, and the number it moved.

    • The Visual Craftsperson: Your portfolio stops people. You’ve worked where the visual bar is genuinely high and you hold yourself to that standard regardless of where you are.

    • The Hypothesis Writer: You think in problems before solutions - you can frame a clear problem statement, propose a test, and explain why that test design makes sense.

    • The Collaborator: You treat design as a shared effort, not a hand-off - you partner closely with PMs, engineers, data, and CRM and you’re a stronger designer for it.

    • The B2C Product Thinker: You’ve worked on consumer products - ideally marketplaces or subscriptions - and you understand how trust is built digitally and what actually makes someone convert.

    The Process:

    We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient process:

    1. Talent Screen: A 20-minute conversation with our Talent team to cover your background, motivations, and the role in detail.

    2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 30-minute call with our Director of Design - a two-way conversation about your craft, your approach to growth design, and whether TrustedHousesitters is the right fit for you.

    3. Portfolio & Technical Review: A deeper session with the team focused on your case studies, your experimentation thinking, and your approach to strategic and UX challenges.

    4. Final Stage: You’ll share a high-level view of what you’d focus on in your first 90 days - not a polished strategy, just your honest read of the opportunity and what you’d want to dig into.

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

💻 Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually
  • Generous equity package for permanent employees
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus
If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!
In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).
At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. Offers of employment into TrustedHousesitters are based solely on individual merit, qualifications, and the person's professional suitability.
Gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or beliefs, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy or maternity status, or any other protected characteristics do not enter into our decision-making process.

raw.description:
Coconut Software is the leading Branch Performance Platform, helping financial institutions grow, drive productivity, and deliver better customer experiences. Coconut's AI-powered, enterprise-grade platform brings together appointment scheduling, in-branch queuing, video banking, and branch workforce management, turning customer interaction and operational data into actionable insights across multiple lines of business. The result: greater visibility into performance, better use of workforce capacity, and smarter decisions that drive stronger branch outcomes.Trusted by 200+ banks and credit unions, including RBC, Mountain America Credit Union, and M&T Bank, Coconut Software turns every interaction and staffing decision into a competitive advantage.

As Engineering Manager, Enablement, you'll lead one of the teams in our Enablement Engineering pillar. These teams build and run the infrastructure, data, tooling, service standards, and customer implementation capabilities that every Coconut product team and many of our Enterprise clients depend on.Reporting to the Director, Engineering Enablement, you'll be the people leader and delivery owner for your team. Unlike our product development teams, Enablement teams don't have a dedicated Product Manager or Designer. You'll own intake and capacity planning for your team, with support from your Director and in partnership with our wider Product Management and Product Design teams.

We're looking for someone who has run one or more flavours of engineering enablement and who thrives where two things meet: building stable, high-trust teams, and keeping roadmaps and deliverables flexible enough to respond to what the business and our customers need next.

Engineering @ Coconut:

  • We innovate on top of a modern solution stack: web technologies (React and Laravel) on a RESTful architecture, backed by relational DBs (MySQL and PostgreSQL), all deployed on AWS. You don't need to be an expert in our specific technologies, but real depth in at least one enablement domain is important
  • We don't follow rigid Scrum, but we do run our teams in an iterative way, focusing on continuously improving delivery and implementing what works for us
  • We foster a blameless culture, balancing open communication and continuous improvement with high accountability and ownership
  • [Note: On Call] Our Enablement teams take part in Engineering's collaborative on-call rotation, supporting the systems that keep Coconut available and reliable. As Engineering Manager, Enablement, you'll be available to support your teams' on-call rotations, direct their rotation schedules, train them on our incident playbooks, and support them through playbook runs when needed

YOU'RE FIRED UP TO CONTRIBUTE TO

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the engineers on your teams, covering all aspects of people management: hiring, onboarding, 1:1s, feedback, performance management, and career growth
  • Build stable, high-trust teams where people feel safe to raise risks, challenge ideas, and learn from incidents
  • Lead teams with different working rhythms, from roadmap-driven platform work to interrupt-driven operational and customer work, and help each team find a cadence that works
  • Create opportunities for knowledge sharing, cross-training, and pairing across teams to reduce single points of failure

Intake, Prioritization, & Capacity Planning

  • Own intake for your teams: gather, clarify, and triage requests from Product Engineering, Professional Services, Security, and other internal partners
  • Own capacity planning, balancing roadmap commitments, platform health and tech debt, operational demand, and customer implementation work
  • Partner with the wider Product Management and Product Design teams to shape requirements, validate priorities, and keep enablement work aligned with the product roadmap
  • Work with your Director to turn the Enablement roadmap into team-level plans with clear objectives and success measures, and flag trade-offs early when priorities compete
  • Re-sequence work as needs change, while protecting team focus and sustainable pace

Delivery & Operational Excellence

  • Help your teams design, plan, and deliver quality, secure, well-documented work following best practices throughout the SDLC
  • Own on-call scheduling for your teams. Make sure engineers are trained on incident playbooks and supported through incident response
  • Facilitate blameless incident reviews and drive follow-through on action items
  • Track and report on team delivery and health metrics (e.g., commitment hit rate, reliability, cloud cost, developer experience)
  • Champion automation and continuous improvement to reduce toil and manual work

Technical Leadership

  • Bring enough technical depth to guide design discussions, review plans, and make sound calls within your teams' domains. You won't be hands-on in the code day to day
  • Partner with the Principal Engineer and other Engineering Managers on technical standards, reference architectures, and paved-road tooling
  • Help your teams adopt AI-assisted ways of working in line with Engineering's AI focus and objectives, and make the impact visible

Customer & Cross Functional Partnership

  • Support Professional Services in delivering customer implementations and integrations, including working directly with Enterprise clients and their technical teams when needed
  • Engage confidently with Enterprise client stakeholders: scoping work, setting expectations, and working through technical issues together
  • Work with Product Engineering, Product Management, Product Design, and Security to remove dependencies and blockers
  • Work with the engineering leadership team to define, implement, and champion department-wide standards and processes

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

  • Proven experience running one or more flavours of engineering enablement, such as platform engineering, DevOps/SRE, or data engineering
  • Proven experience managing engineering teams: coaching, mentoring, performance management, and setting individual and team goals (min 3 yrs of people leadership experience)
  • Prior hands-on engineering experience in an enablement domain, with working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, web application development, and/or modern engineering practices
  • Experience owning intake, prioritization, and capacity planning without a dedicated Product Manager
  • You thrive at the intersection of team trust and stability and roadmap flexibility: you build steady rhythms and strong teams, and you adapt plans when priorities shift
  • Experience leading teams that are on call, including incident response, playbooks, and blameless reviews
  • Comfortable working directly with Enterprise clients and their technical teams
  • Effective at nurturing relationships and managing multiple stakeholders across different teams
  • Someone who is genuinely passionate about our CHEERS values and is committed to living them out every day
  • Driven by the value that 'how we win matters' and a passion for building inclusive, collaborative teams that put people first
  • A curiosity for innovation: We're looking for someone who loves to learn and elevate their skills with new technology, particularly AI/LLMs
    • You should have a foundational understanding of how these tools work and a strong desire to explore how they can be used to solve business and customer problems
    • We value continuous learning and our ideal candidate has a proven track record of innovating and pushing the boundaries of what's possible
  • Experience leading more than one enablement discipline simultaneously is a nice to have
  • Experience in fintech, banking, enterprise SaaS, or platform/API-based products is a nice to have

Technical Product Manager @Splyt

About Splyt

Splyt is the leading global network for mobility and lifestyle services. Our technology integrates ridehailing, airport transfers, micromobility and public transport into our partners’ platforms, so they can unlock the world for their customers. Splyt has a remote working environment with colleagues based in Singapore, Malaysia, Dubai and Europe - but we feel at home anywhere. Our amazing partners are the largest in the business, with over 2 billion users in total, and we are constantly expanding our footprint beyond the 150 countries we already cover.

The role

We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager to help scale and strengthen our partner integrations and drive the evolution of our platform. You’ll play a key role in managing and supporting both existing partnerships and new product initiatives — with a strong focus on API-based solutions. You’ll be part of the Product team and work closely with Engineering, Commercial, Operations, and Partner Support. This role will suit someone who’s not just product-savvy but also technically confident, and who enjoys working at the intersection of business, tech, and customer needs. This role reports to the Head of Product.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the product lifecycle for key integrations with our partners — from planning to launch and ongoing improvements.
  • Proactively manage relationships with existing partners to ensure their success and continued growth on the Splyt platform.
  • Act as a technical consultant for our partners and product managers.
  • Help BD to close deals through supporting them from a technical point of view during sales pitch.
  • Collaborate closely with new prospects (both signed and in the pipeline) to understand requirements and guide them through technical onboarding.
  • Translate partner and business needs into clear product requirements and work closely with engineering, design, and operations teams to deliver them.
  • Support the rollout of new product features and initiatives that enhance the partner and user experience.
  • Act as a bridge between internal stakeholders (engineering, commercial, operations, support) and external partners to align on timelines, goals, and priorities.
  • Contribute to product strategy by identifying opportunities and pain points through market insights and partner feedback.

Who we are looking for

Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 3 years of experience in a product management role, ideally in a B2B or platform-based environment.
  • Hands-on experience managing technical/API-driven products and integrations.
  • Comfortable working directly with APIs — including testing endpoints using tools like cURL or Postman — and familiar with common integration patterns.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills — you’re just as comfortable in a technical discussion as you are in a business meeting.
  • Ability to juggle multiple projects and relationships at once, with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with distributed teams.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, SDKs, and common integration patterns (you don’t need to code, but you should be fluent in “developer speak”).

Skills & Competencies

  • Technical aptitude – ability to understand and engage in technical conversations, especially around APIs, architecture, and data flow.
  • Product thinking – strong intuition for great user experiences and product-market fit, with an ability to turn problems into solutions.
  • Excellent communication – can clearly articulate product ideas, requirements, and decisions across diverse audiences (technical and non-technical).
  • Stakeholder management – confident working with internal teams (engineering, ops, commercial) and external partners to drive alignment and delivery.
  • Project management – organized, detail-oriented, and capable of driving complex projects forward while managing timelines and expectations.
  • Adaptability – thrives in ambiguity and is quick to pivot when priorities change.
  • Analytical mindset – uses data to inform decisions, validate assumptions, and track product performance.
  • Customer-centricity – deeply empathetic towards users and partners, always seeking to improve their experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in mobility, travel, or marketplace platforms, with an understanding of their unique challenges and dynamics.
  • Experience in leveraging analytics and data to inform product decisions and measure impact.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken Business Chinese for effective communication with regional technical stakeholders.

What we can offer you:

  • Exposure to global platform operations
  • Competitive salary
  • Work from home within your country of residence and work eligibility
  • Subsidised lunches
  • Private healthcare

  • React

  • Google Cloud Platform
