raw.title: Werkstudent/in Linkbuilding & Outreach (m/w/d) | Remote
raw.excerpt: Wer sind wir? Entstanden sind wir aus Deutschlands größter Finanzbildungsorganisation.
raw.description:
Wer sind wir?

Entstanden sind wir aus Deutschlands größter Finanzbildungsorganisation. Über 250.000 jungen Menschen haben wir gezeigt, wie Finanzen wirklich funktionieren. Aus dieser Mission ist Finanzklar entstanden. Denn Wissen allein reicht nicht – die meisten Menschen scheitern nicht am Verstehen, sondern an der Umsetzung.

Genau hier setzen wir an: Wir helfen ganz konkret dabei, die richtigen Finanzentscheidungen zu treffen. Ohne Provisionslogik gegen den Kunden. Ohne undurchsichtige Produkte. Sondern mit echter, unabhängiger Beratung.

Unsere Mission: Gute Finanzentscheidungen dürfen nicht länger nur den Experten überlassen sein – wir demokratisieren sie.

Und dafür suchen wir dich. Als Werkstudent/in sorgst du dafür, dass Finanzklar dort sichtbar wird, wo Menschen nach Antworten auf ihre Finanzfragen suchen – auf den Seiten, denen sie vertrauen, und in den Suchergebnissen, die sie anklicken. Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der nicht einfach Massenmails verschickt, sondern echte Partnerschaften aufbaut.

Aufgaben

Du baust unser Netzwerk an Kooperationspartnern auf – von der Recherche passender Seiten über die erste Kontaktaufnahme bis zur fertigen Veröffentlichung. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Content-Kooperationen: Partner veröffentlichen Artikel auf unserer Seite, wir veröffentlichen Artikel auf ihrer. So entstehen wertvolle Inhalte für beide Seiten – und hochwertige Backlinks für Finanzklar.

Deine Aufgaben im Detail:

  • Recherche und Identifikation passender Kooperationspartner (z. B. Blogs, Online-Magazine, Fachportale, Newsletter)
  • Bewertung potenzieller Partnerseiten nach Themenrelevanz, Reichweite und Qualität
  • Eigenständige Kontaktaufnahme per E-Mail und LinkedIn sowie professionelles Nachfassen
  • Anbahnung und Abstimmung von Content-Kooperationen – Gastartikel von Partnern auf unserer Seite, Gastbeiträge von Finanzklar auf Partnerseiten
  • Aufbau hochwertiger, themenrelevanter Backlinks im Rahmen dieser Kooperationen
  • Koordination von Themen, Briefings und Veröffentlichungsterminen mit Partnern und internem Team
  • Strukturierte Pflege aller Kontakte, Anfragen und Kooperationsstände in Outreach-Listen bzw. im CRM
  • Monitoring veröffentlichter Beiträge und Backlinks sowie regelmäßiges Reporting der ErgebnisseEnge Abstimmung mit unserer SEO-Agentur und dem Marketing-Team

Qualifikation

Stellenanforderungen – was du mitbringst

Fachlich:

  • Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule, idealerweise in BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Kommunikation, Medien oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Echtes Interesse an Finanzen, Wirtschaft und KI – du bewegst dich gerne in diesen Themenwelten
  • Grundverständnis für SEO und die Bedeutung von Backlinks – oder die Bereitschaft, es schnell zu lernen
  • Erste Erfahrungen in Outreach, Linkbuilding, Kooperationsmanagement oder PR sind ein Plus – kein Muss
  • Affinität zu digitalen Tools – Kenntnisse in SEO-Tools (z. B. Sistrix, Ahrefs oder SEMrush) von Vorteil
  • Sauberes, fehlerfreies Deutsch in Wort und Schrift – Pflicht; gutes Englisch von Vorteil

Kommunikativ:

  • Freude an schriftlicher Kommunikation – du formulierst Anfragen, die gelesen und beantwortet werden
  • Sicheres, sympathisches Auftreten gegenüber Redaktionen, Seitenbetreibern und Partnern
  • Hartnäckigkeit und Frustrationstoleranz – nicht jede Anfrage wird beantwortet, und das bringt dich nicht aus dem Takt
  • Gespür dafür, welche Themen und Partner zu Finanzklar passen – und welche nicht

Persönlich:

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation – du treibst dich selbst an, auch wenn niemand nachfragt
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Lernbereitschaft – du bist bereit, in kurzer Zeit viel aufzunehmen und anzuwenden
  • Strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise – du behältst den Überblick über viele parallele Kontakte und dokumentierst sauber
  • Offenheit für Feedback und Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Teamfähigkeit – du arbeitest eng mit dem Marketing-Team und unserer SEO-Agentur zusammen und kommunizierst proaktiv

Vorerfahrung im Linkbuilding oder Outreach ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss. Entscheidend ist, wer du als Mensch bist, nicht was auf deinem Lebenslauf steht.

Benefits

Was du bekommst

  • 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel planbar rund um deinen Vorlesungsplan
  • 100 % Remote – du arbeitest ortsunabhängig von überall aus
  • Direkter Einblick in SEO und Content-Marketing – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer SEO-Agentur
  • Einen Platz in einem Team, das wächst, direkt kommuniziert und zusammenhält
  • Echte Entwicklungsperspektive: wer hier gut wird, übernimmt wachsende Verantwortung und baut unser Partnernetzwerk aktiv mit auf
  • Ein Unternehmen mit echter Mission – du hilfst Menschen, bessere finanzielle Entscheidungen zu treffen
  • Praxiserfahrung, die sich gut im Lebenslauf macht – inklusive Option auf Übernahme nach dem Studium

raw.description:
Position Overview

The AEM Technical Architect owns the architecture and technical direction of complex Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) solutions and digital experience engagements. The role translates business, functional, security, data, integration, performance, and operational requirements into scalable technical designs, implementation patterns, and delivery plans.

This individual leads AEM solution architecture and technical consulting across the project lifecycle, from discovery and estimates through implementation and quality reviews. Working with clients and cross-functional teams, the architect evaluates technology options, resolves architectural risks, guides engineers, and ensures solutions support maintainable, high-performing digital experiences.

Location: Remote - United States

Key Responsibilities

AEM Solution Architecture & Technical Direction

  • Lead architecture and technical direction for sophisticated AEM-centric websites, content management, and digital experience solutions, including integration with other enterprise systems.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into architecture designs covering system boundaries, interfaces, data flows, deployment approaches, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Evaluate AEM and adjacent platform capabilities, existing infrastructure, implementation constraints, technical debt, and build-versus-buy options; document decisions and tradeoffs.
  • Diagnose client technical environments and recommend practical architecture and performance improvements.

Delivery Governance & Engineering Quality

  • Guide full-lifecycle solution delivery, including technical discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, and solution readiness.
  • Govern implementation quality through design reviews, architecture checkpoints, risk and exception management, and clear architectural decision records.
  • Provide technical direction to engineering teams on scalable implementation patterns, integrations, troubleshooting, and web performance.
  • Assess complex technical issues, develop solution options, and present recommendations and long-term implications to stakeholders.

Client, Presales & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with client leaders and internal Solutions, Product, Data, Quality, Delivery, and Engineering teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.
  • Support presales discovery, technical scoping, feasibility analysis, solution estimates, and identification of risks and dependencies.
  • Communicate sophisticated architecture decisions clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences and build trusted client relationships.

Mentorship & Practice Improvement

  • Mentor Lead Engineers and Engineers, provide technical guidance, and support knowledge sharing and effective project delivery practices.
  • Develop reusable architecture patterns, accelerators, standards, and lessons learned; stay current with AEM capabilities and evolving engineering practices.

Required Skills & Experience

Architecture & Consulting Leadership

  • 10+ years of relevant software engineering, solution architecture, web content management, or equivalent technical experience, aligned with the 5B Technical Architect level.
  • Experience owning architecture and key technical decisions for complex client engagements, products, or digital solution domains.
  • Experience translating functional and nonfunctional requirements into solution designs, implementation plans, estimates, and architecture decisions.
  • Strong client consulting, stakeholder facilitation, written and verbal communication, and technical presentation skills.

Adobe Experience Manager & Web Technologies

  • Demonstrated expertise designing and leading Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) solutions and integrations with enterprise systems.
  • Proficiency in object-oriented design and Java-based application architecture; understanding of web application performance, troubleshooting, and optimization.
  • Knowledge of web and integration technologies such as RESTful services, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML, SQL, HTTP, web servers, and content delivery networks.
  • Ability to evaluate architectural tradeoffs, reliability, security, scalability, technical debt, and production-readiness considerations.

Delivery, Collaboration & Governance

  • Experience conducting design reviews, managing technical risks and dependencies, and guiding engineering teams through complex implementation challenges.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery approaches, including Scrum, and supporting technical scoping and estimation.
  • Ability to mentor engineers and collaborate across product, data, quality, delivery, and client teams.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% as required by client assignments.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience with AEM as a Cloud Service and AEM-specific technologies such as Apache Sling, OSGi, JCR, Dispatcher, and related caching or CDN configurations.
  • Familiarity with UNIX/Linux environments, Apache web servers, TCP/IP networking, debugging tools, and advanced XML integration patterns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Expectations

Lead architecture and technical delivery within an assigned engagement, product, or domain; make key discipline decisions, manage architecture risks, mentor engineers, and drive high-quality outcomes. An 85% utilization target applies. Depending on client assignments and specialization, additional platform expertise, technical skills, certifications, domain knowledge, or travel may be expected.

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $165,000 - $200,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors.

About Blue Acorn iCi

Blue Acorn iCi, a business unit of Infosys Nova Holdings, LLC, is a digital experience partner helping global brands design, build, and optimize the future of customer engagement. We blend data, design, and technology to deliver connected commerce and content solutions that drive measurable results.

Specializing in the Adobe Experience Cloud, we provide end-to-end services across commerce, content, analytics, and customer insights. Backed by Infosys, we’re growing fast—and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

Our teams work at the intersection of strategy and execution—solving complex challenges for industry leaders in healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and beyond. From large-scale digital transformation programs to platform implementations and ongoing optimization, we bring deep expertise and a collaborative mindset to every engagement.

Why Join Us?

Blue Acorn iCi is a place for curious thinkers, smart builders, and digital pioneers. We’re more than a consultancy—we’re a team of innovators helping the world’s top brands shape the future of digital.

Here, you won’t just contribute to a project—you’ll drive meaningful outcomes, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and grow your skills in a high-impact, high-growth environment. We believe great work starts with great people, and we’re committed to creating a culture where talent thrives, ideas spark change, and results speak for themselves.

If you’re ready to push boundaries, deliver real value, and help shape the next generation of digital experiences—this is your place.

You will work directly with customers to diagnose complex technical issues, minimize equipment downtime, optimize product performance, and provide the training and support they need to get the most from their Epson technology.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, configuration, and equipment performance issues
  • Install Epson products and conduct customer training on equipment operation, production, and maintenance

  • Field-based/on-site troubleshooting, repair, installation, and customer support experience
  • Strong electromechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose hardware and software issues
  • Experience with RIP software, color management, and ICC profiles

raw.description:
At Kepler Communications, we're not just imagining the future of on-demand space connectivity - we're leading it!

Our mission is to provide real-time on-orbit connectivity for critical missions, enabling a new era of data-driven intelligence and innovation. With 33 satellites launched to date, Kepler operates the first commercial optical data relay constellation, enabling real-time, continuous space communications while supporting advanced on-orbit compute and hosted payload capabilities.

Industry-leading technology is only part of the story. What sets Kepler apart is our team: bold thinkers, skilled builders, and passionate problem-solvers who thrive on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in space. We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we’re committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make a global impact.
If you’re ready to reach higher, move faster, and do work that shapes the future space economy - this is your launchpad. Come build the future with Kepler!

What We Offer:

* Competitive compensation with a robust equity plan to share in our success.
* Comprehensive coverage for health, dental, and vision insurance—including dependents.
* Unlimited vacation, supportive parental leave policy, and company-wide holiday shutdown.
* Semi-annual company-wide parties and frequent in-office team events.
* Relocation packages available for approved roles.
* $1,500 annual professional development fund to support your growth.
* Fully stocked Toronto office kitchen with snacks, drinks, games and top-notch kitchen appliances.
* Town Halls, Celebration Calls, and Company-wide events to stay connected and engaged.
* We’re a certified Great Place to Work®, seven years in a row!
We’re on the hunt for a top-tier Flight Software Engineer for a 6+ month contract. Your focus will be on the development and maintenance of flight software and embedded Linux software for both space and ground-based assets across a growing fleet of spacecraft. You’ll be relied upon for input and decisions that will directly impact system design and operation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop reliable, high-quality software related to:
  • Embedded Linux applications and platform software for both space and ground systems
  • Flight software applications and services supporting spacecraft command and control, telemetry, fault detection and recovery, resource management, and on-orbit operations
  • Linux-based development on Xilinx Zynq MPSoCs, Versal SoCs, and NVIDIA Jetson-class hardware
  • Own and maintain embedded Linux build environments using OpenEmbedded/Yocto, including layers, recipes, system images, SDKs, package configuration, and build troubleshooting
  • Design and integrate flight software interfaces with ground software, including HTTP APIs and ZeroMQ message buses using data formats such as Protocol Buffers
  • Write thorough tests and documentation
  • Participate in software design review and code review processes
  • Work with electrical, digital design, ground software, and operations teams to identify required features and define the system architecture
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers
  • Identify shortcomings in existing software components and direct future development efforts

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent
  • 7+ years of embedded development experience, in Aerospace or relevant industry
  • Strong software design and development skills, including architecture, algorithms, testing, and debugging
  • Proficiency in C/C++, with experience developing reliable software for resource-constrained, mission-critical systems
  • Strong embedded Linux experience, including application development, system integration, debugging, kernel modules, device trees, and drivers
  • Experience owning and maintaining embedded Linux build systems using OpenEmbedded/Yocto
  • Experience developing Linux-based software for platforms such as Xilinx Zynq MPSoCs, Versal SoCs, or comparable embedded Linux platforms
  • Experience developing and integrating distributed software interfaces using technologies such as ZeroMQ, Protocol Buffers, and HTTP APIs
  • Understanding of flight-software concerns such as fault tolerance, deterministic behaviour, resource constraints, and operational reliability
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to effectively use git

Bonus Points:

  • Master’s degree
  • Experience developing software for aerospace applications
  • Experience deploying and supporting containerized software using Kubernetes on embedded Linux systems
  • Experience with NVIDIA Jetson-class hardware
  • Experience developing multi-stage bootloaders
  • Experience developing in Python

Kepler Communications is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities, members of visible minorities, and people of all sexual orientations and gender identities.
If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact our People & Culture team at , and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Why You Want to Work with Us

Wisner Baum (formerly Baum Hedlund) has been championing wrongful death and personal injury claims since the 1980s. With a rich history of representing thousands of clients in cases involving commercial transportation and defective products, including medical devices and pharmaceutical drugs, we have established a reputation for breaking new ground and holding multibillion dollar companies accountable. Our work goes beyond legal battles; we influence public policy, raise awareness, and improve public and product safety. The impact we make is not just significant—it’s world-changing.

Purpose and Impact of Your Role

As a Legal Case Manager, you play a crucial role in ensuring the success of our legal cases and the well-being of our clients. You will serve as the point of contact between clients, attorneys, and the legal system, providing support, guidance, and resources to navigate complex legal processes. Your work directly impacts the outcomes of our cases and the satisfaction of our clients.

What Success Looks Like


  • Successful resolution of cases in a timely and efficient manner.

  • High client satisfaction with the legal services provided.

  • Effective coordination of legal tasks and client communication.

  • Compliance with all relevant legal regulations and ethical standards.

  • Strong collaboration with legal team members and external stakeholders.

  • Accurate and organized documentation of case progress.

What You’ll Accomplish


  • Client Communication: Maintain open and clear communication with clients to provide updates on case status and answer their questions.

  • Case Assessment: Conduct initial case assessments, gather necessary documentation, and assist attorneys in case strategy development.

  • Resource Coordination: Assist clients in accessing legal resources and services, including referrals to other professionals as needed.

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date case records, including case notes, correspondence, and court filings.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with attorneys, paralegals, and external agencies to coordinate legal services and resources.

  • Compliance: Ensure adherence to all relevant legal regulations and ethical standards.

  • Case Success: Contribute to the successful resolution of cases, protecting our clients' interests.

  • Efficient Legal Processes: Facilitate smooth legal processes by managing documentation and communication.

  • Client Satisfaction: Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing responsive and helpful assistance.

  • Document Management: Ensure the accuracy and organization of legal documents and records.

  • Team Collaboration: Enhance the legal team's effectiveness through strong collaboration and support.

What You Will Learn and How You’ll Grow


  • Legal Knowledge: Expand your legal knowledge and expertise in various practice areas.

  • Communication Skills: Improve your ability to communicate effectively with clients and legal professionals.

  • Legal Research: Enhance your legal research and writing skills.

  • Client Advocacy: Develop strong client advocacy skills to support clients through legal processes.

  • Professional Growth: Participate in ongoing training and professional development opportunities within the legal field.

What You Need to Get the Job Done


  • Initiative and Self-Starting: Demonstrates a proactive approach to tasks and projects, initiating actions and taking responsibility for driving them forward independently.

  • Effective Interpersonal Communication: Exhibits exceptional communication skills when interacting with both clients and colleagues, fostering positive relationships and clear understanding.

  • Time Management Proficiency: Shows strong time management skills, effectively prioritizing tasks, and consistently meeting deadlines.

  • Critical Thinking Abilities: Possesses the capability to analyze complex situations, evaluate options, and make well-informed decisions based on thoughtful and logical reasoning.

  • Empathetic Engagement: Displays a high degree of empathy, understanding, and sensitivity towards the needs and concerns of clients and colleagues.

  • Adaptability and Flexibility: Easily adapts to changing circumstances, demonstrating flexibility and resilience in various work scenarios.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office: Has a solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, utilizing them efficiently for various tasks and projects.

  • High Aptitude and Rapid Learning: Shows a keen aptitude for learning new skills and concepts quickly, consistently demonstrating the ability to grasp and apply new information effectively.

  • Exemplary Organizational Skills: Maintains an organized approach to tasks, projects, and information, ensuring clarity and efficiency in daily work.

  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: Pays meticulous attention to detail in all aspects of work, minimizing errors and ensuring accuracy.

  • Performing Under Pressure: Thrives in high-pressure situations, effectively managing stress and consistently meeting deadlines with composure and efficiency.

What You’ll Love About Us


  • Great Company Culture. We pride ourselves on our exceptional culture where your growth is not just encouraged, but actively invested in. We know that when our team members thrive, our firm thrives, and allows us to have a positive impact on our world.

  • Making an Impact. We know that each and every team member plays a pivotal role in our mission. We recognize that investing in and empowering our team members leads to employees who are genuinely passionate about their work, which in turn maximizes their impact.

  • Focused on your Growth. Our coaching, continuous feedback, and personalized development plans are designed to empower each team member to reach their full potential.

  • Rest and We are committed to the well-being of our employees, and we understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance. To support this, we offer generous paid holidays, sick leave, and vacation time, so that our team members may step away from work when needed.

  • Health Benefits. Our employees' physical and mental well-being is of utmost importance to us. That's why we offer comprehensive benefits that include medical, dental, and vision coverage, ensuring that you have access to quality healthcare. Additionally, we provide a 401(k) plan to help you secure your financial future.

As a Regional Vice President, Strategic East Sales at Motive, you will be a key leader in our fastest growing segment at Motive. Our RVPs manage a team of Strategic Account Executives and guide them in both engaging and closing Motive’s largest prospects. You’ll lead initiatives across hiring, coaching, and enablement to support Motive’s growth & success. Your team will sell into the most impactful companies in North America that power the physical economy.

We are seizing the opportunity created by our strong product positioning in the market by heavily investing across all Go-To-Market (GTM) teams within our Enterprise segment. You will lead the charge, selling the value of our products and the business outcomes that can be achieved for our customers in partnership with Motive.

Our Strategic Sales team sells consistently into Fortune 500 companies across multiple industries, including trucking, oil & gas, construction, agriculture, manufacturing, consumer transit, or any other business that requires a fleet of vehicles. Because of the collaborative nature of our Go-to-Market team, a win-as-a-team mentality is a must. In this high-energy role, you should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with high standards of quality.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead a world-class team of seasoned Account Executives that you’ll partner with on prospecting strategy, account planning, pipeline reviews, achieving revenue targets
  • Develop and execute on strategic account and territory plans for your team to meet or exceed ACV targets over monthly, quarterly, and annual periods
  • Track progress and success of your Account Executives against various primary KPIs, coaching and enabling their success across short and long-term goals
  • Cultivate a culture of high-performance and accountability through best-in-class hiring
  • Partner with our Sales Enablement team ad-hoc and on more formal Account Executive training and coaching programs to ensure consistency and effectiveness across the organization
  • Excellence in listening, sales process and passionate about the art of selling
  • Collaborate with your Account Executives and directly engage high-priority client prospects to help sell the value of Motive
  • Ensure use of CRM and other operational tools, processes, and best practices in pipeline planning, forecasting, and sales execution

What We're Looking For:

  • 1-3 years experience directly managing SaaS sales teams at the Strategic level
  • History of exceeding sales targets with Strategic-level clients
  • Ability to lead and motivate others to action, including best-in-class customer skills communication, empathy, and integrity
  • A people-based mindset, with a passion for coaching and developing sales talent at all levels and a history of developing great sales cultures
  • Examples of bringing a great sense of rigor, executions and accountability to your team’s day-to-day processes
  • Ability to collaborate with internal cross-functional partners across Sales Development, Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Legal and Sales Ops
  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM and sales technologies and best practices enabling your team to forecast, manage their pipeline and accelerate wins
  • Lead with curiosity and example by attending sales calls to help team manage and close deals
  • Highly preferred that you live in the Eastern Region of the United States - in the same region as the team. (Eastern Time Zone)
Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visitingMotive Perks & Benefits.
The on-target earnings (base pay + commissions) for this role:
$10—$1,000 USD

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

raw.description:
Join Our Team – Contractors or Employees Welcome | Remote Across Europe

We’re on the lookout for talented AWS Cloud Architects to join our growing team. If you're an experienced Senior Architect/ Engineer or have 5+ years in the field, this is your opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking company where innovation drives our success and shapes the future of cloud technology.

Who we are

We’re a professional services company with a difference!

We work as a 100% remote team, engineering cutting-edge, transformational technology solutions that deliver rapid business results for our clients. Our core expertise lies in serverless architecture and implementation, cloud migration, and modernisation of critical business systems. While many prefer to build complex solutions from scratch, we excel at simplifying complex problems and delivering simple, effective solutions.

As a certified AWS Consulting Partner, we bring advanced cloud expertise to every project.

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!

What will you do

As an AWS Cloud Architect, you’ll play a pivotal role within our team, specialising in designing, building and implementing cloud solutions, creating and optimising cloud infrastructure, developing software applications, integrating systems, and defining architecture best practices. In collaboration with both our team at fourTheorem and our clients, you'll contribute to crafting solutions that tackle complex business challenges. Your expertise will be instrumental in shaping and empowering our clients' teams by providing valuable guidance and knowledge. Tasks include:

  • Architect and design scalable, secure, and highly available cloud solutions on AWS, using best practices in DevOps and cloud-native design.
  • Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like CloudFormation or Terraform to enable efficient and consistent deployments.
  • Work collaboratively with fourTheorem colleagues and our customers to understand business goals, incrementally deliver new technology to meet those goals, reduce complexity and demonstrate the impact of our approach.
  • Automate the deployment, configuration, and management of infrastructure and services using CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to define and implement strategies for monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Amazon CloudWatch or third-party solutions.
  • Optimise applications for cost, performance, and security and work with clients on best practices for infrastructure, data, and application deployment.
  • Mentor and guide teams on AWS architecture patterns, DevOps methodologies, and operational best practices.
  • Evaluate and integrate third-party tools and services into applications to enhance automation, performance, and security.

What will you bring

  • 5+ years of experience building and/or architecting distributed applications on AWS.
  • Software development skills with a focus on cloud applications.
  • An understanding of the benefits and drawbacks of any approach, with the ability to make trade-offs to ensure that a solution is right for the customer.
  • Strong proficiency in AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, EC2, API Gateway, IAM, or S3.
  • Hands-on experience with automation and IaC tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
  • Proficiency in building and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or AWS CloudWatch.
  • Proven ability to architect solutions that meet business and technical requirements while balancing performance, scalability, and cost.
  • Communication skills, with a focus on listening and understanding first, but also presenting high-level solutions and implementation details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Our aim is not to intimidate our customers or colleagues by the un-necessary use of jargon - translating complex technology into plain english understandable by all is our main goal.

Looking for the right fit, not just a checklist

We believe in finding the right fit, not just ticking boxes. While we’re looking for the experience above, we also value the unique skills and experiences you bring. If you're passionate about cloud technology, eager to learn, and ready to make an impact, we encourage you to apply. We're flexible and open to making trade-offs to find the right fit for you and the team.

Some of what we offer

Fully Remote: No office, no commute, no problem!

Flexible Hours: We trust you to manage your time - flex your schedule to fit your life.

Annual Leave: 25 days annual leave, in addition to public holidays.

Team Meet Ups: Meet the crew four times a year.

Macbook: Relax - your MacBook is taken care of.

Co-working Allowance: Need a change of scenery? We’ll chip in for your co-working spot.

A culture of respect, collaboration, and inclusion

We respect and value learning at all stages of your career. We believe in listening to ideas from everyone, regardless of experience, and fostering a culture of collaboration. We prioritise team performance over individual contribution, supporting each other and stepping outside the "lane" of any given role to get the job done.

We’re building a team where everyone’s welcome, no matter your background, identity, or how you show up in the world. We believe in respect, fairness, and giving everyone a real shot to grow, thrive, and do great work together.

If you require any reasonable accommodations during the hiring process, please reach out via email to

If you enjoy being part of a collaborative, creative team that is not afraid to challenge others or be challenged, you’ll be a great fit here!

raw.title: Principal Technical Marketing Engineer  | Sweden | Remote
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability.

As Grafana’s offering shifts from dashboards to industry-leading agentic observability, our Product Marketing team is responsible for closing the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. That means building clear, consistent positioning, enabling sellers with trustworthy technical narratives, and creating content that helps Platform Engineering teams quickly grasp why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

As a Technical Product Marketer you will play a critical part in that transformation. You’ll be the hands-on engineer who brings our technical story to life for buyers, not just practitioners. You’ll build core demos, run technical workshops and webinars, and act as the technical bridge between our Product and Sales orgs. Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey.

This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars

  • Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos that highlight Grafana’s value for SRE and platform engineering leaders.
  • Record high-quality technical demo videos and walkthroughs in partnership with our video and content teams.
  • Lead webinars, workshops, and technical sessions designed for evaluators.
  • Teach customers not just how Grafana works, but why our approach is differentiated and valuable.
  • Use AI tools to generate variations, summaries, and reusable assets that scale technical content across channels.

Enable Solutions (Sales) Engineers with clear, consistent technical storytelling

  • Serve as PMM’s technical liaison to the SE org, ensuring consistent messaging and demo guidance.
  • Produce technical enablement assets, value-driven talk tracks, competitive narratives, and demo best practices.
  • Help SEs and sellers communicate Grafana’s story with clarity, confidence, and differentiation.

Collaborate with PMMs to drive technical buyer engagement across high-impact channels

  • Partner with PMMs to identify the most important buyer personas, problems, and technical messages, and help shape the content strategy needed to reach them.
  • Extend technical narratives into impactful buyer-facing channels including analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester), industry forums, podcasts, conferences, and online technical communities.
  • Bring a technical perspective to PMM planning—helping ensure our content, campaigns, and enablement reflect the real challenges and priorities of SREs and engineering leaders.

Use automation & AI to scale technical content

  • Partner with software engineers to streamline demo setup, content workflows, and asset updates through workflows, agents, scripts, and AI-driven tools.
  • Use automation to make technical content more repeatable, discoverable, and scalable across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years in a technical role (solutions engineering, SRE, DevOps, backend engineering, technical PMM, or similar).
  • Interest and ability to travel to training and customer events 10-12 weeks per year.
  • Strong understanding of observability concepts and the needs of SRE/platform teams.
  • Ability to translate deep technical concepts into clear, value-focused stories.
  • Experience presenting technical content through demos, workshops, or webinars.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a crisp, structured, persuasive style.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration; comfort working with PMM, Product, SEs, DevRel, and Field Engineering.
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from concept to completion.
  • Comfort with light scripting or workflow automation.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, or similar observability tools, or a background in Observability or Platform Engineering.
  • Prior experience in Sales Engineering, DevRel, or technical product marketing.
  • Familiarity with demo environment automation or infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Exceptional live presentation or workshop facilitation skills.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Sweden, the base compensation range for this role is SEK 878,578 - SEK 1,054,294. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

Rosie Rules Please read before accepting a project!

Job Description:

The Programmatic Specialist is responsible for supporting channel strategy, execution and stewardship of effective programmatic campaigns on behalf of a major, high-profile advertiser. This individual will have experience with campaign management, programmatic execution, and has hands-on experience in self-serve advertising platforms. Experience executing various campaign types including online display, video, and audio, in an agency environment is required.

This Programmatic Specialist will have a firm grasp and ability to navigate intricacies of hyper targeted, complex campaigns as well as an understanding of basic digital metrics and calculations, media measurement, terminology, and how these impact delivery and performance. The nature of this role requires extreme attention to detail and above average data management skills, heavily leveraging Microsoft Excel, to ensure correct application of a large amount of campaign parameters and for performance monitoring and reporting.

This Programmatic Specialist will possess knowledge of ad serving technology and an emerging understanding of supply chain partnerships in the programmatic ecosystem. They are comfortable participating in client meetings and possess knowledge of trends and new partnerships.

KEY OUTCOMES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning, Strategy, and Programmatic Expertise Development

  • Kick oﬀ the planning process by working cross functionally with Channel Manager, Integrated Planning and Account teams. Provide guidance and answer questions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather insights, identify new opportunities, and provide strategic recommendations and optimizations that exceed campaign benchmarks and align with client goals and challenges
  • Continuously analyze key performance metrics to measure eﬀectiveness of campaign initiatives.
  • Support materials like POVs and other thought leadership to educate internal and client stakeholders on strategy shifts, account restructuring etc.
  • Stay updated on the latest paid programmatic tools, applications, and strategies, providing client-relevant research, analysis and trends.

Effective Campaign Management and Performance Optimization

  • Manage and execute programmatic campaigns across display, audio, video, and digital out-of-home, ensuring adherence to budgets and timelines while ensuring KPIs are met or exceeded.
  • QA campaigns to ensure accuracy and proactively troubleshoot any errors or mismatches.
  • Bring forward suggestions on campaign optimizations, addressing delivery toward campaign objectives through best practices within bid management, audience and placement analysis, and performance tracking of key KPIs.
  • Conduct ongoing delivery pacing checks and provide comprehensive weekly, monthly, and campaign wrap-up reports.
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with digital media partners, ensuring eﬀective collaboration and communication.
  • Support in the communication, evaluation, and implementation of programmatic media partners, technology, and platforms, including Private Marketplace (PMP) and Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) deals.

Data-driven Insights and Reporting

  • Leverage advanced Excel functions (Pivot Tables, VLookups, Concatenates, and IF statements) to gather, analyze, and articulate mid-level insights on campaign performance to maximize results.
  • Accurate QA of all data including PowerBI models.
  • Ability to address questions, articulating campaign performance and trend analysis to internal and external parties via detailed written and verbal summaries.
  • Monitor performance against measurement frameworks and push for higher quality delivery by evaluating delivery, audience analysis, supply path optimization, and placement performance.
  • Manage multiple client campaigns, ensuring high-quality performance, and results that align with our client’s business objectives.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of changes, trends, and learnings to inform future campaign strategy and optimization.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Additional accountabilities and tasks may be assigned by leader/management, to contribute to overall team and agency sucess.

This is NOT a client-facing role.

Familiarity openness to AI tools is preferred (Claude, AI planning tools, etc.)

REQUIRED –

  • Minimum 2-4 years of experience managing campaigns in the digital marketing ecosystem
  • Strong knowledge/familiarity of DV360
  • High level of proficiency in Excel, being able to create &/or utilize formulas, VLookups, concatenate and other functions

• PREFERRED –

  • Experience in hands on execution of advertising within biddable platforms (programmatic, paid search, paid social, media operations, ad operations, etc.). DV360 skills a must!
  • Experience in strategic planning and applied experience of bringing plans to execution.
  • Experience involving heavy utilization of MS Excel (or similar tools) to manage large amounts of data with precision and accuracy.
  • Proven track record in operating with a high-level of integrity, commitment, and enthusiasm to take on a challenging role with cross-functional commitments.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • CUSTOMER FOCUS/CLIENT INTIMACY: seeking to understand client business challenges/needs and delivering continuous value to our clients
  • COLLABORATIVE: working with teams and across the organization with ease
  • OWNER AGILITY: able to continuously learn and quickly adapt to changing circumstances
  • RESULTS DRIVEN: accepts accountability to deliver business outcomes, even under changing circumstances. Delivers on commitments
  • DISCIPLINED: Thinks, plans, and prioritizes work on an ongoing basis; plans and aligns with key team members before acting

raw.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tools & Systems
raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together

raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

We will never ask for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process. Recruiters will only reach out from an insurity.com email address; no other email addresses will be used. Examples of fraudulent email addresses that have been used end with @insurityjobs.us.   Be aware of suspicious recruitment activity. If you think you are a victim of an employment scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agency and/or visit the Federal Trade Commission website here:

Who We Are

Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed.

We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise.

While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer.

Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity

Insurity’s Next Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Insurity is seeking a strategic, operational, and technically credible Chief Information Security Officer to lead Insurity’s enterprise security, cybersecurity risk and privacy programs.

The CISO will protect Insurity’s information assets, products, customer environments, and technology ecosystem while enabling growth, cloud adoption, international expansion, and responsible use of artificial intelligence. This leader will translate cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and technology risk into clear business decisions for executive leadership and the Board.

The successful candidate will combine executive presence with practical execution. They need to be comfortable setting strategy, leading through influence, engaging with customers executives and regulators, directing major incidents, reviewing architecture, and building the processes, team, and culture required for a growing SaaS company.

 What Our Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) Will Do

Enterprise security strategy and governance

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve Insurity’s enterprise information security strategy, policies, standards, and control framework.
  • Establish security priorities that align with business strategy, product roadmaps, customer commitments, and the organization’s risk appetite.
  • Reinforce an enterprise security governance structure, including executive steering forums and appropriate reporting to the executive team and Board of Directors.
  • Define clear accountability for security across Engineering, Product, Corporate IT, Cloud Operations, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance business functions.
  • Provide risk-mitigating direction for initiatives with technology, data, cloud, product, or customer-security implications.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of emerging threats, technologies, regulations, and business risks.

HIPAA, PHI data protection

  • Own and mature Insurity’s HIPAA compliance and electronic protected health information program where applicable to Insurity’s products, services, customers, vendors, and business operations.
  • Lead documented HIPAA risk analyses, risk treatment plans, control testing, remediation tracking, and periodic program evaluations.
  • Ensure appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for protected health information, including access control, authentication, audit controls, integrity, transmission security, encryption, contingency planning, and workforce security.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Product, and Customer Success on the HIPAA Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification Rules.
  • Establish requirements for Business Associate Agreements, customer obligations, subcontractors, cloud providers, and other third parties that create, receive, maintain, or transmit PHI.
  • Maintain audit-ready evidence and support customer diligence, independent assessments, regulatory inquiries, and OCR requests.
  • Lead the security component of PHI breach assessment, containment, investigation, notification coordination, and post-incident remediation.
  • Ensure HIPAA-specific workforce training, sanctions, and awareness requirements are incorporated into the broader security program.

AI security, governance, and responsible adoption

  • Establish and lead Insurity’s enterprise AI security and governance program.
  • Maintain an inventory of AI, machine learning, large language model, generative AI, and agentic systems used, developed, procured, or embedded in Insurity products and operations.
  • Define AI intake, risk classification, ownership, approval gates, prohibited uses, and human-oversight requirements.
  • Establish secure-use standards for generative AI, including requirements for confidential information, PHI, PII, customer data, source code, proprietary data, prompts, outputs, retention, and model training.
  • Define controls for AI-specific risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, insecure agents and tools, model abuse, data poisoning, supply-chain risk, unauthorized access, and unreliable or harmful outputs.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Product, Engineering, Data, and Compliance to address transparency, intellectual property & data rights of emerging AI regulations.
  • Incorporate AI security and governance requirements into procurement, third-party risk management, secure development, cloud architecture, product reviews, and customer commitments.

Risk management, compliance, and assurance

  • Develop a risk-based process for identifying, assessing, prioritizing, treating, and accepting information security and technology risks across Insurity’s ecosystem.
  • Maintain alignment with applicable requirements and leading practices, including HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR & the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
  • Orchestrate internal and external audits through planning, evidence collection, testing, findings management, remediation, and executive reporting.
  • Establish control ownership, evidence standards, issue-management processes, and sustainable remediation tracking.
  • Advise management on the costs, value, and risks of security and technology investments.
  • Support cyber-insurance requirements, underwriting reviews, claims preparation, and risk-improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor regulatory and contractual changes and translate them into practical requirements, policies, and implementation plans.
  • Report material risks, exceptions, incidents, and remediation plans to executive leadership and the Board.

Security operations and incident response

  • Lead the enterprise security operations program, including monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, detection and response, penetration testing, and security investigations.
  • Manage security incident response coordinating both internally and externally from inception to resolution.
  • Maintain an incident response program that covers cyber incidents, privacy events, PHI incidents, ransomware, cloud compromise, insider threats, supply-chain events, and AI-related incidents.
  • Lead security incident response partnering with Insurity’s COO and CLO while remaining sufficiently engaged in technical and operational details.
  • Establish escalation criteria, severity definitions, communications protocols, evidence-preservation practices, and post-incident review requirements.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Communications, customers, insurers, law enforcement, and regulators as appropriate.
  • Measure response effectiveness through exercises, lessons learned, time-to-detect, time-to-contain, time-to-recover, and remediation completion.
  • Lead regular cyber crisis tabletop exercises and simulations with executive leadership, key operational teams, customers, and external partners where appropriate.
  • Maintain crisis communications and breach-disclosure playbooks in partnership with Legal, Communications, Privacy, and executive leadership.
  • Ensure lessons from incidents and exercises are converted into funded improvements.

Product, application, cloud, and infrastructure security

  • Embed security-by-design into product development, architecture, engineering, DevOps, and change-management processes.
  • Establish and oversee application security practices, including secure coding, threat modeling, SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, penetration testing, vulnerability disclosure, and release gates.
  • Lead software supply-chain security, including dependency governance, SBOMs, artifact integrity, code-signing expectations, CI/CD controls, and third-party component risk.
  • Oversee cloud-security architecture, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, network segmentation, logging, monitoring, data-loss prevention, and secure configuration management.
  • Promote Zero Trust principles, least privilege, strong authentication, secure-by-default configurations, and continuous control monitoring.
  • Review and approve security architecture for major products, platforms, infrastructure changes, AI systems, and customer-facing capabilities.

Third-party risk, customer trust, and commercial enablement

  • Establish a risk-based third-party security and privacy program covering vendors, cloud providers, subprocessors, partners, supply-chain participants, and other external parties.
  • Ensure contracts, security requirements, audit rights, breach obligations, data-use restrictions, and Business Associate obligations are addressed with Legal and Procurement.
  • Establish and maintain data classification, data inventory, data-flow, retention, deletion, residency, and access-governance practices.
  • Ensure security requirements are addressed across the lifecycle of customer, employee, regulated, confidential, and proprietary information.

Leadership, organization, and culture

  • Build and lead a cost-efficient, high-performing security organization with appropriate direct and dotted-line relationships across Engineering, Product, IT, Cloud Operations, Privacy, Compliance, and other functions.
  • Hire, develop, coach, and retain security talent while establishing clear operating rhythms and accountability.
  • Create and manage security awareness and role-based training for employees, contractors, approved system users, developers, administrators, and executives.
  • Promote a culture in which security is viewed as an enabler of customer trust, product quality, resilience, and business growth.
  • Manage the security budget, partner strategy, managed service providers, and external security resources.
  • Define and report meaningful security metrics, risk indicators, maturity measures, control health, remediation progress, incident trends, audit results, customer commitments, and AI-governance metrics.

Who We’re Looking For 

  • A strategic leader and builder who can establish vision, create alignment, and execute through influence.
  • A credible executive communicator who can brief the Board, lead a crisis, engage customers, and explain complex issues in simple terms.
  • A pragmatic security leader who balances risk reduction, business enablement, customer commitments, speed, and cost.
  • A collaborative partner to Engineering, Product, IT, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership.
  • A calm, decisive leader who can operate effectively in high-pressure, high-stakes situations.
  • A leader who is comfortable working hands-on when necessary while building a scalable team and operating model.

Required qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in information security, computer science, information technology, business, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 8–10 years of progressive experience in information security, cybersecurity, technology risk, or related disciplines within a SaaS, cloud, technology, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated environment.
  • At least 5 years of executive or senior leadership experience in a CISO, Deputy CISO, Head of Security, or comparable role.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating an enterprise security program across a distributed or remote organization.
  • Experience with HIPAA, ePHI, Business Associate requirements, healthcare data protection, or comparable regulated-data obligations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading security risk assessments, audits, remediation programs, and regulatory or customer assurance activities.
  • Experience leading material incidents, crisis response, business continuity, disaster recovery, and executive communications.
  • Experience establishing or operating an AI security, AI governance, responsible AI, model-risk, or secure-generative-AI program.
