raw.description:
Hypori, Inc. is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming how organizations think about secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform enables users to access enterprise apps and data from any mobile device—with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M in funding from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, Hypori is expanding into new commercial and regulated markets. Learn more at hypori.com.

Hypori is looking for a builder-minded Channel Account Manager to join our growing commercial sales team. You will recruit, enable, and drive revenue through the MSSPs, MSPs, RPOs, and C3PAOs that serve small and mid-size defense contractors, building partners who sell, deploy, and support Hypori on their own. You will report to the VP of Commercial Sales.

More than 100,000 companies sit in the Defense Industrial Base, and most buy security from the partner that runs their IT. Hypori gives those partners a proven answer: more than 95,000 Department of War users are on the platform today, and we hold IL5, FedRAMP High, NIAP Common Criteria, NSA CSfC, CMMC 2.0 Level 2, and SOC 2 Type II, so it clears review with defense clients. The DIB partner program is being built from scratch, and the person in this seat builds it.

Responsibilities

  • Own an annual target for new MSSP, MSP, RPO, and C3PAO partners serving defense contractors
  • Source partners through outbound, the CMMC practitioner community, and events including CMMC CON, AFCEA small business forums, and Hypori CMMC Accelerate
  • Understand the partner’s why first: why add Hypori, why now for their clients, what it does for their practice and margin, and why not stick with the status quo
  • Qualify partners on DIB client base, CUI exposure, GCC High or enclave practice, and willingness to sell, then negotiate and sign agreements across referral, co-sell, and resell tiers
  • Take every new partner to first transaction on a defined timeline, and move partners from referral to selling on their own as an extension of Hypori
  • Build and run the partner certification path with the channel sales engineer
  • Get partner sellers ready to position isolation and defend the scope reduction argument to their clients
  • Own partner content, deal registration, the partner portal, and the enablement calendar
  • Carry a partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue number and forecast it accurately in Salesforce
  • Run joint business plans and quarterly business reviews with top partners, and co-sell into partner client bases with Hypori account executives and sales engineers
  • Work with Carahsoft, our distributor, on distribution and procurement paths, including opportunities under 100 licenses, and with Marketing on campaigns, co-branded content, and events
  • Report monthly on recruitment, time to first transaction, pipeline, and revenue by tier
  • Over time, help stand up the foundation for a broader security reseller and solution provider channel

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in channel sales or partner management at a cybersecurity, infrastructure, or SaaS vendor
  • Experience building a DIB-focused MSP or MSSP partner program, not just managing an existing one
  • A track record of recruiting and activating MSP or MSSP partners from signature to first transaction and beyond
  • Working relationships across the MSP, MSSP, or CMMC practitioner ecosystem serving the DIB
  • Working knowledge of CMMC 2.0 and NIST SP 800-171: CUI vs. FCI, the 5 asset categories, SPRS scoring, and DFARS 7012 obligations
  • Experience carrying and hitting a partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue number
  • Experience building your own enablement material, and familiarity with deal registration, partner portals, and margin structures
  • Strong Salesforce and pipeline hygiene
  • Location: Remote, United States, with travel up to 40 percent to partner sites and industry events

Who You Are

  • Speed: You move with urgency and get things done today, not next week
  • Focus: You spend your time on the partners who will actually sell
  • Extreme ownership: Your program, your partners, your number. No excuses
  • Accountability: You do what you say, when you say. You flag slips early
  • Coachability: You ask for feedback, act on it, and get better
  • Humility: You know what you don’t know, and you say so
  • Creativity: You find new ways to recruit partners and get them selling

Preferred Attributes

  • Technical credibility: Partners only carry products their engineers and compliance leads believe in. You will have a dedicated channel sales engineer, but this is still a technical role, and you should be able to have these conversations whether your SE is in the room or not
  • CMMC and 800-171: Walk a partner through how an unmanaged device moves from CUI Asset to out of scope. Speak to the External Service Provider question, FedRAMP Moderate equivalency under DFARS 7012, and shared responsibility
  • Microsoft 365 GCC High: Commercial vs. GCC vs. GCC High, enclave vs. full-tenant migration, and where Hypori shrinks the GCC High footprint
  • Endpoint and mobile: MDM, UEM, MAM, mobile threat defense, enterprise browser, VDI, and DaaS. You know where the data rests in each
  • Hypori platform: Run a partner enablement session covering architecture, deployment scoping, licensing, and what each accreditation means to a client
  • MSP operations: RMM and PSA platforms, per-seat packaging, margin expectations, and multi-tenant administration
  • Prior time at an MSP, MSSP, RPO, or C3PAO serving defense contractors
  • CMMC CCP or CCA certification
  • Military service or Department of War civilian experience

About Us

Compensation: $215,000 – $235,000 on-target earnings (commensurate with experience). Variable compensation is uncapped, with accelerators above 100 percent attainment, and the role includes equity. Targets are based on partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, plus partner recruitment and activation.

About Us

Hypori Inc. provides a generous benefits package for full-time employees that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, and life and disability packages. We also invest in our employees' futures by providing a 401(k) plan with employer-matching contributions that vest starting from your first day of employment. In addition to the base compensation, Hypori also offers a performance bonus, which is primarily contingent upon company-wide performance. We are dedicated to investing in the tools and skills required to be strong, collaborative colleagues and people managers to help build and retain a strong workforce.

Hypori is an Equal Employment and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex,sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

At Hypori, we are committed to creating and promoting an inclusive workplace that embraces differences and perspectives – making us a stronger, more successful company. This is a consultative executive support role for senior leaders—not a task-based administrative position. Our executive assistants are proactive thinkers, problem solvers, client partners, and project coordinators who are also highly capable of executing administrative work when needed.

About the Role

As an executive assistant, you will manage a portfolio of client relationships and work alongside an Implementer to help clients delegate more effectively, strengthen their executive support systems, and keep important work moving.

You will get to know each client’s business, priorities, challenges, and working style, then proactively identify opportunities to improve how work is delegated, organized, coordinated, and executed.

raw.description:
About the Client
Our client is a US-based property management business that oversees residential rental properties, including single-family and multifamily units, on behalf of property owners. They’re growing, and daily tenant communication, leasing paperwork, maintenance follow-ups, and bookkeeping are taking up more of their time. They’re looking for a dependable, detail-oriented coordinator who can keep operations running smoothly and know when to bring them in.
Why does this role exist?
The client needs to step back from daily tenant and admin work without anything slipping through the cracks. This role exists to take over day-to-day operations, from tenant communication and leasing to maintenance coordination, light bookkeeping, and owner updates. In your first 30 days, you’ll learn their systems, properties, tenants, and vendors, and handle requests quickly and independently so the client can trust you to run the day-to-day.

The Impact you’ll make

Tenant Communication
  • Answer tenant calls, emails, and texts within set response times
  • Log maintenance requests and send confirmation to the tenant
  • Send rent reminders before the due date and late notices after
  • Share move-in and move-out instructions
  • Send building notices about inspections, water shutoffs, pest control, or repairs
  • Escalate emergencies to the property manager right away
Leasing Lease Administration
  • Post vacancy listings on Zillow, Apartments.com, Facebook Marketplace, and similar sites
  • Respond to prospect inquiries and schedule showings
  • Send rental applications and track which ones are complete
  • Coordinate background, credit, and income checks through the screening platform
  • Prepare lease agreements from approved templates for review, then send for e-signature and follow up until signed
  • Track lease start dates, end dates, and renewal deadlines, and send renewal offers 60 to 90 days before expiration
  • Keep a lease tracker updated with rent amounts, deposits, and key terms
  • Prepare move-in and move-out inspection checklists
Maintenance Coordination
  • Create work orders and assign them to the right vendor
  • Request and compare vendor quotes
  • Schedule repairs and confirm access with tenants
  • Follow up until each job is closed and the tenant confirms it’s resolved
  • Keep a vendor list with contacts, rates, insurance, and license expiration dates
  • Schedule preventive maintenance such as HVAC service, gutter cleaning, and smoke detector checks
Light Bookkeeping
  • Record rent payments and match them to each unit
  • Track late fees and outstanding balances
  • Enter vendor invoices and bills into QuickBooks, Buildium, AppFolio, or the owner’s system
  • Upload and categorize receipts
  • Reconcile bank and credit card transactions monthly
  • Track security deposits and prepare deposit return calculations
  • Prepare a simple monthly report per property showing income, expenses, and net
  • Collect W-9s from vendors and keep records ready for 1099s
  • Flag unusual charges or missing payments to the owner
Admin, Records Owner Relations
  • Keep tenant, lease, and property files organized in a shared drive
  • Track insurance policies, permits, and property tax due dates
  • Manage the property manager’s calendar for showings, inspections, and vendor visits
  • Update the tenant and unit database after every change
  • Prepare a weekly status summary covering vacancies, open work orders, overdue rent, and upcoming renewals
  • Send monthly owner statements and get owner approval for repairs above a set dollar limit
  • Answer basic owner questions about their property

Backend Geospatial Software Engineer

Chesapeake Technology, Inc. | Remote — US

About Chesapeake Technology

Chesapeake Technology is a 25-year leader in marine survey software, developing SonarWiz — the industry-standard platform for processing sidescan sonar, sub-bottom profiler, bathymetry, and magnetometer data. We serve commercial survey companies, research institutions, government agencies, and defense customers worldwide. We are currently building a next-generation cloud-native platform that brings AI/ML-powered processing to the browser, along with edge computing capabilities for real-time AUV data analysis.

The Role

We're looking for a Backend Geospatial Software Engineer to architect and build the cloud processing engine powering our new platform. You'll work on large-scale geospatial data pipelines — ingesting, transforming, and serving sonar and bathymetric datasets — using modern Python-based scientific computing tools on AWS. You'll also help design lightweight edge processing solutions that run onboard autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) for real-time sensor analysis and decision-making. High-impact role on a small, focused team where your work ships directly to production.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement scalable backend services for cloud-based geospatial data processing

  • Build distributed data pipelines using Dask and Xarray to process large multi-dimensional sonar datasets

  • Architect and optimize AWS infrastructure (S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, SQS) for compute-intensive workloads

  • Develop edge computing pipelines for onboard AUV data analysis, enabling real-time target detection and adaptive survey planning

  • Design systems that bridge edge and cloud — syncing, validating, and enriching AUV-collected data post-mission

  • Develop APIs that serve processed geospatial data to the web-based frontend

  • Integrate ML/AI models for automated bottom tracking, target recognition, and data classification

  • Optimize data storage, compression, and retrieval for large raster and point-cloud datasets

  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of backend software engineering experience with Python

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS (S3, EC2/ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, or equivalent orchestration)

  • Production experience with Dask for distributed/parallel computing

  • Production experience with Xarray for multi-dimensional array data

  • Solid understanding of geospatial data formats and CRS (GeoTIFF, NetCDF, shapefiles, WGS84, UTM)

  • Experience building RESTful or GraphQL APIs

  • Comfort with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)

Preferred

  • Experience with edge computing or embedded processing on resource-constrained platforms (ARM, NVIDIA Jetson, or similar)

  • Familiarity with AUV/UUV systems, robotics middleware (ROS/ROS2), or real-time sensor data processing

  • Experience with marine survey, hydrographic, or oceanographic data

  • Familiarity with sonar data processing (sidescan, multibeam, sub-bottom profiler)

  • Experience with GDAL/OGR, Rasterio, or similar geospatial libraries

  • Background in scientific computing or numerical methods

  • Experience with ML/AI pipelines (TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar), including model optimization for edge deployment

  • Familiarity with Zarr, Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG), or other cloud-native data formats

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK)

  • Active or ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance

Why Chesapeake

  • High impact — your code processes real-world ocean data used by navies, researchers, and survey companies worldwide

  • Cloud + edge — work across the full spectrum, from scalable cloud infrastructure to real-time processing onboard AUVs

  • Greenfield platform — built from the ground up with modern tools, no legacy constraints

  • Small team, big ownership — direct influence on architecture decisions and product direction

  • Domain expertise — 25 years of sonar processing knowledge; you'll learn a fascinating domain

  • Flexible work — fully remote within the US with a collaborative, low-bureaucracy culture

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance, flexible PTO, and professional development opportunities.

Translate clinical findings into product claims, business strategies, and consumer messaging.

  • Represent AscentAI at conferences, webinars, customer meetings, and industry events.
  • Support partner-led opportunities involving LogicGate, IBM OpenPages, Protecht, Resolver, and other strategic ecosystem partners.

Solutions Architect (L5)

The Role

As a Solutions Architect, you will lead the technical strategy for your customers — owning architecture discussions, driving platform adoption, and serving as a trusted advisor to customer technical leads and architects. You combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to position Databricks as the foundation of your customers’ data and AI strategy. You are developing a technical specialization (archetype) and are recognized within your team for depth in a specific domain.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Own the end-to-end technical strategy for your accounts, from initial discovery through production deployment and consumption growth
  • Lead complex architecture discussions — designing scalable, production-grade solutions spanning data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer architects, engineering leads, and Directors
  • Drive technical wins in competitive scenarios by demonstrating Databricks’ differentiation through custom-built solutions
  • Develop and declare an emerging technical specialization (archetype) — becoming a go-to resource for your team in that domain
  • Orchestrate cross-functional resources (DSAs, SSAs, Partners) to deliver comprehensive solutions for complex customer needs
  • Influence product direction by providing structured feedback on customer requirements and competitive gaps

What We Look For

  • 6+ years in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role
  • Strong coding proficiency in Python and SQL — you must demonstrate live coding, debugging, and solution-building skills
  • Deep expertise in distributed data systems architecture: designing scalable pipelines, streaming architectures, lakehouse patterns, and cloud-native data platforms
  • Proficient on the Databricks Platform (or demonstrated ability to achieve proficiency rapidly) with a developing technical specialization in one area (e.g., real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, migrations)
  • Proven ability to lead architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders — whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off analysis
  • Experience with production deployments on public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including infrastructure, security, and governance considerations
  • Track record of driving platform adoption and consumption growth within accounts
  • Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex architectures into business value for both technical and executive audiences
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience)

Nice to Have:

  • Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, Platform)
  • Experience with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) — understanding the landscape you'll position against
  • Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider
  • Industry domain expertise (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Media, etc.)

Interview Process: Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design and Architecture Interview → Live Coding Assessment → Build, Demo, Pitch! Presentation → Reference Check

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here.

Local Pay Range
$180,000—$247,500 USD

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
